purpose: FROZEN, append-only pre-registration ledger for the Scientific Progress Dashboard's Dimension 3 (Narrow) and Dimension 4 (Decide). One entry per open scientific question; each question carries a set of rival hypotheses that were pre-registered BEFORE their discriminating experiment ran (design rule 3). The initial hypothesis set is the FROZEN denominator of the reduction ratio -- it must never be padded after the fact. There are TWO sanctioned ways it may grow: LABELLED GOV-FANOUT-1 fan-out (see the labelled_fanout_growth invariant) and LABELLED discovery growth (see the discovery_growth invariant) -- both preserve the registration-time denominator separately so the ratio is always reportable both ways.
authority: This file is a derive-only INPUT. It never mutates claims.yaml, closure weights, or claim status. It is the human-adjudicated ledger appended at the same governance moment as /failure-autopsy -> /governance. build_hypothesis_space.py joins it against the live autopsy/manifest/evidence data to DERIVE surviving counts, momentum classes, decision-readiness state, and the time series. Nothing here is scored by the closure pipeline.

invariants.elimination_bar: A hypothesis may carry resolution.state == 'eliminated' ONLY with an adjudicated weakens (or a confirmed fan-out discrimination), met_elimination_bar == true, control_passed == true, and non_degenerate == true (design rule 4). check_hypothesis_space_integrity.py enforces this.
invariants.frozen_initial_set: initial_frozen_count_at_registration is fixed at registration and NEVER changes. initial_frozen_count tracks the current enumerated set and may only exceed it via LABELLED fan-out growth (see labelled_fanout_growth) or LABELLED discovery growth (see discovery_growth). A hypothesis's pre_registered_utc must be <= the resolved_utc of its adjudicating run (pre-registration before the experiment, never retro-padding) -- EXCEPT a discovery-growth leg, whose pre_registered_utc legitimately equals its own resolved_utc (see discovery_growth).
invariants.labelled_fanout_growth: An EXISTING, already-adjudicated question's hypothesis set may legitimately grow when a GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination portfolio enumerates new rival explanations as earlier axes are eliminated -- but ONLY when all three hold: (a) STRICT FORM OF INVARIANT 3 -- growth is legitimate for legs whose adjudicating run has NOT yet resolved; a leg added after its own evidence is already in clears ONLY on GIT-WITNESSED provenance, i.e. its pre_registration_source artifact (or its own registry entry) was durably committed BEFORE the run resolved. The self-reported pre_registered_utc alone is NOT sufficient -- it is written after the fact and is trivially back-datable, so an audit reading only this file can never detect back-dating. The witness makes the honest case self-clearing with no human adjudication and the dishonest case detectable, because a commit date cannot be manufactured. Legs with no git history at all (uncommitted, wholesale rewrite, git unavailable) report as a quiet 'unverifiable' state -- not a violation, but not evidence either; (b) the growth is recorded as a machine-readable entry in the question's fanout_growth_events[] naming the autopsy that opened the portfolio (fanout_source) and listing the added hids; (c) initial_frozen_count_at_registration is preserved separately so the reduction ratio can be reported BOTH ways. Growth satisfying (a)-(c) is ADVISORY (labelled fan-out), not a violation. Growth that is unaccounted, unlabelled, or retro-padded remains a REAL bucket-(b) violation. NOTE: a growing denominator is itself a scientific signal -- a campaign that keeps inventing new candidate explanations as it eliminates old ones is FAILING to converge. The dashboard must report surviving/original AND surviving/current so this stays visible rather than being laundered into an improved ratio. DESIGN NOTE -- alarm fatigue is itself a Goodhart vector: a warn-only flag that recurs every cycle with a plausible narrative attached gets accepted by default (exactly what happened when 'benign per invariant 6' was cited for growth invariant 6 did not cover). Legitimate cases MUST self-clear on verifiable provenance so that a raised flag stays rare enough to be worth reading; silence-plus-a-narrative must fail where a git witness would pass.
invariants.discovery_growth: A DIFFERENT sanctioned growth path from labelled_fanout_growth, for a hypothesis that was genuinely never considered until the SAME analysis that resolves it revealed it -- discovered while explaining away already-pre-registered rivals, not anticipated as a rival beforehand. Confirmed incident (2026-08-03): V3-EXQ-108b's disambiguating run eliminated BOTH of inv088_evaluator_degeneracy_cause's pre-registered rivals (H-undertrained-instrument, H-dimension-ceiling) and landed on a THIRD, previously-unconsidered mechanism (H-dynamics-collapse, grounded in established single-step-trained/multi-step-rollout-collapse literature) -- which the labelled_fanout_growth path cannot honestly accommodate, since by construction no artifact can pre-date a discovery made BY that same run's own analysis; forcing it through that path produces exactly the 'unwitnessed pre_registered_utc' signature the (a) witness check exists to catch, which is what actually happened before this invariant was added. Growing an existing question's set this way is permitted ONLY when all three hold: (i) BORN RESOLVED -- the hypothesis's resolution is filled in the SAME edit that registers it (resolved_utc is set, never left alive/untested); pre_registered_utc equals resolved_utc's date, which is honest (it records the day the hypothesis was learned to exist, not a claim of advance knowledge) rather than back-dating (a claim of prior knowledge that was not true). If a hid added this way is left alive, it does NOT qualify as discovery growth -- it needed Mode A pre-registration BEFORE its adjudicating run instead, and back-dating pre_registered_utc to fake that is exactly the violation this invariant exists to distinguish from; (ii) LABELLED WITH A RATIONALE, not just a source -- a discovery_growth_events[] entry naming the discovering-and-resolving autopsy (discovery_source) plus a rationale: what independent theory or mechanism this hypothesis draws on, and why the run's OWN data is what surfaces it, not intuition applied after the fact. discovery_source is also set on each added leg (mirrors pre_registration_source in labelled_fanout_growth); (iii) the original denominator is preserved, exactly as labelled_fanout_growth (c). NEVER use discovery growth as an escape hatch for a rival hypothesis you actually anticipated but forgot to pre-register -- the tell is (i): if you knew it was a live rival before running the experiment, it is not a discovery, and back-dating a pre_registered_utc to make it look pre-registered is the (b) violation this ledger polices, whichever door you try to walk it through. check_hypothesis_space_integrity.py escalates a question racking up >= N (matches FANOUT_RECURRENCE_N) discovery-growth events as a signal that 'discovery' may be substituting for pre-registration discipline rather than genuine one-off serendipity, mirroring the labelled-fan-out recurrence overlay.
invariants.human_owns_decided: decision.decided is set ONLY by a human via decision.decision_log_ref; the dashboard may say 'decidable_now', never 'decided', without it.
invariants.non_contributory_unchanged: A run whose evidence_direction is inconclusive/non_contributory and which does NOT discriminate a pre-registered leg leaves the tree counts untouched (it still appears in the momentum feed).

axis_families._purpose: COARSE, HUMAN-OWNED taxonomy grouping per-leg `axis` labels into families, so build_hypothesis_space.py can distinguish SUCCESSIVE REFINEMENT (a campaign closes out one family and opens a fresh one -- leg count grows while understanding narrows) from CIRCLING (new legs re-enter a family that already has eliminated legs) and SCATTERING (legs spray across families with none ever closed). The bare `fanout_added > 0` proxy it replaces could not tell these apart.
axis_families._authority: This map is ARGUABLE and belongs to the human, not the script. build_hypothesis_space.py computes over it and never invents or infers a family. Disputing a row here is the correct way to dispute a convergence verdict.
axis_families._unclassified_policy: An axis absent from `map` is reported as `unclassified` and forces the question's convergence_class to `indeterminate` -- it NEVER silently defaults into a family. Extend the map when introducing a new axis label (see /failure-autopsy Step 9b).
axis_families._provenance_caveat: These family boundaries were drawn on 2026-07-18 AFTER the competence_floor campaign had run, by a session that had already formed a reading of that campaign's shape. Confirmation-by-construction is a live risk: the taxonomy could have been gerrymandered to produce the verdict its author expected. Two partial checks -- (i) the boundaries are drawn on intervention LOCUS (what layer of the system a hypothesis blames), which is independent of any one question's outcome; (ii) applied to competence_floor it yields a NON-flattering result, classifying the 769 fan-out's drive-schedule leg as re-entry into an already-swept family. A taxonomy that only ever confirms would not do that. Neither check is decisive; treat the verdict as a reading, not a measurement.

_family_glosses.constitution: what the agent is endowed with BEFORE learning starts (innate drives, seeded priors, substrate capacity)
_family_glosses.process: HOW learning or decision proceeds (algorithm, credit, curriculum, exploration, selection, drive schedules)
_family_glosses.representation: WHAT is encoded or perceivable (state representation, readouts, observability)
_family_glosses.world: the TASK the agent faces (environment dynamics, reward structure, evaluation regime)
_family_glosses.instrumentation: whether the effect is MEASURABLE at all (metric validity, credit horizon as a measurement question)

axis_families._explanandum_blindness_caveat: STANDING LIMITATION, recorded 2026-07-19T15:14:23Z per competence_floor_reposing_2026-07-19.md section 2 / section 5d. convergence_class partitions on intervention LOCUS ONLY -- 'what layer of the system a hypothesis blames' -- and has NO dimension for the EXPLANANDUM, the thing being explained. It is therefore STRUCTURALLY INCAPABLE of seeing a change of explanandum, and A LEGITIMATE RE-POSE THAT KEEPS ITS LOCI WILL NECESSARILY SCORE 'circling'. WORKED INSTANCE (competence_floor, cycle 2026-07-19a): all 12 pre-retention legs explain FAILURE TO ACQUIRE; all 4 retention legs explain FAILURE TO RETAIN, conditioned on an installed-competence state (20.933) that no prior leg ever reached. Same loci, different thing-to-be-explained -- so the discriminator must report 'circling', and it did. At FAMILY granularity that verdict is arithmetically correct (4 of 4 re-enter families holding eliminated legs); at the finer per-leg AXIS granularity the map coarsens, only 1 of 4 is a true re-entry (H-consummation-binding into intrinsic-architecture), and that one is motivated by the ELIMINATING run's own load-bearing positive (V3-EXQ-781: approach drive earned at 0.707 while raw_view foraging was SUPPRESSED to 0.200 from a 2.983 control, tight across 3/3 seeds) -- refinement, not circling. The other three sit on a FRESH axis (policy, no prior leg at all), one whose sole prior leg is CONFIRMED (algorithm / H-optim), and one whose sole prior leg is STILL ALIVE (learning-signal / H-bc-prior). DELIBERATELY NO 'retention' AXIS WAS MINTED, and this caveat is the alternative to minting one. Both mech457_retention_portfolio_2026-07-18.md section 91 and competence_floor_reposing_2026-07-19.md section 2 reject a retention axis on the same ground: 'retention' is a QUESTION SHAPE, not an intervention LOCUS, and encoding question-shape into a locus taxonomy to escape an unfavourable score is exactly the confirmation-by-construction gerrymandering _provenance_caveat guards against. A critic swap is an ALGORITHM intervention whether the question is discovery or retention. OPERATIONAL RULE: when a question's convergence_class reads 'circling', check whether its EXPLANANDUM changed before reading the verdict as the re-derive-brake smell. If it did, the verdict is expected and carries no information -- read it against the re-posing record rather than re-litigating it. Absent this note the finding is re-derived every cycle, and it WILL recur here: h_fanout_recurrence also fires again unchanged because the overlay counts PORTFOLIOS and portfolio 3 is permanent history -- N reads 3 until a 4th portfolio opens.

GOV-FANOUT-1 consumer half. RETENTION discrimination portfolio designed by session priceless-lewin-f47019 from the fanout_recommendation of failure_autopsy_MECH-457-gov-fanout-1-cluster-780-781-782_2026-07-18. QUESTION SHAPE CHANGED: the campaign's first ten legs asked which mechanism PRODUCES competence, every one adjudicated against an arm that never left the ~0-1 floor. V3-EXQ-780's raw_view arm reached 20.933 -- the FIRST supra-lift-target (13.05) observation in the campaign -- and RL then ERODED it to 11.667. The open question is therefore why produced competence is not RETAINED. ALL FOUR LEGS ARE SUBSTRATE-BLOCKED and NOTHING WAS QUEUED: /queue-experiment Step 2.5 stopped the portfolio (no distributional critic, no KL-anchor/frozen-policy snapshot, bc_aux_coef is a constant with no schedule, no consummatory act). Four complicated (buildable) nodes minted in substrate_queue.json; route is /implement-substrate. INVARIANT 3a(a) holds trivially and maximally cleanly -- these legs have NO adjudicating runs at all, so pre-registration necessarily precedes resolution. NUMERATOR HONESTY: this moves surviving/frozen from 2/12 = 0.167 to 6/16 = 0.375, which records that the question got WIDER, not that it narrowed -- the opposite direction from the padding the sanctioning decision flagged when it declined H-return-scale. Registering at fan-out DESIGN time, before any probe exists, is the moment this invariant sanctions; the producer-half autopsy deliberately deferred it honouring V3-EXQ-782's pre-declaration, and that deferral is discharged here. AXIS-FAMILY DISPUTE (recorded per axis_families._authority, which designates this as the correct mechanism for disputing a convergence verdict): a naive read scores this portfolio as CIRCLING because the process family already holds 6 eliminated legs. Two corrections. (a) The autopsy's caution overstates the arithmetic -- it says three of four axes map to process, but learning-signal maps to CONSTITUTION, so the split is algorithm+policy -> process (2) and learning-signal+intrinsic-architecture -> constitution (2). (b) The remaining re-entry is not circling, and the distinction is measurable: every eliminated process leg intervened on how competence is DISCOVERED and was adjudicated against an arm at the ~0-1 floor; these legs intervene on whether ALREADY-INSTALLED competence is RETAINED, are adjudicated from a 20.933 starting point, and read a TRAJECTORY. A retention deficit was not merely unobserved by the prior legs, it was UNOBSERVABLE to them -- an arm that never produces competence cannot be seen failing to retain it. DELIBERATELY NO `retention` AXIS INTRODUCED, hence no new axis_families.map row and no forced indeterminate convergence_class: axis_families is drawn on intervention LOCUS, and 'retention' is a question SHAPE. Minting a retention axis to escape an unfavourable score is exactly the confirmation-by-construction the map's own _provenance_caveat warns against. A critic swap is an algorithm intervention whether the question is discovery or retention. ANTI-ALIAS: H-retention-critic changes the VALUE ESTIMATOR, H-retention-consolidation changes the UPDATE CONSTRAINT; a leg changing both is disallowed, which is why the consolidation leg must anchor to a frozen snapshot of the installed policy rather than via bc_aux_coef (that would anchor to the demonstrator and alias with H-retention-auxiliary-decay).

hypotheses.label: needs a dense teacher / stronger exploration
hypotheses.desc: reward sparsity is the wall; a dense teaching signal on z_world should clear it

resolution.basis: sparsity WAS a wall (dense teacher on z_world clears it) -- but the cleared policy still reaches only ~11% of the 48-cell ceiling, so the sub-case 'dense teacher sufficient' is refuted while 'sparsity mattered' is confirmed.

children.label: sparsity was a genuine wall (dense teacher clears it)

hypotheses.label: success-independent novelty (RND) is the seed
hypotheses.desc: a stronger unsupervised explorer (Random Network Distillation) clears the 1.0 competence floor without any earned reward

resolution.basis: RND clears the 1.0 floor (5.22) unsupervised on z_world -- a NECESSARY seed, but insufficient alone (no single bolt-on lifts competence past it). Confirmed-necessary, not confirmed-sufficient.

hypotheses.label: backward credit-sweep converts novelty to competence
hypotheses.desc: an eligibility/credit-sweep over visited states manufactures competence from coverage

resolution.basis: hcredit collapses to the sparse-RL baseline (~0.2-0.45 @D3, below the 1.0 floor and the RND 5.22 plateau); the pre-registered reference bands (oracle 57 / local-view 48 / RND 5.22) all clear the floor, so the sub-floor reading is real, not a starved measurement. Discrimination adjudicated in the confirmed cluster autopsy; non_contributory to MECH-457 but eliminates H-credit as a sufficient mechanism.

hypotheses.label: prediction-trained z_world confers a competence advantage over a random projection
hypotheses.desc: Instrument-validity leg (R4/D12): does a PREDICTION-TRAINED z_world beat a FROZEN RANDOM-PROJECTION z_world on installed foraging competence? Re-validates whether the representation-axis eliminations (H-rep, 747/749) hold now that the encoder actually trains -- V3-EXQ-780 proved every prior z_world arm used a frozen random projection, so the earlier eliminations may have been run on a broken instrument.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-819a (819's gate/router reconciliation: post_bc_install_took now scores strict-majority install fraction, matching the router's own predicate; seeds 3->6) is non_degenerate:true with no adjudication flag. C_zworld_training_confers_competence_advantage passed: mean paired AUC delta +0.626 vs a 0.3 margin, 4/6 seeds clear it (42/43/45/46), n_seeds_harm=0. One low-severity, not-fully-closure-verified substrate-hash provenance caveat recorded in the autopsy (zworld_random_proj control arm ran on a different git substrate_hash than the trained arm mid-run); does not affect this resolution.

hypotheses.label: an informative (distributional) value baseline reverses/flattens the destructive competence-below-control inversion
hypotheses.desc: MECH-475's decisive REVERSAL test: substitute a distributional critic for the scalar one on the named destructive instances (capacity/V3-EXQ-769, approach/V3-EXQ-781, metabolic/V3-EXQ-771), holding the rest of the build byte-identical, and ask whether the treatment-below-control inversion reverses or flattens in >=2/3 families. Anti-alias vs H-retention-critic: that leg tests whether the critic swap RETAINS an installed competent policy under ordinary RL refinement; this leg tests whether it REVERSES an actively DESTRUCTIVE manipulation on an uninstalled/in-training policy.
hypotheses.null_declared: the destructive treatment-below-control inversion persists or worsens under the distributional critic on the destructive instances -> the informative baseline is not the causal mechanism behind this specific destructiveness, and MECH-475 is withdrawn per its own pre-registered criterion.
hypotheses.measurement_requirement: Per-family non-degeneracy guard (scalar_control_competent) and phenomenon-reproduction guard (scalar_inversion_reproduces) both mandatory before a family is scorable -- a family whose own control never cleared the competence floor cannot exhibit a treatment-below-control inversion and must self-exclude, never be forced into a reading.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: Five independent destructive instances (V3-EXQ-769/781/771/780/789) plus the measured uninformative-critic mechanism (V3-EXQ-782 R-(b): std(V)/std(G)=0.041 vs 0.25 floor) plus the positive control (V3-EXQ-788: distributional critic retains 1.839 where scalar does not, under ordinary RL refinement).

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-837 (FAIL, non_degenerate, 2/2 scorable families capacity+approach both readiness- and phenomenon-reproduction-gated green; metabolic correctly self-excluded on its own unmet control-competence guard): the distributional critic's treatment-below-control inversion (15.13/14.90) is 3.4x LARGER than the scalar critic's (4.45/4.44) in both scorable families, reverses_or_flattens=false on all 6 scorable seeds. The informative baseline does not reverse or flatten the destructive effect -- it worsens it. ELIMINATES H-mech475-baseline-reversal; per MECH-475's own text this outcome shape means the claim is WITHDRAWN, not narrowed.

hypotheses.label: competence retention is a dose-dependent consolidation process (over-training deepens the trace)
hypotheses.desc: MECH-476 DOSE arm (Krakauer 2005 over-training paradigm ported): BC-install at 300/600/900 episodes, then identical unconstrained RL refinement; DV is retained_fraction TRAJECTORY. SUPPORTED if retained_fraction_mean is monotone non-decreasing in dose and grows by >= the discrimination margin; WEAKENED if invariant to dose.
hypotheses.null_declared: retained_fraction_mean is invariant to install dose (spread < margin) -> retention tracks only the concurrent constraint, no dose-dependent consolidation process.
hypotheses.measurement_requirement: install_took_strict_majority per-arm readiness gate mandatory; an install that did not take is uninformative about retention. DISCOVERED GAP (resolved by 836a): the SUPPORTED/WEAKENED/NON-MONOTONE discrimination margin must be scaled to observed per-arm noise (SD of the inter-arm delta), not a fixed literal -- 836a implements the noise-scaled fix; see basis.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: V3-EXQ-780 (single BC dose straight into RL refinement, no dose variation) established the erosion phenomenon this leg dose-varies.

resolution.basis: SUPERSEDES the 836 fixed-margin read above. V3-EXQ-836a (FAIL, non_degenerate, all 3 dose arms readiness-gated 100%, n=10 seeds each) redesigned the discrimination rule to the noise-scaled effect-size margin (max(1.5*sd_delta, floor), the gap 836 itself surfaced): retained_fraction_mean = [0.712 (300), 0.430 (600), 0.512 (900)], non-monotone, effect -0.1998 well inside the noise-scaled margin 0.7162 required to call growth. This is now a clean, well-powered null, not a measurement artifact. ELIMINATES H-mech476-dose-response as the retention-driving mechanism. Read jointly with H-mech476-novelty-tagging (836d) and the interval leg (V3-EXQ-836e, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-836e_2026-08-01.json): all three of MECH-476's pre-registered falsifier arms independently and robustly find retention invariant to their manipulated variable, satisfying the claim's own pre-registered withdrawal condition. MECH-476 status updated to retired/withdrawn in claims.yaml (live_status.as_of 2026-08-01, adjudicated_by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-836e_2026-08-01).

hypotheses.label: a temporally-close novelty exposure consolidates an otherwise sub-threshold (weak) install via behavioural tagging
hypotheses.desc: MECH-476 NOVELTY arm (Moncada & Viola 2007 behavioural-tagging paradigm ported): fixed weak BC install (150 episodes, deliberately sub-threshold), then an offline novelty-paired vs novelty-unpaired consolidation window (SD-083 OfflineEWCAnchor, novelty-gated capture). SUPPORTED if the novelty-paired arm retains a larger fraction than unpaired.
hypotheses.null_declared: retained_fraction is invariant (or reversed) between paired and unpaired -> no behavioural-tagging-style novelty-gated consolidation effect.
hypotheses.measurement_requirement: install_took_strict_majority per-arm readiness gate mandatory. DISCOVERED GAP (resolved by 836d): same fixed-margin defect as H-mech476-dose-response, compounded by a deliberately low/noisy weak-install competence regime -- 836d implements the noise-scaled fix.
hypotheses.motivating_evidence: SD-083 offline policy-consolidation window (landed 2026-07-29) provides the novelty-gated EWC capture mechanism this leg exercises for the first time.

resolution.basis: SUPERSEDES the 836c fixed-margin read above. V3-EXQ-836d (FAIL, non_degenerate, both arms readiness-gated 100%, n=10 seeds each) redesigned the discrimination rule to the noise-scaled effect-size margin (the gap 836c itself surfaced): paired retention (0.8338) is LOWER than unpaired (0.9499), opposite Moncada & Viola's prediction, effect -0.1161 well inside the noise-scaled margin 0.7818, and robust across all 10 leave-one-out folds. This is now a clean, well-powered null, not a measurement artifact. ELIMINATES H-mech476-novelty-tagging as the retention-driving mechanism. Read jointly with H-mech476-dose-response (836a) and the interval leg (V3-EXQ-836e, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-836e_2026-08-01.json): all three of MECH-476's pre-registered falsifier arms independently and robustly find retention invariant to their manipulated variable, satisfying the claim's own pre-registered withdrawal condition. MECH-476 status updated to retired/withdrawn in claims.yaml (live_status.as_of 2026-08-01, adjudicated_by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-836e_2026-08-01).

synthesis.surviving_label: retention of an installed competent policy -- which of four loci (value estimator / update constraint / auxiliary persistence / consummatory binding) sets the decay half-life
synthesis.text: Floor = success-dependence + capacity-to-convert. FIVE axes eliminated (capacity 769; drive-schedule 770; reward-coupling 771; credit-horizon 772; approach-primitive 781). RND (H-optim) remains necessary-not-sufficient. THE QUESTION SHAPE CHANGED on 2026-07-18: V3-EXQ-780's raw_view arm installed a BC prior at 20.933 post-BC -- the campaign's FIRST supra-lift-target observation, 3/3 seeds -- which RL refinement then eroded to 11.667. So a competence-directed behavioural prior CAN produce competence; the substrate does not RETAIN it. The ten prior legs were adjudicated on TERMINAL competence, a DV structurally incapable of distinguishing a failed manipulation from a successful one that decayed -- it manufactures nulls at a constant rate independent of the science, and those nulls drove the rival enumeration the recurrence overlay counts. The live frontier is the four-leg RETENTION portfolio (anti-aliased: value estimator / update constraint / auxiliary persistence / consummatory binding). SECOND, UNOWNED explanandum: the same run's z_world arm reached post_bc 0.583 with 0/3 seeds taking -- the manipulation never installed at all. That is an installability question, not a retention one, and no leg currently owns it. RESOLVED 2026-07-25 (failure_autopsy_mech457-retention-confirms-788-792a): all four retention loci adjudicated. CONFIRMED (process family): value estimator -- a distributional critic retains 1.839 vs a flat scalar critic 0.525 (788); update constraint -- a strong KL-anchor to the installed policy retains 0.895 vs unconstrained 0.509, non-monotone dose-response (792a). ELIMINATED (constitution family): auxiliary persistence (789), consummatory binding (821). The retention half-life is set by PROCESS-family mechanisms; the question is decidable_now.
synthesis.under_test: RETENTION portfolio -- 2 of 4 legs now buildable and UNQUEUED (H-retention-critic on ree-v3 8e88ffc; H-retention-auxiliary-decay on ree-v3 9a8dbae, both landed 2026-07-18). H-retention-consolidation and H-consummation-binding remain substrate-blocked (mech457_policy_kl_anchor, mech457_consummatory_act -- both 'proposed'). The superseded H-bc-prior / H-approach-primitive portfolio RAN and RESOLVED on 2026-07-18: V3-EXQ-780 inconclusive (self-route rejected; leg split 2026-07-19T15:14:23Z), V3-EXQ-781 non_contributory (H-approach-primitive eliminated).

decision.decision_question: What sets the decay half-life of an already-installed competent policy under continued RL refinement -- the value estimator, the update constraint, auxiliary persistence, or consummatory binding?
decision.live_gate: H-retention-critic + H-retention-auxiliary-decay, queued AS A PAIR under new EXQ numbers. Both substrate-unblocked 2026-07-18; the retention portfolio's own 'queue nothing until at least two legs are buildable' gate is MET, and ree-v3/experiment_queue.json is empty. Pair, not singly: GOV-FANOUT-1 exists because adjudicating a leg in isolation is how a confident-but-wrong elimination enters the frozen ledger, and 781's elimination alone would have rested on no demonstration that competence was reachable at all.
decision.distance_phrase: DECIDED 2026-07-25 (scoped to RETENTION; decision_log.v1.jsonl@2026-07-25T23:26:31Z). The retention decision_question is closed: PROCESS-family loci set the decay half-life of a BC-installed competent policy -- value estimator (H-retention-critic / V3-EXQ-788) and update constraint (H-retention-consolidation / V3-EXQ-792a), each independently sufficient -- while CONSTITUTION-family loci were eliminated (H-retention-auxiliary-decay / V3-EXQ-789; H-consummation-binding / V3-EXQ-821). SCOPE: retention only. The INSTALLABILITY / representation explanandum (the competence FLOOR itself; whether prediction-trained z_world confers any advantage) remains the LIVE FRONTIER -- carried by V3-EXQ-819 and the sibling question conversion_ceiling_root (H-observation-interface), and owed its own question per the bifurcation_note. Marking this hero question 'decided' closes RETENTION, not the floor. CORRECTION 2026-08-08 (competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08.md): the installability frontier this phrase names as 'LIVE' and 'owed its own question' is resolved, not live. H-bc-prior child 3 (the z_world non-install finding this pointed at) was VOIDED 2026-08-07 as a frozen-random-projection instrument artifact -- the imitation pathway's z_world behaviour, re-measured on the corrected instrument, is not distinguishable from a genuine install (V3-EXQ-819a: trained z_world beats random projection, mean paired AUC delta +0.626, 4/6 seeds; within 780's own contaminated data the z_world treatment beats its own control on every sub-skill). H-zworld-trained-instrument is CONFIRMED. No installability leg remains open; the bifurcation_note's deferred qid split (D6, 07-19 repose) is therefore MOOT -- there is nothing left on either side of the split to carry into a second qid. The campaign's discrimination phase is complete; see growth_restriction.
decision.observation_bottleneck: Any new leg on this question MUST carry the four measurement_requirement constraints: a competence TRAJECTORY DV (not terminal); an explicit 'manipulation succeeded and then decayed' branch in the interpretation grid; routing on DECLARED COVARIATES; and substrate_not_ready_requeue when an install did not take. V3-EXQ-780 is the standing worked example of what their absence costs -- the catching covariate (post_bc_foraging_competence) was present, declared and load-bearing, yet the grid enumerated only a ~0 null, so a manipulation that succeeded ABOVE target was scored a null. The instrumentation was adequate; the interpretation grid was not. UPDATE 2026-08-07/08 (competence_floor_instrument_audit_2026-08-07.md section 3d; competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08.md section 4): V3-EXQ-821's H-consummation-binding test is itself a worked instance of this requirement's fourth clause going unheeded -- both arms installed at only 14% of the ceiling this campaign's other legs used (4.77 vs 20.9-38.3 forage/episode), tied at the absolute floor on every sub-skill (forage 0.000, goal_reach_rate 0.000, survival below random_walk), so the comparison could not discriminate anything. state reset alive <- eliminated; met_elimination_bar reset false. The re-posed decisive re-test (not a new rival hypothesis): once the BC install is calibrated to clear a usable floor and the DV reports foraging RATE (resources/tick) alongside the composite resources/episode count (the composite conflates rate with episode duration -- see the confirmed legs' own sub-skill-decomposition rider), does consummatory-act binding change the retention outcome? Routed complicated (buildable) -> /queue-experiment (probe-function fix + one calibrated re-run), NOT a fan-out portfolio -- there are no rival hypotheses left on this leg, only a measurement floor to clear.
decision.bifurcation_note: This question carries TWO explananda -- RETENTION (raw_view: installed 3/3 at 20.933, eroded to 11.667) and INSTALLABILITY (z_world: post_bc 0.583, 0/3 took, never installed). Two explananda under one denominator is itself part of why the campaign reads as non-convergent. A qid SPLIT was ADJUDICATED AND DEFERRED 2026-07-19T15:14:23Z (competence_floor_reposing_2026-07-19.md section 5a / D6), on three grounds: (a) the installability half currently has ZERO legs, and a question with initial_frozen_count 0 yields an undefined reduction ratio; (b) splitting would SHRINK this question's frozen count, and the GOV-FROZEN-1 invariants sanction labelled denominator GROWTH (3a) but define no operation for shrinkage -- it would present as an audit (a)/(b) violation; (c) the z_world install-failure diagnosis (session blissful-hugle-5dd043, claimed 2026-07-18T18:28Z) has NOT landed a finding note under evidence/planning/, so splitting now would pre-commit the frame ahead of its own diagnosis. The bifurcation is instead recorded structurally: here, in synthesis.text, and as child 3 of the H-bc-prior split. REVISIT the split when the installability diagnosis lands with at least one leg to carry.
decision.decidable_basis: The decision_question ('which of value estimator / update constraint / auxiliary persistence / consummatory binding sets the decay half-life') now has an adjudicated answer: value estimator AND update constraint both set it (each independently restores retention of the BC-installed prior from ~0.51 to 0.81-1.84 retained_fraction); auxiliary persistence and consummatory binding do not. The retention deficit is a PROCESS-family (algorithm/policy) problem, not a CONSTITUTION-family one. adjudicated_by failure_autopsy_mech457-retention-confirms-788-792a_2026-07-25.

questions.title_repose_note: RE-POSED 2026-07-19T15:14:23Z per competence_floor_reposing_2026-07-19.md section 3. The prior title -- 'Why is committed competence stuck below the foraging floor?' -- PRESUPPOSED competence is never reached. V3-EXQ-780 falsified that presupposition: the raw_view arm reached 20.933 immediately post-BC (above the 13.05 lift-competence target, inside the 32.72 BC-expert band, against a 48.05 local_view_greedy ceiling), with 3/3 seeds taking the install; RL refinement then eroded it to 11.667. A question with a false presupposition cannot be answered, only endlessly re-explained -- every leg that failed to produce TERMINAL competence read as 'another rival is needed', when the actual structure is that competence is reachable, transient, and invisible to a terminal-only DV. The re-posed title carries BOTH explananda the campaign actually faces (retention, installability) rather than the single acquisition question that was never the live one. Explanandum only -- no leg, locus, denominator or claim status changes here.
questions.growth_restriction: CLOSED TO FURTHER FAN-OUT (2026-08-08, competence_floor_recurrence_repose_2026-08-08.md, chip-20260808-competence-floor-refpose). This qid accumulated 5 labelled GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolios (denominator 7 -> 20) before its own standing rule -- set by competence_floor_reposing_2026-07-19.md section 7, 'if a fifth portfolio is proposed on the retention operationalization, treat the recurrence flag as BLOCKING' -- was checked against a real case. Portfolio 5 (failure_autopsy_mech476-mech475-cluster_2026-07-29) opened three legs squarely in the already-decided 'process' family (MECH-475's own registration text names the SAME uninformative-baseline mechanism the retention decision had just confirmed a fix for) and nothing checked the 07-19 rule against it, because the rule lived only as prose in a planning document, not as anything a future /failure-autopsy Step 9b invocation would read. It converged decisively anyway (both MECH-475 and MECH-476 fully retired within days, on their own pre-registered falsifiers) -- that was the outcome, not a property of the process that produced it. RULE, stated here so the next session finds it in the qid it applies to, not in a fourth separate document: a claim whose depends_on includes MECH-457, MECH-459, MECH-460, MECH-475, or MECH-476, and whose first /failure-autopsy would otherwise grow competence_floor by Step 9b's claims+theme matching, should instead pre-register its OWN qid -- UNLESS the specific mechanism under test targets an axis family this qid's decision block still lists as undecided (there is currently none; every family -- process, constitution, instrumentation, representation, world -- carries a resolved answer). This qid's 20 hypotheses and their resolutions are UNCHANGED by this note (GOV-FROZEN-1 has no shrinkage operation and none is invoked); what changes is that this qid should not receive hypothesis #21 onward. The one still-alive leg, H-consummation-binding, is not an exception -- it is complicated (buildable) work (a probe-function fix + one calibrated re-run; see decision.observation_bottleneck), not a discrimination, so it does not need or license a sixth portfolio. Recommended follow-on (not started by this session, per scope discipline): teach /failure-autopsy Step 9b to read a target qid's growth_restriction before Mode A/B registration and surface it to the user at the Step 8 gate rather than silently growing the qid.

questions.title: Which of the four candidate roots drives the conversion / committed-action-diversity ceiling?

fanout_growth_events.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 growth routed by the confirmed 734/737b/742a cluster autopsy (user-adjudicated 2026-07-22). The live gate V3-EXQ-737 returned a null that does NOT discriminate H-policy-learning, because every learner scored below its own random-walk anchor -- a failure invariant across learner AND representation is a property of the objective they share. Pre-registered BEFORE its adjudicating run exists (none queued), so invariant 3a(a) is satisfied by construction. CIRCLING DISCLOSURE: axis `reward` maps to family `world`, where H-reward-balance is already eliminated by V3-EXQ-735, so build_hypothesis_space.py will classify this growth as CIRCLING. That is accepted, not dodged -- see the autopsy .md section 7. H-reward-balance asked whether RE-WEIGHTING reward terms lifts committed-action DIVERSITY; this leg asserts that under the given weighting the OPTIMAL policy is not to forage at all, on the FORAGING-COMPETENCE DV, and rests on evidence that did not exist when 735 was adjudicated. A reader who judges that distinction too fine should merge this leg into H-reward-balance and re-open that elimination -- NOT re-label the axis.

813 autopsy override: raw-obs actor forages, latent-actor does not -> representation/observation-interface is the surviving live root after H-policy-learning eliminated and H-objective-misspecification displaced.

hypotheses.label: reward-balance is the lever
hypotheses.desc: re-balancing the reward terms lifts committed-action diversity

resolution.basis: reward re-balancing does not move the ceiling -- reward is not the lever (adjudicated in the confirmed cluster autopsy).

hypotheses.label: substrate ceiling (representation/capacity)
hypotheses.desc: the REE substrate itself caps diversity independent of driver

resolution.basis: a substrate ceiling remains consistent with the null; not discriminated away -- stays alive. CORRECTION 2026-07-22 (failure_autopsy_competence-objective-cluster-734-737b-742a): the recorded adjudicating run V3-EXQ-734 is now known INVALID -- its z_world encoder guard was RED on all 4 rungs x 4 seeds (0 of 61 latent_stack and 0 of 4 world_encoder tensors moved, max_abs_delta 0.0), so ree_trained_allon ran on a frozen random projection throughout. The leg was already alive so no state moves, but 734 must not be cited as evidence for or against it. Awaiting the 734a re-run on the SD-070 encoder-warmup path. | UPDATE 2026-07-24 (failure_autopsy_backlog): the V3-EXQ-734 20260722T202649Z re-run has a GREEN z_world encoder guard (unlike the invalidated earlier 734) and still shows REE all-ON recovering at NO difficulty rung while vanilla PPO recovers at D2 -- a VALID corroboration of the substrate/representation ceiling. 813 corroborates via the representation route (H-observation-interface). Stays alive as a leading live root alongside H-observation-interface. | UPDATE 2026-08-25 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-948): 948 sharpens the representation route from corroboration to a CONFIRMED, actionable, NAMED mechanism (H-observation-interface: z_world discards resource-gradient structure present in its own input, even under SD-018's existing scalar proximity supervision). H-substrate-ceiling itself remains alive and untested by 948's design -- this is a read-across note, not a resolution of this leg.

hypotheses.label: policy-learning insufficient (or deeper root)
hypotheses.desc: the policy-learning stage cannot convert representation into committed diversity

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-813 (survival-zeroed PPO probe) DISCRIMINATES this axis where 737b/742a could not: PPO on raw observations CLEARS the D3 hazard-free floor (9.033 >> 1.0) while PPO on the REE latent does not (0.5), under the identical W3_survival_zeroed objective. A competent external actor learns the foraging policy fine, so the policy-learning stage is NOT the bottleneck -- eliminated. (Autopsy failure_autopsy_backlog_2026-07-24: 813 self-routed substrate_not_ready on an unmet manipulation-check, a false self-route overridden per user-confirmed judgment.)

hypotheses.label: F-dominance selection-conversion
hypotheses.desc: a dominant selection channel (F-dominance) starves committed-action diversity at conversion

resolution.basis: 2026-08-02 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-857a+858, session determined-ritchie-55a3a6): V3-EXQ-851's and V3-EXQ-858's own substrate_not_ready_requeue self-routes are COMPOUND-GATE ARTIFACTS (an all-4-rungs-simultaneous AND active_frac>=0.8 requirement), not evidence of a dead mechanism -- raw per-cell data (851: excluded_count 17-28 at active_frac 0.24-0.58; 858: excluded_count 17.8-29.0 at active_frac 0.24-0.84, both matching the healthy V3-EXQ-654j baseline magnitude) show MECH-448/449 robustly engaged at a reduced duty cycle. 858's own C2 (committed-class entropy lift F000 vs F100) reads as a near-miss in the H-f-dominance direction: 2/3 seeds positive (+0.090, +0.048 nats vs 0.05 margin), 1/3 flat (-0.003) -- suggestive but not decisive (only 1/3 clears the driver's own 2-of-3 pass bar). Stays alive pending V3-EXQ-863 (route_source='none' comparator, queued, deprioritized) and a corrected readiness-gate spec for this GOV-FANOUT-1 lineage.

hypotheses.label: the training objective is not the scored objective
hypotheses.desc: The training return is dominated by episode survival, so the optimal policy under the given reward is NOT to forage. Every learner correctly un-learns the behaviour the DV scores. Evidence: at hazard-free D3 every learner (REE bias-head 0.533, ppo_raw_obs 0.567, ppo_ree_latent 0.233, all four actor-critic arms 0.200-0.267) sits BELOW the run's own random-walk anchor of 0.933, while a local-view greedy reading the same 5x5 field scores 48.05; and at D0 vanilla PPO survives 175.0 steps vs the greedy oracle's 20.4 while foraging 17x less.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-808 CONFIRMS the descriptive core -- the realised return is SURVIVAL-dominated (consumption_share 0.282 < 0.50), so the training objective under-weights the scored foraging objective. But its declared null required consumption ALREADY >= 0.50 AND reweighting inert to REFUTE, and the first clause did not hold, so the leg is NOT refuted. C2_reweighting_moves_d3_competence FAILED (0.333, non-degenerate): reweighting toward consumption (up to 25:1) does not lift competence -- naive reweighting is not the removable lever. Misspecification is real but DISPLACED as the actionable root; live discrimination passes to policy (813, eliminated) and representation.

questions.title: Does the control plane carry two independent degrees of freedom, or collapse to one scalar?

hypotheses.label: score-bias and temperature are independent axes
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (i): the MECH-320 tonic_vigor score-bias axis and the MECH-313 noise_floor temperature axis route to distinct E3 softmax parameters and produce non-collinear behavioural effect vectors (rank 2)

resolution.basis: 777a narrowed nothing, but for a NEW reason. Sampling is genuinely repaired (all 56 cells reached 250 fresh E3 selections, zero starved cells) and all six preconditions were MET, so control_passed and non_degenerate are true for the first time. C1 still failed -- NOT on collinearity: mean_sin_angle 0.5454 EXCEEDS the 0.500 margin and c1_seed_count PASSED (3 of 4 informative seeds, required 3). The sole failing bar, c1_robust, is defined as mean minus POPULATION SD (statistics.pstdev, script line 541/697) and so cannot be met at any n; repaired to standard-error form it needs ~51 informative seeds against an observed 28.6% informative yield (~177 raw seeds, ~31 h). That yield is substrate-gated: corr(D-saturation-distance, norm_v_score) = 0.884 with 9 of 14 seeds saturated, a property of an untrained agent's degenerate action-value distribution that barely moved from 777's starved run. Hypothesis stays ALIVE -- a substrate-ceiling non_contributory discriminates nothing. Note the surviving evidence points TOWARD this leg, not away: within the informative pool the angle does not track score-axis magnitude (corr 0.028) and the best-conditioned seed 17 gives sin_angle 0.9883. Re-derive brake FIRED; pending SD-PROBE-WARMUP, not a further lettered iteration.

hypotheses.label: tonic baseline and phasic transient are independent DOF on one readout
hypotheses.desc: MECH-063 sub-claim (ii): the MECH-313 tonic noise_floor moves the sustained baseline entropy while the SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst moves an event-locked transient on the same E3 temperature readout, with cross-legs ~0 (double dissociation)

resolution.basis: 779b was a one-parameter exposure fix for 779a and the fix VERIFIABLY took effect (seed 23 / T1P1: 835 -> 2400 env steps, stop_reason episode_cap -> step_cap, episode_cap_can_bind False in all 20 cells) yet phasic_fires_real_events still measured 6 vs threshold 10 -- the MIN having MIGRATED from T1P1/seed23 (6 -> 13, as predicted) to T0P1/seed23 (10 -> 6 despite ~2.85x exposure). The starvation hypothesis is REFUTED. Root cause: PhasicSurpriseBurst resets its surprise-EMA COLD at every episode boundary with a ~10-tick time constant (PHASIC_EMA_DECAY 0.1) while seed 23 runs ~6.9-step episodes, so its baseline never converges and added steps arrive as 345 more cold restarts rather than longer episodes -- exposure was added on an axis orthogonal to the binding constraint. SD-069 capability remains ruled out (burst_level_max 1.00 in every PHASIC-ON cell). Crucially the withholding is CORRECT, not spurious: diss_seed_count 4 sits at exactly MIN_SEEDS 4 and leave-one-out collapses the verdict for 4 of 5 seeds INCLUDING seed 23, so the load-bearing criterion DEPENDS on the very cell the gate flags. Spearman rho(ticks, |dR_phasic|) = -0.90 (n=5) is equally well read as the gate being construct-invalid OR as small-sample effect-size inflation on seed 23 (-0.110 on ~9.5 ticks), and n=5 cannot discriminate -- arguing from the effect size presupposes the effect is real. Separately robust:true used the mean-minus-population-SD idiom retired by MECH-063 autopsy follow-up #4; under the corrected SEM bar the PHASIC leg (which is this sub-claim) fails at k=2 (+0.0179 vs margin 0.02) while the tonic leg passes. non_degenerate false and nothing discriminated, so the elimination bar is NOT met and the leg stays ALIVE. Re-derive brake FIRED (3rd MECH-063 autopsy; the 779a exemption predicate is falsified on both halves); V3-EXQ-779c REFUSED, routed to substrate sd_phasic_ema_episode_continuity.

hypotheses.label: the control plane collapses to a single scalar
hypotheses.desc: the rival reading: apparent tonic/phasic and score/temperature distinctions are reparameterisations of one underlying control scalar, so no genuine second degree of freedom exists

resolution.basis: Both adjudicating runs have now completed and BOTH produced evidence pointing AWAY from collapse -- 777a's mean_sin_angle 0.5454 exceeds the 0.500 non-collinearity margin with its best-conditioned seed at 0.9883, and 779a's double-dissociation criterion PASSED robustly on 4 seeds. NEITHER cleared the elimination bar, however: 777a is a substrate-ceiling non_contributory (informative yield 28.6%, criterion bar unreachable) and 779a is non_degenerate false (readiness unmet). No bits may be claimed against this rival. It stays ALIVE and remains untested; the apparent support 777 once lent it was withdrawn by the predecessor autopsy and nothing here revives it.

questions.title: Do the SD-068 consolidation-pipeline per-phase readouts measure content fidelity, or raw noise sensitivity?

hypotheses.label: the SWS denoising readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: sws_denoising_snr scores the preserved deviation-structure of injected clean prototypes, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance rather than raw noise sensitivity

resolution.basis: null_slope_ratio 1.0000 (sd 2.7e-8, 95% CI [0.99999997, 1.00000001]) on 8/8 seeds -- the zero-content null arm reproduces the injected arm's sigma-slope to eight decimal places. Structural, not statistical: noise_power is identical across arms at every sigma while signal_power is 5585.7 vs 0.0, so denoising_snr_db = 10*log10(signal/noise) has a sigma-slope driven entirely by log(noise_power) and the content term differentiates away. Readiness precondition met (injected slope 0.0665 >> 1e-06) and criteria_non_degenerate true, so the control discriminated cleanly.

hypotheses.label: the NREM transfer-fidelity readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: nrem_transfer_fidelity measures the fraction of the injected-content gap closed by the CrossModuleConsolidator pass, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance

resolution.basis: null_slope_ratio 0.1445 (sd 0.00090, 95% CI [0.1438, 0.1451]), 0/8 seeds confounded, verdict stable, CI well below the 0.25 ceiling and not straddling it. The null arm's slope is ~14% of the injected arm's, so the readout is substantially content-contingent. Necessary-not-sufficient for SD-068's full 3-phase contract: this is the ONLY phase confirmed content-contingent.

hypotheses.label: the REM precision-calibration readout tracks content fidelity
hypotheses.desc: rem_precision_error scores |running_variance_after - 1/target_clean| against an injected known target precision, so its sigma-slope reflects functional damage tolerance

resolution.self_route_label: substrate_not_ready_requeue + measurement_still_degenerate_requeue (both superseded by the joint read)
resolution.basis: ELIMINATED as the direct complement of H-rem-genuinely-content-free being confirmed -- the two are mutually exclusive readings of the same readout and the joint evidence discriminates between them. Once 778d's unpaired-target null removes the clamp degeneracy (7/8 seeds de-railed, clamp fractions mostly 0.0), the null arm STILL tracks the injected arm's sigma-slope: content-contingent on only 1/8 seeds, unclamped ratios 0.577-0.995 against a 0.25 ceiling. 778e's independently de-clamped readout agrees on every non-degenerate seed (0.999 / 0.998 / 0.326, all ABOVE the ceiling). Positive controls passed in both legs (injected slopes 0.0665 and 0.0771, both >> the 1e-06 floor, on 8/8 seeds). The rem calibration readout responds to noise magnitude, not content fidelity. Residual: one dissenting seed (778d idx 3, ratio 0.0011) and a wide ratio spread (sd 29.8, CI [-9.08, 32.18]) whose instability runs TOWARD content-freeness.

hypotheses.label: the REM null degeneracy is a clamp artifact of the step=1.0 measurement choice
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The full-adoption step=1.0 linear interpolation drives calibration_error into its positivity floor / saturation constant, so the null arm cannot express a graded slope regardless of content-contingency

probe_amendments.retired_probe: re-run the rem leg over a step ladder (0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0) and read whether the null arm leaves the 998.5 constant and the 1e-3 floor. Declared null: if the null arm stays railed at every step, this leg is refuted.
probe_amendments.retired_reason: PROVABLY INERT -- would have returned this leg's own declared null BY CONSTRUCTION. ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py recalibrate_precision_to computes rv_after = (1-step)*rv_before + step*(1/(target+1e-6)), so (a) the max(1e-3, raw_target) positivity clamp is applied to corrupt_target UPSTREAM of step, making the clamp fraction and the null-series distinct-value count EXACTLY step-invariant, and (b) both arms' sigma-slopes carry the same linear factor step, which CANCELS in the reported ratio |null slope| / |injected slope|. Verified numerically over step in {0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0}: ratio identical to 12 significant figures (14569.1833719598-...602, float round-off only), clamp fraction and distinct-value count bit-identical. A positivity-floor ladder fails for the same reason: the null arm's reference is centred on ZERO, so it clamps on ~half the draws at ANY floor value. Running it would have written a false elimination into the frozen ledger rather than a measurement.
probe_amendments.replacement_probe: UNPAIRED-TARGET null. ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED points the recalibration at an INDEPENDENT positive target of the same magnitude class (log-normal, positive by construction), unpaired with the clean target the error is scored against -- the faithful Bar et al. 2020 'same odour, NO PRIOR PAIRING' analog, versus the zero-content null which removes the pairing AND pushes the parameterisation off a cliff. ARM_NULL_ZERO (the 778c null) is retained as a replication anchor.
probe_amendments.replacement_declared_null: if ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED stays railed too -- still clamping, still constant -- this leg is REFUTED and the measurement axis is eliminated from the question.
probe_amendments.detected_by: pre-queue design audit of V3-EXQ-778d, before any compute was spent
probe_amendments.witness_commit: ree-v3 18c4687 (main) -- 'SD-068 GOV-FANOUT-1: queue the 3-leg REM discrimination portfolio (V3-EXQ-778d/e/f)'
probe_amendments.integrity_note: The amendment precedes the adjudicating run: witness commit 18c4687 and this record both predate any V3-EXQ-778d result manifest, and resolved_utc is still null. pre_registered_utc (2026-07-18T08:41:15Z) is unchanged and the hid is unchanged, so the git-witnessed pre-registration check still resolves against the original fan-out commit. The hypothesis under adjudication is UNCHANGED (the degeneracy is an artifact of the measurement rather than a property of the readout); only the probe is.

resolution.control_rehabilitation_note: control_passed is asserted on the CORRECTED both-rails predicate, NOT the shipped one-rail predicate. The shipped readiness anchor (v3_exq_sd068_rem_unpaired_null_diagnostic.py:288) scores `railed` as NOT(clamp_frac<=0.2 and n_distinct>=3 and n_unclamped>=3), which detects only the SATURATION rail; V3-EXQ-778c's degeneracy was documented at BOTH rails (saturation AND positivity-floor collapse). The three floor-collapsed seeds are therefore scored HEALTHY, capping a bit-perfect replication at 5/8 = 0.625 against a >= 0.75 gate -- the precondition is unmeetable by construction. The anchor's underlying data DID reproduce 778c to identical floats across three independent runs ([4348.4665081785715, 0.0, 9142.771353766831, 0.0, 1801.6453681003277, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0] in both 778d ARM_NULL_ZERO and 778e's legacy anchor, matching 778c's recorded 0.0-on-5/8 / 1801-9143-on-3/8). criteria_non_degenerate.C1 = readiness_ok AND anchor_ok with readiness_ok true on 8/8, so the degeneracy flag traces ENTIRELY to this one mis-specified statistic. Post-hoc rehabilitation, adjudicated at the interactive gate 2026-07-18 and labelled as such. Clean-as-shipped re-run routed as V3-EXQ-778h (low priority, ledger hygiene; NOT a blocker on this resolution).
resolution.basis: CONFIRMED on the load-bearing criterion: C1_unpaired_null_derails PASSED, 7/8 seeds, ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED clamp fractions [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.2, 0.0, 0.6, 0.2, 0.2]. The leg's declared null ('if ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED stays railed too, this leg is REFUTED') did NOT trigger -- the unpaired null left the rails. The V3-EXQ-778c both-rails degeneracy WAS an artifact of how the zero-content null was operationalised. Note this is orthogonal to content-freeness: the degeneracy being an artifact and the readout being content-free are BOTH true (see H-rem-genuinely-content-free). Probe was amended pre-queue -- the original step-ladder was proven algebraically inert (step cancels in the reported ratio; verified identical to 12 sig figs over step in {0.1,0.25,0.5,1.0}) and would have returned this leg's declared null BY CONSTRUCTION; the unpaired-target replacement is the faithful Bar et al. 2020 'same odour, no prior pairing' analog. Amendment witnessed at REE_assembly master 2970e2112c / ree-v3 18c4687. Provenance updated 2026-07-19: V3-EXQ-778h (anchorfix re-run, supersedes V3-EXQ-778d) reproduces this result on a corrected readiness anchor -- anchor railed 8/8 seeds and the unpaired null de-railed 7/8, confirming the 1e-3 positivity-clamp artifact is real. Scored non_contributory (ledger hygiene, not double-counted weight); see failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-778h_2026-07-19.json.

hypotheses.label: the REM calibration readout is genuinely content-independent, like SWS
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The rival reading: the clamping is incidental and a de-clamped readout would still show a null slope ratio near 1.0, making rem a second content-free leg

resolution.basis: CONFIRMED on the JOINT 778d+778e evidence, per GOV-FANOUT-1's requirement that portfolio legs be read jointly. 778e ALONE narrows nothing: its precondition declamped_null_series_non_degenerate is unmet (5/8 seeds saturate at n_distinct 1) and its C1 fails on those degenerate zeros -- a zero slope from a saturated constant is not evidence of content-contingency. But 778d's de-railed ARM_NULL_UNPAIRED is a NON-DEGENERATE observation of the same quantity (7/8 seeds de-railed, injected readiness cleared 8/8), and it shows the null still tracking the injected slope: content-contingent on 1/8 seeds, unclamped ratios [0.995, 0.901, 0.877, 0.0011, 0.577, 85.18, 0.574, 3.295] against a 0.25 ceiling. 778e's three NON-degenerate seeds agree independently (0.999 / 0.998 / 0.326, all above the ceiling). De-clamping changed the SCALE (9143 -> ~1.0) but not the PATTERN -- the same five seeds saturate -- so the degeneracy is not a units artifact. control_passed true (injected-arm readiness cleared on 8/8 in BOTH legs); non_degenerate true (778d's unpaired arm). RESIDUAL STATED HONESTLY: one dissenting seed (778d idx 3, unclamped ratio 0.0011, strongly content-contingent, on a legitimately de-railed arm), and the unpaired-arm ratio estimate is unstable (mean 11.55, sd 29.77, 95% CI [-9.08, 32.18], ceiling_inside_ci95 true) -- but the instability runs TOWARD larger ratios, i.e. toward more content-freeness. Direction not in doubt; magnitude not estimable. Confirmed 7/8, not 8/8.

hypotheses.label: rem_generative_gain is a content-free transfer-function property
hypotheses.desc: GOV-FANOUT-1 leg. The attenuating generative gain (0.149, 8/8) may be a property of the rollout transfer function rather than evidence that 'correction needs an intact seed' -- which would undercut the sd_068 doc's line-221 gloss without touching the attenuation finding itself

resolution.basis: CONFIRMED cleanly as shipped -- the only leg of the portfolio that needed no rehabilitation. Precondition control_input_corruption_range_supra_floor met (1.5646 vs 0.05) on the content_scale=1.0 positive control; all three criteria_non_degenerate true; manifest non_degenerate true. Load-bearing C1_gain_flat_in_content_scale PASSED: mean gain delta (1.0 minus 0.0) = -0.009662 against a pre-registered separation bar of max(0.05 absolute floor, 2 x SEM = 0.0117) = 0.05, separated false. The declared null required the gain to be above the bar WITH monotonicity; it was an order of magnitude below. Mean gain by content scale 0.1589 / 0.1520 / 0.1493. TWO points against the retracted gloss: (i) a consistent monotone ordering does exist (7/8 seeds) but is exactly the consistent-but-tiny case the bar was built to reject; (ii) its SIGN IS INVERTED -- gain is LOWER with intact content than with none -- opposite to what 'correction needs an intact seed' predicts. SCOPE GUARD HONOURED: this does NOT overturn the attenuation finding (rem_generative_gain 0.149, attenuating 8/8 seeds), which STANDS and is recorded at every content scale (8/8 attenuating at 0.0, 0.5 and 1.0). Only the interpretive gloss in the sd_068 architecture doc's OPEN QUESTION box is retracted.

questions.title: Why is the z_world manifold under-differentiated -- an untrained encoder, or a world_dim=32 discriminative-granularity ceiling?

hypotheses.desc: SplitEncoder.world_encoder receives no gradient during P0 (the loop buffers latent.z_world.detach() and optimises only agent.e2.parameters()), so the manifold is an untrained projection regardless of its width.

resolution.basis: 783 crosses {dim 32,128} x {untrained,trained} at n=8 paired seeds. Training lifts the z_world contrast ratio at BOTH dims (dim32 +0.0814, t=+7.26; dim128 +0.1074, t=+13.11), both CI95 clear of zero. All four preconditions MET, including the positive control (raw channel CR 0.8138 vs a 0.2 floor) and the weight-movement check that read 0/61 on the x734 configuration and reads 7 here.

hypotheses.label: the world_dim=32 discriminative-granularity ceiling
hypotheses.desc: The 2026-06-06 cluster autopsy's substrate_ceiling / pending_retest_after_substrate leg: 32 latent units cap the discriminable structure z_world can carry, so contrast should rise with dimensionality.

resolution.basis: Raising world_dim 32 -> 128 lifts contrast at NEITHER training state: untrained -0.0032 (t=-0.73, CI95 [-0.0135,+0.0071]), trained +0.0228 (t=+1.60, CI95 [-0.0110,+0.0566]) -- both straddle zero at n=8 paired seeds. The emitted mixed_partial_separation label turned on the trained delta exceeding a bright-line 0.02 minor-axis ceiling by 0.0028 against its own SEM of 0.0143, and does not survive a noise-aware read (autopsy section 3, user-adjudicated). The 2026-06-06 substrate_ceiling verdict on this leg is refuted by its own user-confirmed retest spec.

synthesis.surviving_label: untrained encoder (a1) -- z_world under-differentiation is a training fault, not a dimensionality fault
synthesis.text: z_world under-differentiation is a TRAINING fault, not a DIMENSIONALITY fault. SD-070 (ree-v3 main f418400) supplies the missing gradient path and demonstrably works (world-path weight-delta 7; participation-ratio retention 0.658 against the prescribed pre-SD-070 P0's collapse to PR ~1.06). questions.title: Does global scalar arousal amplify selection variance by CONCENTRATING it on the incumbent channel, or by BROADENING it across subordinate channels?

hypotheses.label: Arousal concentrates variance on the incumbent (MECH-463 as registered)
hypotheses.desc: Incumbent share of committed-selection score variance rises monotonically with urgency decile, channel-agnostically across incumbent identities.
hypotheses.basis: The claim's registered prediction. Contradicted in the one validly-scored regime (rho -0.8303 vs threshold +0.6) but only under ENDOGENOUS urgency, so the elimination bar is not met.

resolution.basis: Under EXOGENOUS urgency (i.i.d. uniform over a pre-registered grid, confound broken by construction, gate GREEN, non_degenerate true) the incumbent share does NOT rise: 0.9375 -> 0.9411 across an 8.5x urgency range (0.04-0.34), gap +0.0036 against a +0.02 threshold, rho +0.31 vs +0.6. The null is tight, not underpowered: within-level share SD ~0.075-0.082 at ~290 rows/level gives SE ~0.0044, so the gap is under 1 SE, and per-seed gaps straddle zero [-0.0016,+0.0119,+0.0021,+0.0081,-0.0058]. Independently reconfirmed at tick level on the 1757 committed rows in custom_information.per_tick_rows: corr(assigned_urgency, incumbent share) = +0.010. Internal validity held -- the manipulation genuinely moved the gate (effective_threshold 0.3761 -> 0.2570, a 32% reduction) with injection fidelity 5.6e-17 and randomisation corr(assigned_urgency, hazard_prox) = 0.0177, so this is 'no effect', not 'no treatment'. ELIMINATED at the harm_weighted incumbent identity only; MECH-463's CHANNEL-AGNOSTICISM half remains untested (second regime dropped with recorded evidence).

hypotheses.label: Arousal amplifies total variance but broadens it toward subordinate channels
hypotheses.desc: Total cross-candidate variance rises with urgency while the incumbent's SHARE falls, because subordinate channels' absolute variance grows faster. Mechanism candidate: the commit threshold is an ADMISSION threshold, so shrinking it admits lower-separation ticks.
hypotheses.basis: Newly opened by V3-EXQ-785's GREEN arm: total variance 14.1x, incumbent absolute 12.1x, non-incumbent absolute 79.2x. Currently the best-fitting account but confounded with hazard proximity.

resolution.basis: Both halves fail under exogenous urgency. Total cross-candidate variance does not rise: var_total fold 0.970 (i.e. 1.0x) vs 785's endogenous 14.1x, rho -0.086 vs a +0.6 threshold, per-seed log10 deltas straddling zero [+0.0011,-0.0125,-0.0270,+0.0021,-0.0257]; tick-level corr(assigned_urgency, log10 var_total) = -0.005. And the incumbent share does not fall (see H-arousal-concentrates). Its proposed mechanism -- 'the commit threshold is an ADMISSION threshold, so shrinking it admits lower-separation ticks' -- is separately ruled out: C3 measured commit rate flat at ~0.99-1.00 across all six levels (span 0.0099, rho -0.086) despite the 32% threshold movement. The mechanism was also mis-signed at pre-registration: committed = variance < commit_threshold*(1-urgency) is an UPPER bound, so raising urgency makes admission STRICTER, not less selective; and the gated quantity is the z_world running variance (world-model stability), not candidate separation, since use_harm_variance_commit is off.

hypotheses.label: The profile is hazard geometry, not arousal
hypotheses.desc: High-urgency ticks are near-hazard ticks whose candidate geometry differs for reasons unrelated to the arousal scalar; both the variance rise and the share redistribution are artifacts of conditioning on an endogenous variable.
hypotheses.basis: Leading rival. Not addressable from V3-EXQ-785 because urgency was endogenous and the per-tick sink (which would carry a proximity covariate) is absent from disk.

resolution.basis: ELIMINATED under EXOGENOUS manipulation of hazard proximity with a within-seed load-bearing statistic at S=24. The manipulation was delivered: corr(assigned level, realized hazard_prox_center) = 0.988, realized centers matching the pre-registered grid to 6 decimals across a 3x proximity range (0.222 -> 0.667), pin_miss_frac 0.006 mean / 0.067 max -- so this is 'no effect', not 'no treatment'. Neither half of the 785 profile moves. C1 amplification: mean within-seed slope on log10 var_total -0.000944 (sd 0.005087, t=-0.909, df=23, t_crit 2.069, n.s.), 0.33% of the 785 reference slope 0.28725 and below the 0.0287 absolute floor. C2 redistribution: mean slope on incumbent share +0.000131 (sd 0.002446, t=0.262, n.s.), 0.38% of the 785 reference -0.03475 and below the 0.0035 floor; the sign is POSITIVE where the hypothesis predicts negative. All three arms gate GREEN, criteria_non_degenerate true on all three, incumbent harm_weighted at margin 0.906 with 2 non-trivial components (the >=2 gate 785 structurally failed). The null is NOT attributable to an inexpressive channel: the A3 expressivity positive control PASSED, moving the SAME statistic (log10 var_total) by a mean per-seed span of 1.347 decades with per-seed monotone fraction 1.0 (rho=1.0 on all 8 seeds) -- a larger excursion than the 785 reference effect it was invoked to explain (log10_var_fold 1.149). The channel could have shown the effect and did not. The 785a under-differentiation caveat is also materially weakened: z_world participation ratio measures 4.30-4.38 here, against the ~1.06 the 785a adjudication assumed. The decoys confirm the 785a reading was a small-n artifact and route nothing. D1 pooled tick-level correlations collapse to r=+0.004 (share) and -0.012 (log10 var) on 5592 rows, against 785a's -0.187 / +0.171. D3 between_fraction is 0.490 (share) and 0.711 (log10 var), not the near-1.0 Simpson signature. D4 replicates=false: only seed 0 lands within 0.02 of 785a's seed-0 mean share of 0.833 (0.8268 here -- the same RNG seed, so trivially the same trajectory), and at S=24 it is the low tail of a smooth distribution (mean 0.954, sd 0.055, z=-2.33), not a distinguished anomaly. 785a's seed-0 leverage was Simpson's paradox on n=5, as that adjudication suspected. Independently, the hypothesis's own PREMISE fails at the first stage: in the urgency-free arm corr(assigned proximity, realized urgency) = +0.164, below the 0.2 threshold, so premise_holds=false. 'High-urgency ticks are near-hazard ticks' is false in this substrate -- whatever endogenous urgency tracked in 785, it was not proximity. SCOPE: the harm_weighted incumbent identity only, and the SD-011 commit-threshold route only (use_harm_variance_commit OFF, so the gated quantity is the z_world running variance, not candidate separation). Channel-agnosticism is NOT covered here -- that is V3-EXQ-785b, a separate workstream.

hypotheses.label: Arousal's variance effect is channel-agnostic: the amplification/concentration profile appears at ANY incumbent identity, not only harm_weighted
hypotheses.desc: MECH-463 asserts the mechanism is a property of global scalar arousal, so it must not be specific to the harm_weighted incumbent. Tests the profile at a second and third incumbent identity (residue_weighted, f) under exogenous urgency.
hypotheses.basis: Named as the untested channel-AGNOSTIC half of MECH-463 by the V3-EXQ-785 autopsy, which recorded it as a separate workstream rather than shipping a regime that could not pass its own gate.

resolution.basis: ELIMINATED at two further incumbent identities. Under exogenous urgency at residue_weighted (and f), var_total fold 1.078 with rho +0.486 against a pre-registered +0.6, and incumbent share rho -0.143 -- neither half of the 785 profile appears. The run is not underpowered or vacuous: per_arm_gate.all_green with 8/8 preconditions met on BOTH arms, 3 non-trivial components per arm, 1757 committed ticks over 6 populated urgency levels, exogenous assignment fidelity 5.55e-17, incumbent identity as pre-registered at 0.582/0.794 against a 0.1 floor, non_degenerate true on all three criteria. Independently immune to the hazard-geometry rival: randomisation_orthogonal_to_hazard_proximity 0.066 against a 0.25 ceiling. So arousal's causal inertness on committed-selection variance geometry is channel-agnostic, closing the half the 785 autopsy recorded as open.

synthesis.surviving_label: none -- 4/4 registered hypotheses eliminated. Arousal is causally inert on committed-selection variance geometry, channel-agnostically (785a harm_weighted, 785b residue_weighted + f), and the leading rival (hazard geometry) is separately eliminated with a passing expressivity control (787). What endogenous urgency was tracking in V3-EXQ-785 is OPEN with no pre-registered candidate remaining.
synthesis.text: Global scalar arousal is causally INERT on committed-selection variance geometry on the SD-011 commit-threshold route, at every incumbent identity tested (harm_weighted, residue_weighted, f), and the leading rival explanation -- that the V3-EXQ-785 profile was hazard geometry rather than arousal -- is eliminated under exogenous manipulation with a passing expressivity positive control. The endogenous 14.1x amplification measured in V3-EXQ-785 is real and unexplained. Because the frozen rival set is exhausted while the phenomenon persists, this is a mystery (known data) node: the frame is wrong, and further probes on the arousal/selection axis will not settle it. Routed to /claim-synthesis -- MECH-463 fuses an amplification premise with a concentration premise that V3-EXQ-785 showed dissociate (total up 14.1x while incumbent share fell, rho -0.83).

decision.decision_question: Is global scalar arousal an ENTRENCHMENT mechanism (concentrating variance on the dominant channel, as MECH-463 asserts and as the conversion-ceiling argument invokes) or a DIVERSITY lever (broadening the variance base)?
decision.distance_phrase: decided for the harm_weighted incumbent on the commit-threshold route AND channel-agnostically (residue_weighted, f); rival set exhausted 4/4; the endogenous 14.1x profile is unexplained with no pre-registered candidate remaining
decision.observation_bottleneck: Resolved for this question. V3-EXQ-785b closed the channel-agnosticism half at two further incumbent identities with 8/8 preconditions green on both arms, which the prior entry recorded as blocked on 'no viable second incumbent identity on the entropy axis'. No observation bottleneck remains; the residual is a framing problem routed to /claim-synthesis.

hypotheses.desc: the per-candidate novelty bonus, sourced from e2_world_forward candidate rollouts, produces cross-candidate score variation large enough to move the E3 argmin

resolution.basis: Load-bearing C1 (c1_parent_delta_on_vs_off = 0.402505 vs margin 0.03) with the ARM_OFF negative control passing and c1_non_degenerate true; 3/3 seeds move the same direction. Novelty carries the ENTIRE parent effect: ARM_NOVELTY_OFF collapses exactly onto ARM_OFF on every trajectory quantity, so ablating novelty is behaviourally identical to ablating all structured curiosity. Confirmed, not eliminated, so met_elimination_bar is false. Robust to the D3 intra-run substrate divergence: C1's seed-42 comparison is fully substrate-matched (ARM_OFF/42 and ARM_ALL_ON/42 both on f80bc236) with the largest delta of the three seeds (0.732).

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-604c could NOT discriminate this leg. Stays ALIVE: an uninformative run narrows nothing. non_degenerate=False records that this leg's criterion was structurally degenerate even though the run's own criteria_non_degenerate flag (scoped to C0/C1/C2-overall) read true.

A uniform additive constant cannot change an argmax or a softmax sample, so the observed c2 delta of EXACTLY 0.0 is an ARITHMETIC IDENTITY fixed before the run, independent of this hypothesis's truth. synthesis.text: One of three legs is CONFIRMED (novelty, per-candidate). The other two are not open questions in the ordinary sense: as Phase-1 broadcast scalars they are argmax-invariant BY CONSTRUCTION, so no selection-level DV can discriminate them and no number of seeds or letters can help. This is an OBSERVATION BOTTLENECK, not evidential equipoise. The re-derive brake fired (3rd substrate_ceiling adjudication for MECH-314b/314c/Q-044) and a further same-claim ablation is refused; the two legs become adjudicable only after the substrate gives uncertainty and LP the per-candidate treatment MECH-314a already received (recommended_substrate_queue_entry amend on ARC-065).

decision.observation_bottleneck: MECH-314b/314c are Phase-1 broadcast scalars (one constant across all K candidates). A uniform additive constant is invariant under both argmax and softmax, so EVERY selection-level readout returns an exact structural zero regardless of the claims' truth. Any future leg on this question must either (a) test against a DV the manipulation can actually move, or (b) wait for the per-candidate implementation. Note the trap this run walked into: the 604c readiness gate r2 used curiosity_bias_range, which is precisely the statistic in which a broadcast constant CANCELS -- so the gate certified readiness for the novelty channel alone while appearing to certify the whole experiment.
