questions.title: Does V_s-drop-triggered (R1) policy decomposition reduce execution-time forward-prediction failure, and is it dissociable from the R5 bottleneck trigger?

fanout_growth_events.note: GOV-FANOUT-1: three consecutive environment-axis attempts (816, 816b, 816d) converged within noise of each other (~0.0086-0.0087), independently confirmed by 830's 'slow never fires' finding. Fanning out to representation and algorithm axes rather than a fourth environment escalation.

hypotheses.label: R1 (V_s-drop) decomposition reduces low-V_s execution-time forward-PE
hypotheses.desc: turning on the V_s-drop-triggered decomposition operator withholds/replaces committed chunks in low-V_s regions and reduces execution-time forward-prediction error vs the OFF baseline

resolution.basis: 816 ran with 0 low-V_s steps (worst ARM_1 cell, threshold 5): the discrimination-enabling precondition vs_heterogeneity_low_vs_steps_present was unmet, so C_MAIN was never evaluable (n_paired_seeds=0). Positive controls passed (OFF forward-PE varies+bounded; decomp fired frac 1.0) but the R1 trigger never fired -- an uninformative starved run that narrows NOTHING. It surfaces an OBSERVATION BOTTLENECK (Dimension 4); the hypothesis stays alive. V3-EXQ-830 (2026-07-27, independent scale-heterogeneity diagnostic) confirms the identical observation bottleneck from a different angle: the 'slow' pathway fired zero times in 2393 sweeps across both arms, and ON/OFF arms produced bit-identical behaviour. Two independent probes now converge on the same environment-uncertainty ceiling (per failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json). Still non-eliminating; hypothesis stays alive.

hypotheses.label: R1 (V_s-boundary) and R5 (bottleneck) decompose at dissociable loci
hypotheses.desc: the R5 bottleneck trigger decomposes at high-V_s graph-structural funnel states where the R1 V_s-drop trigger is silent, so the two triggers are behaviourally dissociable

resolution.basis: 820's R5 arm fired abundantly (1524 fires, 484 events) but R1 never fired in either arm (arm1/arm2_vs_trigger_total=0), so dissociation_high_vs_frac=0.0 -- there is no R1 side to dissociate R5 FROM. Same unmet precondition as 816 (lowvs_worst_arm1=0). Uninformative; hypothesis stays alive.

hypotheses.label: the env under-drives persistent prediction uncertainty by measure time
hypotheses.desc: the default env (8x8, 3 hazards, env_drift_interval default, 40 warmup) is fully learned by the measure window (forward-PE ~0.005), so no low-V_s regions arise; a harsher/non-stationary env produces both forward-PE heterogeneity and low-V_s regions

resolution.basis: RATIFIED DISPOSITION 2026-08-16 (governance cycle, GFLAG-0038; recommended by govdiag1_repose_mech321_chain_2026-08-12.md section 7(ii)): this leg is SUPERSEDED / MOOT -- no longer load-bearing for this question whatever its truth value. Reason: section 7(i)'s companion leg H-vs-proxy-saturation is now CONFIRMED (V3-EXQ-816c: region-V_s saturated at 0.9338 and decoupled from forward-PE, spearman 0.083 against a 0.2 coupled floor), so raising forward-PE CANNOT lower region-V_s and even a successful future harshening would not restore the V_s readout this leg exists to rescue. STATE DELIBERATELY LEFT `alive`, AND THIS IS A SCHEMA-VOCABULARY LIMIT, NOT A SCIENTIFIC HEDGE. The registry's derived state vocabulary has exactly three buckets -- ALIVE_STATES {alive, untested}, RESOLVED_OUT_STATES {eliminated, split}, and `confirmed` (build_hypothesis_space.py) -- and has no `superseded` member; writing the ratified word as a literal state would be silently uncounted by build_hypothesis_space.py's surviving/resolved_out/confirmed arithmetic and would stop this question's `environment` axis family ever being marked closed. The only in-vocabulary out-state, `eliminated`, requires met_elimination_bar true, and section 7(ii) EXPLICITLY declines to recommend it: 816b's and 816d's own pre-registered elimination branch was 'forward-PE elevated but V_s flat', and neither run took it -- both recorded pe_elevated false (off_pe_mean_worst 0.008594 and 0.008675 against the 0.01 discrimination floor), so on the LITERAL pre-registered null the runs read 'dose insufficient, direction correct'. Section 7(ii) surfaces the stronger reading (V_s did not move a little, it did not move at all -- low_vs_produced false and lowvs_worst_arm1 0 at every dose -- while PE did move) as available and defensible but as stretching a pre-registered floor after the fact, and therefore recommends `superseded` over `eliminated`. Asserting met_elimination_bar true here would be the over-counting Goodhart direction GOV-FROZEN-1 exists to prevent, so this leg keeps the conservative under-count that /governance Step 5c explicitly blesses ('an unresolved leg simply keeps surviving in the count until Step 9b resolves it -- a conservative under-count, not a Goodhart move'). READ THIS LEG AS MOOT, NOT AS OPEN: it must not be re-queued for a fourth environment-axis dose escalation. The residual -- add a `superseded` state to the registry vocabulary and both derive scripts, or ratify `eliminated` -- is raised for governance as its own flag and as the decision chip chip-20260818-hypothesis-registry-superseded-state. V3-EXQ-816b (env_drift_interval->3, world_rule_shift interval=24/depth=1): forward-PE rose 0.005->0.0086, short of the 0.01 discrimination floor, so zero low-V_s steps were produced. Informative-but-non-eliminating: direction correct, dose insufficient. Does not meet the elimination bar (met_elimination_bar requires an adjudicated eliminating direction); hypothesis stays alive pending a stronger-dose retest per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-816b_2026-07-26.json. THIRD dose escalation (V3-EXQ-816d, harshened_env_v2, 2026-07-26): off_pe_mean_worst=0.00867, within 0.0007 of 816b's 0.0086 -- diminishing returns confirm this axis is likely saturated. Still non-eliminating (met_elimination_bar stays false); see the new fanout legs below rather than a fourth same-axis escalation (per failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json).

resolution.basis: CONFIRMED 2026-08-18 (Mode B, lightweight /failure-autopsy per /governance Step 5c; disposition ratified by the 2026-08-16 governance cycle as GFLAG-0038, recommended by govdiag1_repose_mech321_chain_2026-08-12.md section 7(i)). questions.title: Does the MECH-090 commit latch actually hold an injected ARC-071 chunk atomically for more than one tick, or does the experiment's own readout misreport a persisting commitment as resetting every step?
questions.short_title: ARC-071 commit-latch persistence: wiring vs readout

hypotheses.label: H1: commit-latch wiring defect
hypotheses.desc: The step-index advance / re-deliberation suppression in select_action does not hold across ticks under train_mode=False + use_chunk_proposal_injection=True + a continued StepHarness run; a genuinely new commitment is issued every tick.

resolution.basis: Direct instrumentation (seeds 101/505, A_HIER_S2, forced guaranteed-selectable 3-step chunk + forced commit) shows agent._committed_step_idx never advances past 1 across 80 ticks / 8-10 E3 re-deliberation cycles per seed, and a BRAND NEW trajectory object (distinct id()) is installed on every single E3 tick despite the identical candidate being re-selected -- confirming the commit-latch does not hold across ticks in this configuration. Root cause: agent.py's between-E3-tick stepping branch never falls back to e3._persistent_committed_trajectory (unlike the MECH-321 hook), so the step-index-advance increment is never reached; compounded by no re-selection short-circuit on E3 ticks. control_passed: true (the forced-commit / guaranteed-candidate manipulation check unambiguously isolates the mechanism); non_degenerate: true (160 real ticks exercised, 18 real E3 re-deliberation cycles observed). met_elimination_bar left false -- this maps to 'supports', not an elimination target; see evidence/planning/diagnostic_arc071_commit_latch_h1h2_probe_2026-07-31.md for the full trace.

hypotheses.label: H2: experiment readout artifact
hypotheses.desc: The internal commitment state persists correctly across ticks, but _committed_chunk_state()/_segment_commitments()'s read path does not correctly observe it, producing an artefactual reset-every-tick reading.

resolution.basis: _committed_chunk_state() (the experiment's own read function) was directly compared against ground-truth attribute reads (e3._committed_trajectory, e3._persistent_committed_trajectory, agent._committed_step_idx read independently, outside the read path) at every one of 160 ticks across seeds 101/505 -- 0 genuine mismatches. The readout faithfully reports the real, broken substrate state; there is no genuinely-persisting commitment for it to misreport. H2 is refuted.

synthesis.surviving_label: H1 confirmed (ree_core commit-latch wiring gap); H2 refuted (readout is faithful)
synthesis.text: H1 (ree_core wiring defect) CONFIRMED via direct instrumentation; H2 (readout artifact) REFUTED (0/160 mismatches between the experiment's read function and ground-truth attribute reads). Root cause: agent.py's between-E3-tick stepping branch never consults the SD-084 persistent trajectory handle (unlike the MECH-321 hook, which already does), so _committed_step_idx never advances past its first post-commit value; compounded by E3 unconditionally re-deliberating and re-committing a fresh trajectory object on every E3 tick with no already-committed short-circuit. Fix is two-part (agent.py fallback + arc071_chunking.py baseline flag) plus one open, undiagnosed question (should E3 skip re-selection when already committed) -- routed to /implement-substrate (substrate_queue.json arc071_chunk_commit_latch_persistence, diagnosis_correction field) rather than applied this session, because ree_core/agent.py was under an active claim by a concurrent session's merge at diagnosis time.

decision.decision_question: Is the ARC-071 chunk-injection commit-latch persistence pathway a genuine ree_core defect (route implement-substrate) or an experiment-script measurement defect (route queue-experiment redesign of the readout only)?
decision.live_gate: requires the H1/H2 discriminating probe (fanout_recommendation.suggested_probes) to run
decision.distance_phrase: DECIDED: H1 confirmed, H2 refuted. Distance to CLOSED is now implementation (agent.py fallback + arc071_chunking.py flag), not further discrimination.

hypotheses.basis: Full-loop rv reduction from baseline is ~half the repair smoke's demonstrated reduction at the identical error scale; F1 recalibration is the one substrate component present in the full loop and absent from the smoke.

resolution.basis: F1-disabled INFL-only re-run at 794a's asymmetry levels (V3-EXQ-850): dose_levels_separated precondition FAILED (LO vs HI rv differ by only 3.21e-05, below the 1e-04 floor -- same saturation signature 794a itself showed), so C1/C2's quantitative gap-closure criteria cannot be trusted as a clean confirmation/elimination of H1. Recommend a requeue that separates the dose-level-differentiation question (orthogonal, inherited from 794a's design) from the F1-on/off between-run comparison H1 actually needs. See failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-850_2026-08-01.

hypotheses.label: Training budget too short for full drift accumulation
hypotheses.desc: N_TRAIN_EPS=30, K=1 single-fire sleep may be too short for the asymmetric EMA to accumulate as much drift as the smoke's own update sequence reached.
hypotheses.basis: Same full-loop-vs-smoke magnitude gap as H1; exposure duration is the other structural difference between the isolated smoke and the full behavioural run.

resolution.basis: STRENGTHENED 2026-08-01 by V3-EXQ-860, a confound-corrected redesign of the V3-EXQ-853 probe: holds N_TRAIN_EPS fixed at 794a's original 30 (F1/REM recalibration firing count UNCHANGED from 794a, decoupling H1's axis) and instead raises STEPS_PER_EP 200->1000 (5x), reaching the SAME total exposure (30000 waking steps) as 853's own 5x N_TRAIN_EPS change via a single clean axis. RESULT: closure toward the smoke's target collapsed from 853's confounded 12-22% down to 2.5-2.9% once F1-firing count was held fixed. Since the only design difference between 853 and 860 is which axis absorbed the 5x exposure increase (episode count, which also multiplies F1 firings, vs episode length, which does not), this is a clean controlled comparison directly implicating F1-firing count (H1's axis), not raw exposure duration (H2's axis), as the driver of 853's partial signal. H2 is therefore weakened more strongly and more cleanly than by 853 alone. 860 ALSO failed inflation_lowers_rv, but WRONG-SIGNED (negative in both arms, vs 850/853's small-positive-but-sub-threshold readings) -- a separate, new, undiagnosed puzzle (see failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-860_2026-08-01) that does not undermine the closure-fraction finding above, since that comparison does not depend on this precondition's sign. state stays alive per GOV-FROZEN-1's elimination bar (non_degenerate=false), but H2 is now the most clearly weakened of the three hypotheses. User-confirmed 2026-08-01: recommend /governance mark V3-EXQ-853's own evidence_direction as superseded by this cleaner result.

hypotheses.label: Asymmetric-EMA is the wrong drift-source mechanism
hypotheses.desc: The driver's own pre-registered fallback: if C1 fails at both LO and HI, a structurally different SD-076 mechanism (not asymmetric EMA) is owed.
hypotheses.basis: Pre-registered in the driver docstring (v3_exq_794a_mech204_phase7_sd076_calibration_loop_2x2.py lines 108-111) as the intended read of a both-levels C1 failure. WEAKENED (not eliminated) by the smoke-comparison finding in this autopsy: the same mechanism form reaches the target regime in isolation at this scale, arguing against a pure mechanism-form defect -- but not ruled out until H1/H2 are checked.

resolution.basis: Literature synthesis (not an experimental run), commissioned by 794a's own fanout_recommendation: /lit-pull on expected magnitude/timescale of waking metacognitive overconfidence drift under sleep deprivation/fatigue (ree-v3/REE_assembly commit e84240108d, targeted_review_sd_076 + targeted_review_connectome_mech_204, 5 entries). Net read: the best-controlled human calibration literature (Baranski 1994/2007) finds NO significant waking confidence-calibration drift under acute deprivation, and Boardman 2024 shows the acute regime is specifically where drift is LEAST likely (chronic restriction is where it appears) -- both nudge AWAY from H3 (wrong mechanism form) and TOWARD H2, without eliminating H3. Jones et al 2006 (comparative overconfidence emerges ~19h into wakefulness) offers partial counter-support for a real drift phenomenon existing at all, with a construct-mismatch caveat. van der Helm et al 2011 supports MECH-204's general REM-active-recalibration architecture (noradrenergic, not serotonergic -- an honest caveat). Net: H3 weakened, not eliminated; independent of and consistent with 794a's own smoke-comparison finding. NOTE: the V3-EXQ-850 (H1) autopsy's registration_note/decision text (generated 2026-08-01T10:37:54Z) states this lit-pull was 'not yet started' -- that was already stale at the time it was written (the lit-pull landed 2026-08-01T00:07:47Z, ~10.5h earlier); this resolution corrects the record.

decision.decision_question: Which of H1 (F1-interaction damping), H2 (insufficient training exposure), or H3 (wrong mechanism form) explains why V3-EXQ-794a's full behavioural loop reached only about half the rv reduction the SD-076 headroom repair's own validation smoke demonstrated is achievable at this error scale -- and does the answer support retain_ree, hybridize, or retire_ree_claim for SD-076 under EVB-0454?
decision.live_gate: H1 partially probed 2026-08-01 (V3-EXQ-850): alive, partial signal, not confirmed/eliminated. H2 probed twice 2026-08-01 (V3-EXQ-853, then confound-corrected V3-EXQ-860): alive but now MORE STRONGLY weakened -- the decoupled comparison collapsed 853's 12-22% closure to 2.5-2.9%, cleanly implicating H1's axis (F1-firing count) rather than H2's (exposure duration) as the driver of 853's original partial signal. H3 resolved via lit-pull 2026-08-01 (e84240108d): alive, weakened by the best-controlled human calibration literature, not eliminated. H1 is now the best-supported of the three by process of elimination, though still not formally confirmed.
decision.distance_phrase: H2 is now clearly the weakest-supported hypothesis after a clean controlled comparison; H1 remains the most likely explanation by elimination but still lacks its own confirming evidence beyond the original partial signal; a separate small diagnostic on V3-EXQ-860's wrong-signed inflation_lowers_rv puzzle is chipped but not expected to resolve before the 2026-08-03T20:50:36Z deadline.

questions.title: Is MECH-135/INV-088's near-total evaluator-degeneracy (V3-EXQ-108a) caused by inadequate bespoke-loss training or a genuine world_dim=32 discriminative-granularity ceiling?

fanout_growth_events.note: Sub-mechanism discrimination WITHIN the confirmed H-dynamics-collapse leg, enumerated verbatim (with the exact decision rule and re-scope branch) by the git-witnessed lit-pull SYNTHESIS on 2026-08-03, 26 days before the adjudicating run. The ELIMINATED child (H-horizon-compounding) is the parent's own recorded basis mechanism ('compounding error') -- this growth corrects the confirmed leg's basis wording without withdrawing the leg (the training-signal-family confirmation stands).

discovery_growth_events.rationale: H-dynamics-collapse draws on an independent, established mechanism -- the classic model-based-RL compounding-error/mode-collapse failure mode, where a dynamics model trained only on single-step transitions is rolled out autoregressively far beyond its training horizon and converges toward a training-distribution-average attractor -- not intuition applied after the fact. It was genuinely unconsidered before 108b ran: the two hypotheses pre-registered on 2026-08-02 (H-undertrained-instrument, H-dimension-ceiling) both concerned z_world's REPRESENTATION (bespoke-loss adequacy, dimension=32 capacity); neither anticipated a DYNAMICS-training-objective explanation. 108b's own instrumentation is what surfaces it: separately measuring the antecedent (CR_real, healthy at 0.19-0.20) from the coupling-leg (CR_rollout, collapsed to ~3e-6 of CR_real) is what let the run's own decision tree eliminate both pre-registered rivals (branch 1 and branch 2) and land on branch 3 (downstream_dynamics_collapse) -- a mechanism the pre-registration could not have named because the CR_real/CR_rollout dissociation that reveals it did not exist as a finding until this run produced it. Re-filed from fanout_growth_events (2026-08-03T12:15:04Z integrity audit, bucket (b)): that path requires pre-registration to precede its adjudicating run, evidenced by a commit that pre-dates the run's resolution -- but failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-108b_2026-08-03.json (the only artifact naming this hypothesis) was committed 2026-08-03T09:47:09+01:00 (ree-v3 commit 9c48f834231ca20f3476112ad151808e1352986e), AFTER the run's resolved_utc of 2026-08-02T12:16:43Z -- unwitnessed by construction, since the hypothesis was discovered BY that run's own analysis, not anticipated before it. Discovery growth is the honest path: pre_registered_utc is set to the same instant as resolved_utc (2026-08-02T12:16:43Z) because that is genuinely when the hypothesis was learned to exist, not a claim of prior knowledge.

hypotheses.label: undertrained instrument (a1)
hypotheses.desc: 108a's bespoke single-step E1 MSE loss (100 episodes) is inadequate to differentiate z_world; a properly-trained z_world (the sanctioned sd_zworld_warmup_optimizer_group route, already confirmed adequately-trained by V3-EXQ-819/819a) would show materially higher e1coe_score_var, clearing C3 (>=0.002).

resolution.basis: 108b used the SANCTIONED sd_zworld_warmup_optimizer_group training route (encoder_trained precondition met, world_encoder_max_abs_delta 0.22-0.24, holdout balanced accuracy 0.80-0.94) and C3 STILL failed (e1coe_score_var ~2.25e-14 vs 0.002 threshold) -- directly refutes 'the bespoke loss just wasn't adequate training'.

hypotheses.label: genuine dim=32 discriminative-granularity ceiling (a2)
hypotheses.desc: Even with the sanctioned-trained z_world (the SAME stack V3-EXQ-819/819a confirmed reaches only AUC 0.90 vs a ~48-57 achievable ceiling), e1coe_score_var stays near-degenerate -- world_dim=32 structurally cannot support enough discriminative capacity for 40 distinct 30-step rollouts to diverge in goal-proximity.

resolution.basis: CR_real (antecedent contrast ratio on 40 real diverse z_world observations, same sanctioned-trained encoder) measured 0.19-0.20, far above the CR_REAL_FLOOR=1e-4 degeneracy floor in both seeds -- world_dim=32 clearly CAN support real-state differentiation, directly refuting 'dimension=32 is a structural ceiling'.

hypotheses.label: E1 forward-rollout dynamics collapse (new, third mechanism)
hypotheses.desc: Neither pre-registered hypothesis: the sanctioned-trained z_world encoder differentiates REAL states fine (CR_real ~0.19-0.20, healthy), but E1's forward-rollout DYNAMICS collapse distinct 30-step imagined action-sequence endpoints toward near-identical predictions (CR_rollout/CR_real ~2.6e-6 to 3.2e-6, code-verified against the CR_ROLLOUT_COLLAPSE_RATIO=0.1 threshold). Root cause traced in code: agent.e1 is trained ONLY via single-step MSE loss (_train_agent, 100 episodes, horizon=1) yet applied autoregressively 30 times at eval (_score_sequence_e1coe_with_endpoint) -- a single-step-trained dynamics model rolled out far beyond its training horizon, the classic model-based-RL compounding-error/mode-collapse failure. Independent of z_world's own representational capacity (INV-088's literal framing) -- the bottleneck is E1's training OBJECTIVE (learning-signal), not the representation.

resolution.basis: Both antecedent checks (encoder_trained, real_zworld_nondegenerate) passed and both alternative hypotheses were eliminated by the same run's own decision tree (branch 3 hit exactly, code-verified in v3_exq_108b_mech135_inv088_zworld_disambiguation.py lines 846-853); confirmed in both seeds (cr_ratio 2.57e-6 / 3.18e-6).

questions.title: Does MECH-267's mode-conditioned hippocampal proposal content survive HippocampalModule's CEM elite-refit at production settings, and if not, which locus (iteration count, scoring criterion, or pool architecture) is responsible?
questions.short_title: MECH-267 content persistence vs CEM refit

hypotheses.label: noise-scale-only modulation preserves content
hypotheses.desc: CEM proposal noise-scale, scaled by operating_mode alone (without horizon-depth), preserves mode-conditioned content through production elite-refit (iters=3)

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-869 (30 seeds): C0 manipulation check passed cleanly (gaps 0.031-0.092 vs 0.015 floor); C1 production (iters=3) failed flat (gaps -0.0003 to +0.0035 vs 0.01 floor). Confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-869_2026-08-02: competence_implementation_gap, non_contributory -- noise-scale-only insufficient to survive production elite-refit.

hypotheses.label: noise-scale + horizon-depth (both mechanisms) preserve content at iters=3
hypotheses.desc: Adding horizon-depth modulation (CEM elite-selection scoring-window depth) alongside noise-scale preserves mode-conditioned content through production elite-refit

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-869a (30 seeds, both mechanisms confirmed active via mechanism_activation check): C0 passed cleanly (gaps 0.031-0.092 vs 0.015 floor, unchanged from 869); C1 production (iters=3) failed flat (gaps +0.0008 to +0.0024, -0.0037 vs 0.01 floor) -- nearly identical to 869's own C1 numbers despite the new mechanism genuinely firing. Confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-869a_2026-08-03: competence_implementation_gap (user-confirmed, not upgraded to substrate_ceiling), non_contributory. Routed to a GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio rather than a third same-question letter.

hypotheses.label: wash-out is iteration-count dependent
hypotheses.desc: The content-persistence wash-out depends on num_cem_iterations itself; a lower iteration count (e.g. 2) would preserve mode-conditioned content that iters=3 erases

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-923 (30 seeds, both mechanisms confirmed active): C0 manipulation check passed cleanly (gaps 0.031-0.092 vs 0.015 floor); C_H1 at iters=2 failed flat (gaps -0.0028/0.0023/~0.000006 vs 0.01 floor), same order of magnitude as iters=3's reading. Confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-923_2026-08-12: standard/non_contributory -- content wash-out is not iteration-count dependent.

hypotheses.label: elite-selection value function needs an explicit mode-dependent term
hypotheses.desc: Windowing an already mode-independent score (horizon-depth's actual mechanism) is insufficient; the CEM elite-selection value function itself must carry an explicit mode-dependent term to survive refit

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-928 (4 arms x 30 shared seeds, production num_cem_iterations=3) built this leg as the mode_value_weight facet: a per-trajectory mode-dependent term subtracted from the CEM elite-selection score, so the ranking stays mode-differentiated on every refit iteration. The facet ENGAGED on all 480/480 cells (manipulation check) and produced nothing: H2 arm mean broad-minus-tight gap -0.00162 (sub-floor, floor 0.01), and the paired same-seed contrast H2 - OFF = +0.00147, t=+0.48, 14/30 seeds positive -- a clean null. Discriminating non_contributory: sub-floor against a PASSING reference band in the same run (H3 +0.01363 / BOTH +0.01112, H3-OFF t=+4.34) with the OFF negative control washed out as predicted (-0.00309). An explicit mode-dependent term in the elite-selection value function is NOT the locus. Confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_927-928-mech267-cluster_2026-08-16.

hypotheses.label: mode-independence is structural to shared elite-refit
hypotheses.desc: Cross-mode elite mixing during refit is itself the wash-out mechanism; hard-partitioning candidate pools per mode (no shared elite set) would preserve differentiation

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-928 (4 arms x 30 shared seeds, production num_cem_iterations=3) confirms the LOCUS this leg names: the shared elite-refit is what discards mode-conditioned proposal breadth. The mode_partitioned_cem facet rescues the broad-minus-tight raw_std gap at production settings -- arm mean +0.01363, and decisively on the paired same-seed contrast H3 - OFF = +0.01672, t=+4.34, 24/30 seeds positive (BOTH - OFF = +0.01420, t=+4.02), with the OFF control washed out (-0.00309) and the manipulation confirmed on 480/480 cells. TWO reasons met_elimination_bar is false. (1) Restoration is PARTIAL: only the extreme-pair contrast is rescued; per_arm_all_adjacent_gaps_clear_floor is false in ALL four arms, H3's adjacent gaps being +0.00729 / +0.00750 / -0.00116 -- first two directionally right but sub-floor, third INVERTED -- so the predicted monotone four-mode gradient is not restored. (2) The intervention tested is WEAKER than this leg's literal text: mode_partitioned_cem does NOT hard-partition candidate pools (no separate elite sets); it keeps the shared elite set and re-applies the mode-conditioned noise scale to the freshly-refit ao_std once per CEM iteration. So the refit-breadth locus is confirmed, but 'cross-mode elite MIXING per se is the mechanism' remains untested. Separately, the run's own acceptance gate is under-powered (per-seed SD 0.011-0.018 exceeds the 0.01 floor; t vs floor is only +1.09 for H3 and +0.36 for BOTH) -- the confirmation rests on the paired vs-control contrast, not on the floor-clearing. Confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_927-928-mech267-cluster_2026-08-16.

questions.title: Does harm-aware selection at mid-execution policy decomposition reduce task-level harm outcome, and can a screened matched-abort-pair design actually test it?

hypotheses.label: harm-aware mid-execution leaf selection reduces realised task harm relative to harm-blind selection
hypotheses.desc: When a divergence-eligible decomposition fires in both the harm-aware (ON) and harm-blind (OFF) arms on a matched seed, the ON arm's post-divergence harm signal is less negative than OFF's by >=1SE over >=6 paired seeds.

resolution.basis: Four generations, each fixing the defect the last one surfaced, none yet a decisive test. 844: mechanistic PE-reduction supported (C2) but harm-outcome (C1) weakens -- competence_implementation_gap. 867: harm bias never engaged (no SD-029 hazard tuning) -- environment_adequacy_defect, mechanism untestable. 867a: hazard tuning added, bias engages, but the power guard was vacuous (min(6, n_observed)) and only n=2 matched pairs -- measurement_test_design_defect. 867b: hard floor (n>=6) + a 48-candidate in-process screen -- still only 4 matched pairs, pool EXHAUSTED. NEW finding this cycle: screen_soundness_check shows monotonicity_violations on 5 of 7 screen-matched seeds (held=false) -- most seeds that screen-match at a short probe do NOT hold at full measurement schedule. This is not simply 'screen a bigger pool' -- the screen-then-match design family is invalid. CORRECTED 2026-08-09 (governance GFLAG-0014/0015 adjudication; text synced into this field from live_gate per /failure-autopsy Step 9b): the ORIGINAL reading of that violation -- 'the ON-arm manipulation itself perturbs whether/when mid-execution decomposition fires' -- is WRONG and is withdrawn. 867b's own manifest contradicts it: the violation appears in the OFF arm, where the manipulation is provably inert (decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero == 0 on every OFF cell); OFF-arm multi_action_commits DECREASED from the 4-episode screen to the 12-episode measurement on 5 seeds, impossible for a monotone counter over a prefix extension; and at full schedule the matching held PERFECTLY (on_only and off_only tiers both EMPTY, 0 discordant of 10 measured seeds). The actual cause is an instrumentation defect: screen cells call _run_cell directly with NO RNG reset, while measurement cells enter through arm_cell (which calls reset_all_rng), so the two phases measure DIFFERENT agents and the prefix-monotonicity premise the screen-soundness check assumed never applied. Full analysis: evidence/planning/mech321_harm_aware_selection_measurement_redesign_staged_2026-08-08.md sections 2 and 8. The ratified routing is UNCHANGED by this correction (pool-exhaustion alone already forced a DV redesign): failure_autopsy_2026-08-05_pending_review_batch (confirmed, routing ratified by /governance 2026-08-07): refuse a same-design 867c; recommend a DV/matching redesign (e.g. unconditional whole-episode harm rate, not divergence-tick-matched windowing) as the next probe on this question. Text correction only -- state, control_passed, non_degenerate and met_elimination_bar are unchanged. RESOLVED 2026-08-13 (/failure-autopsy, session jovial-shannon-35d300, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-919_2026-08-13): the redesign this entry's own live_gate called for (unconditional whole-episode harm-rate DV, no screen, n=40 seeds x 2 arms, 4-seed A-A null control discharging the matching-validity precondition by construction) ran as V3-EXQ-919. All readiness preconditions green (per_arm_gate.all_green=true, red_arms=[]); A-A control bit-identical (max_abs_delta=0.0); harm-aware selection engages robustly (150+ min fires per ON-arm cell, every seed). C1 (load-bearing) FAILS in the negative direction: harm_delta_mean_unconditional=-0.003728 (n=40, SE=0.02292); C2 (mechanistic PE corroboration) also fails to corroborate (-0.0000422); engagement anti-correlates weakly with outcome (engagement_outcome_spearman_rho=-0.28563). This is the first structurally decisive, non-degenerate, fully-powered test in the lineage -- the hypothesis is ELIMINATED as built (magnitude-only harm-aware selection). The commissioning lit-pull (targeted_review_threat_modulated_defensive_path_selection) named escapability and threat-predictability as additional biologically-supported co-determinants explicitly deferred at build time -- routed to /implement-substrate (amend SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition) to add one or both before any re-test; a same-design re-queue is refused.

questions.title: Are wanting and liking stored as functionally-separable, drive-gated valence channels in hippocampal map nodes, per SD-014?

hypotheses.desc: Drive-state vectors probed through get_valence_priority meaningfully re-rank replay-candidate nodes (C1, functional drive-gating), and the stored wanting/liking channels are not collinear across nodes (C2, representational separability).

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-887 (3 seeds, first-ever genuine experimental evidence for SD-014): readiness gate green (R1-R4 all met, instrument's own orthogonal synthetic control confirms it CAN detect separability, tau=-0.011 vs ceiling 0.5), non_degenerate=true. Both load-bearing criteria fail on every seed: C1 mean_pairwise_tau_dissociated 0.87-0.89 (near 1.0 = rankings barely move with drive state) vs TAU_MAX=0.85; C2 max_abs_channel_spearman(w,l) 0.93-0.97 vs RHO_MAX=0.90 (highly collinear). Root cause read directly from ree_core/agent.py: update_liking() (line 10287) writes VALENCE_LIKING from raw benefit_exposure (threshold-gated); update_benefit_salience() writes VALENCE_WANTING from serotonin.benefit_salience(benefit_exposure) -- a smoothed/calibrated transform of the SAME underlying signal, not an independent pathway the way dopamine-mediated wanting and opioid-mediated liking are in the cited biology (Smith/Berridge/Aldridge 2011). Eliminated AS CURRENTLY IMPLEMENTED -- a concrete buildable fix exists (decouple wanting's computation from raw benefit_exposure, e.g. an incentive-sensitization term), and a retest after that fix would open a fresh hypothesis, not resolve this one.

questions.title: Why does survival-competence acquisition on the all-ON REE stack succeed reliably for some seeds and fail near-baseline for others, even after the SD-070 z_world fix and an aligned training budget?

hypotheses.label: exploration/initialization variance in the all-ON REINFORCE stack traps some seeds in early bad-hazard-avoidance local optima
hypotheses.desc: Failing seeds (42, 45 in V3-EXQ-875a) get stuck early in training and never escape, regardless of remaining budget; a per-seed reward-curve trajectory would show early divergence between the succeeding and failing seeds.

resolution.basis: 93% of the eventual group-gap (60.49 of 64.94 ticks) is already present after the first checkpoint (episode 20 of 160); this early-divergence signature independently replicates under both the driver's own narrower official 2-seed split and a data-driven 5-seed natural upper-cluster grouping the driver did not use (both show elevation from checkpoint 1 onward). Necessary-not-sufficient: does not itself rule out H-bias-head-ofc-interaction contributing; met_elimination_bar left false accordingly. Confirmed via failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-890_2026-08-07 (user-confirmed at Step 8 gate).

hypotheses.label: per-seed hazard-field/reef layout randomization creates genuinely harder survival tasks for some seeds
hypotheses.desc: The failure is task-difficulty variance, not learning variance -- some seeds draw a harder hazard/resource layout that no amount of the same training recipe would overcome.

resolution.basis: Random-walk baseline anchors (a task-intrinsic difficulty measure independent of any learned policy) are statistically indistinguishable between the cleared and not-cleared groups across all 16 seeds (diff_frac=0.0026; both groups tightly clustered 8.5-12.1 ticks). If per-seed hazard-layout difficulty explained the split, the random-walk control would differ between groups; it does not, under either the official 2-seed or the natural 5-seed grouping. hypotheses.desc: The shared all-ON stack's other drives (bias_head, OFC-devaluation) compete with survival-competence acquisition in a seed-dependent way, an implementation-level drive-arbitration problem rather than pure exploration or task difficulty.

resolution.basis: Exploratory only -- the driver declares no pre-registered threshold and this signal does not gate outcome. lPFC-bias-head norms are nearly identical between groups at every checkpoint (~4.36-4.39 both). OFC-devaluation norms differ modestly early (4.29 cleared vs 4.41 not-cleared at checkpoint 1) but converge by checkpoint 8 (4.71 vs 4.71 both). Neither pattern clears a discrimination bar because none was pre-registered; remains an open rival pending a purpose-built probe. Reviewed but not resolved via failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-890_2026-08-07.

questions.title: Which mechanism, if any, allows MECH-074d's BLA attribution head to satisfy C2 (context-differentiated addressing, the Moita-2004 dissociation) rather than converging to a context-invariant answer?

hypotheses.label: over-firing / dilution
hypotheses.desc: The fixed non-trainable attribution gate's PE-sigma threshold is too permissive, diluting real attribution signal with false-positive fires -- recalibrating sigma would recover C1/C2.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-894a swept bla_remap_pe_sigma_threshold over [1.0,1.5,2.0,2.5]; mean attribution-mass-excess falls MONOTONICALLY with sigma (Spearman -1.0), tracking the fall in fire-fraction rather than diverging as dilution would predict. Per-seed ranking (one selective, one context-blind-deterministic, one null) stable across all four thresholds -- structural, not sampling noise. Confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-894a_2026-08-08.

hypotheses.label: trainability alone
hypotheses.desc: The fixed, non-trainable attribution rule is architecturally incapable of C1/C2; a learnable attribution head (any reasonable training budget) would recover both.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-894b built and tested the learnable BLAAttributionHead (SD-035): C1 attribution_selectivity recovers fully (0/3->3/3 seeds) but C2 context_differentiated_addressing does NOT recover in either trained arm (stays 0/3 seeds). Doubling the training budget (914->1998 updates) did not help, ruling out 'needs more experience'. Confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-906a_894b_2026-08-09.

hypotheses.label: entropy_weight / MSE loss-term balance
hypotheses.desc: The module's own docstring (design decision 3): the entropy penalty and MSE term are in deliberate tension; a large entropy_weight buys C1 (peakedness) at C2's (context-sensitivity) expense. Retuning entropy_weight downward would let the MSE term's context-sensitivity through.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-894c swept entropy_weight over [0.02,0.01,0.005,0.001] (sigma fixed at 1.0, single P0 budget). No arm reaches C1 AND C2 on >=2/3 seeds (passing_arm_ids=[]). Raw within/cross-context Jaccard components show the head collapses to a fully deterministic, context-invariant answer (within=cross=1.0000) in 10/15 cells, concentrated at the middle two swept values. The docstring's own predicted tradeoff direction is not supported either (mass_excess improves, not degrades, as entropy_weight falls -- opposite predicted sign). Confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-894c_2026-08-11.

hypotheses.label: architecture lacks an explicit context-conditioning mechanism
hypotheses.desc: The attribution head's loss (peakedness + prediction accuracy) does not penalize context-invariant output, so gradient descent can (and mostly does) converge to a fixed-answer local optimum that still minimizes both loss terms. Either the head's input representation does not carry a reliable context-discriminating signal at all, or the head needs an explicit mechanism forcing its output to condition on context, distinct from any scalar loss-term reweighting.

resolution.basis: Newly surfaced by this autopsy's raw within/cross-context Jaccard breakdown of V3-EXQ-894c (not visible from the aggregate jaccard_context_gap statistic alone). Untested directly -- no run has yet probed the attribution head's input representation for context-discriminating signal, nor tested an explicit context-conditioning architectural addition. Suggested probe: failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-894c_2026-08-11 recommended_substrate_queue_entry (SD-035 amend).

questions.title: Which of H1 (literal-F dominance), H2 (primary-field dominance), H3 (upstream insufficiency), or H4 (conditional specialisation) explains E3's apparent F-authority -- and does the substrate's default operating regime (near-uniform, uncommitted selection) even permit a fair test of any of them as posed?
questions.short_title: E3 F-dominance causal discrimination (H1-H4) + selector-regime confound

discovery_growth_events.rationale: H0 draws on an independent, established mechanism -- accumulator/drift-diffusion decision models, where near-uniform choice under a low signal-to-noise ratio (small score range relative to decision temperature/noise) is a textbook signature of weak evidence, not intuition applied after the fact. It was genuinely unconsidered when H1-H4 were pre-registered (ree-v3 commit dcd4b6639a, 2026-08-12T06:44:40Z): all four concern WHICH channel has causal authority, none anticipated that NO channel would have meaningful absolute authority at this scale regardless of identity. The run's own instrumentation is what surfaces it -- fixing the counterfactual-replay reconstruction bug (previously reproducing the live selection only ~2.5% of the time, chance at K=32) exposed committed=False on every observed tick and normalised entropy 0.998, a finding that did not exist as such before the replay arithmetic was corrected during this session's authoring.

H5 draws on an independent, established property of the substrate's own numerics rather than on intuition applied after the fact: F is a squared latent-transition norm and the modulatory channels are piecewise-linear head outputs, so the quadratic-vs-linear scaling relation is derivable a priori -- and V3-EXQ-936's data confirms it at slope 2.020, R^2 0.978, over 54 orders of magnitude. It was genuinely unconsidered when H1-H4 were pre-registered (2026-08-12T06:44:40Z) and when H0 was discovered later that day: every one of those five asks WHICH channel has causal authority, or whether any does at the observed scale; none asks whether the scale is a controlled quantity at all. The run's OWN data is what surfaces it -- V3-EXQ-936 is the first experiment in this lineage to record the E3 score COMPONENT MAGNITUDES rather than a rank/entropy statistic (rank statistics are invariant under monotone transforms and structurally cannot see a scale change, which the driver's own docstring notes as a plausible reason the lineage kept reading 'no conversion'). It is born resolved because the evidence that reveals it is the same arithmetic that settles it; there is no future adjudicating run to await for the hypothesis as stated. The separate CAUSAL question -- whether the unbounded rollout is due to the unarmed SD-056 clamp -- is a distinct proposition and is NOT claimed here; it is the V3-EXQ-936a A/B.

hypotheses.label: literal-F dominance
hypotheses.desc: Literal F itself has candidate-specific causal authority sufficient to suppress useful competitors.

resolution.basis: C1 (literal-F lesion) moved the selection distribution (total variation 0.0005177) but with NO consistent direction toward the independently-preferred (ground-truth-safer) candidate on disagreement events (delta_p_safer_mean=-0.0000016, frac_moved_toward_safer=0.376) -- the H1-supportive branch (delta_p_safer>0.01 and frac_toward>0.5) did not fire. Stays alive: committed_fraction=0.000 means the run mostly did not test the COMMITTED-selection regime H1 is actually about (MECH-439's own framing); this may not have been a fair test of H1 as posed. 2026-08-28 update (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-925a_2026-08-28, Mode B resolving-run append, state unchanged): V3-EXQ-925a restores the committed regime (committed_fraction 1.0, deterministic argmin, c0 match 1.0; the 925 uncommitted regime was a driver defect -- missing post_action_update). Scores remain near-flat (diagnostic entropy 0.998); F-lesion/scramble flip the ACTUAL committed winner on 9.7-30% of events but chance-directionally (frac_toward_safer 0.530/0.484) -- real argmin-level F authority with no consistent safety-axis alignment, so the discrimination remains open; the fair-test blocker is re-attributed from commitment to absolute score scale (H5).

hypotheses.label: primary-field (eligibility) dominance
hypotheses.desc: Not literal F specifically; the broader pre-modulatory/eligibility pathway retains privileged authority even when literal F alone is attenuated.

resolution.basis: MECH-448 eligibility-envelope toggling (C4) changed the winner on 0.0% of events -- no evidence the eligibility mechanism itself is an independent locus of authority beyond literal F in this sample. Stays alive for the same regime-confound reason as H1: near-uniform, uncommitted selection (entropy 0.998) means the toggle had almost nothing to move regardless of whether H2 holds under committed selection. 2026-08-28 update (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-925a_2026-08-28, Mode B resolving-run append, state unchanged): V3-EXQ-925a restores the committed regime (committed_fraction 1.0, deterministic argmin, c0 match 1.0; the 925 uncommitted regime was a driver defect -- missing post_action_update). Scores remain near-flat (diagnostic entropy 0.998); F-lesion/scramble flip the ACTUAL committed winner on 9.7-30% of events but chance-directionally (frac_toward_safer 0.530/0.484) -- real argmin-level F authority with no consistent safety-axis alignment, so the discrimination remains open; the fair-test blocker is re-attributed from commitment to absolute score scale (H5).

hypotheses.label: upstream insufficiency
hypotheses.desc: Apparent dominance is mainly downstream of inadequate candidate generation/representation; competing channels do not yet carry useful candidate-specific evidence.

resolution.basis: NEAR-MISS: the driver's own H3-supportive threshold (competitor_tv<1e-9 AND competitor_influence_factual<0.05) did not fire -- competitor_had_influence_factual_f_rate=0.0858 narrowly exceeds 0.05; competitor_had_influence_lesioned_f_rate=0.0959 also exceeds it, so the 'near-zero in both conditions' branch also missed. hypotheses.label: selector-regime / scale confound (new, discovered)
hypotheses.desc: Neither pre-registered hypothesis. [DESC RE-SCOPED 2026-08-28 by /governance cycle governance-cycle-20260828, resolving GFLAG-0049; basis: confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-925a_2026-08-28, which partially supersedes failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-925_2026-08-12. Prose/attribution only -- resolution state, resolving_runs, control_passed, non_degenerate, met_elimination_bar and the frozen set are all UNCHANGED by this edit.] WITHDRAWN half: the original text asserted as a SUBSTRATE fact that at corpus-standard default configuration the E3 selector essentially never engages committed (argmin) selection (committed_fraction=0.000 across 2493 fresh events, 2 seeds). That is refuted. V3-EXQ-925's committed_fraction=0.000 was a DRIVER INSTRUMENTATION DEFECT, not a regime: its driver never called post_action_update, so E3._running_variance stayed pinned at precision_init=0.5 against commit_threshold=0.4 and commitment was arithmetically impossible before the run collected any data. Adding that one standard call at UNCHANGED default config moves committed_fraction 0.000 -> ~1.0. Red-team verified at the 925-era commit 9bcde4cb, not merely against a later tree. The original parenthetical attributing the regime to use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature=False is likewise withdrawn: both of that flag's call sites sit inside 'elif committed:', so it cannot influence WHETHER commitment engages. SURVIVING half, re-attributed: normalised selection entropy is near-uniform at 0.998 -- independently re-measured at 0.998 by V3-EXQ-925a under a RESTORED committed regime (committed_fraction 1.0, deterministic argmin, c0 match 1.0), so the near-flatness is real and is NOT an artefact of the defect. It is re-attributed from 'no committed regime' to ABSOLUTE SCORE SCALE (H5). Under the corrected harness, F-lesion/scramble do flip the committed winner on 9.7-30% of events -- real argmin-level F authority -- but chance-directionally (frac_toward_safer 0.530/0.484), so there is no consistent safety-axis alignment and the H1-H4 discrimination remains OPEN. MECH-439's 'committed-selection variance monopoly' framing is therefore NOT excluded by this leg; the blocker is score scale, not commitment.

resolution.basis: Directly measured: committed_fraction=0.000 (exact), selection_entropy_normalised_mean=0.99820, replay reconstruction validated to 7.87e-09 vs the selector's own recorded distribution (so the near-uniform reading is not a replay-arithmetic artifact), degeneracy check passed (non_degenerate=true). This was not a rival explanation considered when H1-H4 were framed (2026-08-12, ree-v3 commit dcd4b6639a) -- it was revealed only once the counterfactual-replay bug (reproducing the live selection ~2.5% of the time, chance at K=32) was fixed during this session's authoring and the replay began perturbing the REAL captured score vector.

hypotheses.label: uncontrolled score scale (new, discovered)
hypotheses.desc: Neither pre-registered hypothesis nor H0: E3's apparent F-authority is an artefact of an UNCONTROLLED ABSOLUTE SCALE in the score sum, not of any channel's causal role. F (compute_reality_cost) is the SQUARED z_world step norm over the E2 imagination rollout, while every modulatory channel is at most linear in latent scale, so var(F) ~ var(non-F)^2 -- measured on V3-EXQ-936's own 8 cells, OLS slope 2.020 (R^2 0.978) over 54 orders of magnitude, against a predicted 2.000. The rollout is unbounded by default (e2_rollout_output_norm_clamp_enabled=False), so the same substrate can sit at either extreme: V3-EXQ-925 measured a regime so FLAT that no channel steers anything (normalised entropy 0.998, committed_fraction 0.000 -- that is H0), while V3-EXQ-936 measured one so STEEP that std(non-F)/std(F) falls below float32 eps in 7 of 8 cells and the entire modulatory stack is ADDITIVELY ANNIHILATED in the score sum. Under H5, 'F's variance share' is not a stable architectural property at all, and MECH-439's own stated remedy ('rebalance F's variance share') is unreachable by re-weighting any channel -- a 1e20 magnitude gap cannot be offset by a coefficient. DISTINCT FROM H0: H0 says no channel has meaningful ABSOLUTE authority at the small-scale end; H5 says the scale itself is uncontrolled in BOTH directions and is what determines apparent authority.

resolution.basis: Established by arithmetic on the run's own recorded per-cell variances, needing no external control: OLS of log10 var(F) on log10 var(non-F) across all 8 cells gives slope 2.020, R^2 0.978 (OFF arm alone 1.951; DEMOTION arm alone 2.149) against the quadratic-vs-linear prediction of 2.000; and std(non-F)/std(F) sits below float32 eps (1.192e-07) in 7 of 8 cells, down to 4.6e-23. The run's OWN P3 non-degeneracy precondition is the passing control that makes this a magnitude effect rather than dead channels: the modulatory components DO carry variance (worst cell 1394.44 absolute, threshold 1e-9), so their absence from the committed score is purely relative scale. criteria_non_degenerate true for both C1 and C2. Not a rival considered when H1-H4 were framed (2026-08-12) nor when H0 was added: all five concern which channel has authority, or whether any does at this scale -- none anticipated that the scale is itself an uncontrolled free variable spanning 54 orders of magnitude across seeds of one run. It was surfaced only by V3-EXQ-936's variance decomposition, the first instrumentation in this lineage to record the component magnitudes rather than a rank statistic. NOTE what this does NOT establish: that the missing SD-056 rollout-norm clamp is the CAUSE. That is the V3-EXQ-936a A/B and has not been run. EXTENDED 2026-08-30 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-936a_2026-08-30): the clamped successor corroborates the uncontrolled-scale reading from the other side -- with rollout magnitudes bounded, the variance monopoly persists with a DIFFERENT occupant (residue_weighted 0.9999876-0.9999998 of committed-selection variance in all 8 cells, both share methods agreeing), while F's share is 6.33e-06. The monopolist is whichever channel has the largest uncontrolled scale, not F specifically. No state change; H1-H4 undisturbed (936a's C2 was unevaluable and discriminates nothing). EXTENDED 2026-09-02 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-571c_2026-09-02, Mode B resolving-run append; state, pre_registered_utc, bar fields and the frozen set are all UNCHANGED). V3-EXQ-571c is the first run in this lineage to hold the ENVIRONMENT fixed (936 regime throughout) while varying only the residue-feeding protocol, and it corroborates H5 from a third direction: the monopoly's EXISTENCE does not vary while its OCCUPANT tracks the protocol. residue_weighted holds 0.999989-0.999996 of within-tick cross-candidate variance in all four fed+warmup cells (F share 4e-06 to 1.1e-05), while F itself -- harm_weighted, per the driver's own F_COMPONENTS at driver:345 -- holds 0.994-0.9998 in 7 of 8 STARVED cells. So MECH-439's F-monopoly premise is true when residue is starved and false when it is fed, at one environment. Crucially for H5 as stated, this is a RELATIVE-scale phenomenon and not dead channels: every non-structurally-zero component in every one of the 16 cells clears the absolute variance floor (1e-12), and every liveness failure is on the 1e-3 RELATIVE share floor. The run is gate-red (n_live_channels=1 in the worst cell of all four arms) and scores nothing, so this is corroboration, not a new adjudication. NOTE what it does NOT establish: that bounding one channel RELOCATES the monopoly to the next-largest. No run has bounded two channels at once; the 936 -> 936a -> 571b -> 571c sequence is consistent with that prediction but does not test it. Also newly established at source and worth recording against any future scale-control leg: the residue term E3 actually reads is RBFLayer.forward summing self.weights (field.py:122-149), written by an unbounded += in add_residue (field.py:171) -- SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND clamps a DIFFERENT accumulator (valence_vecs, field.py:294-332), so no bound on this channel currently exists. H1-H4 remain alive and are NOT discriminated by this run.

synthesis.surviving_label: H0 selector-regime/scale confound (discovered) -- dominates the observed pattern; H1-H4 remain undetermined pending a regime-matched re-test
synthesis.text: None of H1, H2, or H4 were eliminated or confirmed by V3-EXQ-925 (2026-08-12): C1's F-lesion moved the score distribution but with no consistent direction, and eligibility toggling almost never changed the winner. H3 was a near-miss (competitor influence 0.086 factual / 0.096 F-lesioned, both just outside the driver's own 0.05 threshold on either side), qualitatively favoured by the biological-reference reading (weak, only-partially-differentiated candidate evidence is expected to produce near-uniform choice) but not confirmed. The dominant finding instead is H0: at this substrate's default configuration, the selector essentially never engages committed selection (committed_fraction=0.000, entropy 0.998), so this run may not have been a fair test of any of H1-H4 as MECH-439's own committed-selection-authority framing poses them. User-confirmed routing: a /queue-experiment redesign that engages committed selection (use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature or an extended-training wider-score-range configuration) before re-testing H1-H4. A candidate note bearing on MECH-439's own evidence_quality_note was drafted for /governance review (not applied by this autopsy).

decision.decision_question: Which of H1-H4 explains E3's apparent F-authority, and does MECH-439's committed-selection framing describe this substrate's actual default operating regime?
decision.live_gate: A regime-matched re-test (committed selection genuinely engaged, e.g. via use_gap_scaled_commit_temperature or an extended-training wider-score-range configuration) that produces a non-trivial committed_fraction and a clean disagreement-conditioned discrimination among H1/H2/H4, with H3 read against the same biological-reference lens.

questions.title: Why does the SalienceCoordinator arbitrate bang-bang after the salience_affinity_input_cap fix -- is the saturation an artefact of the cap operating point (H1), structural to SD-032a's discrete argmax mode register (H2), or an artefact of the non-vacuity gate and mode-agnostic dwell statistic used to measure it (H3)?

fanout_growth_events.note: V3-EXQ-935 eliminated H2 and strongly supported H1, and in doing so exposed a rival explanation at a level none of H1-H3 addressed: not WHICH cap value, but WHY a per-agent cap value is needed at all. Pre-registered before any adjudicating run exists (invariant 3a(a) satisfied trivially). NON-CONVERGENCE, stated plainly: this is the THIRD growth event on this question across three autopsies (2026-08-13, 2026-08-16, 2026-08-18). The denominator is growing while the surviving set has only now taken its first elimination -- the campaign has not converged.

hypotheses.label: cap mis-calibration
hypotheses.desc: Some AFFINITY_INPUT_CAP value (or per-signal caps) admits a mixed-occupancy regime; the arbiter can mix and the sweep has simply not found the operating point.
hypotheses.basis: AFFINITY_INPUT_CAP=2.0 was chosen from a single-seed scratch diagnostic (symmetric-arm occupancy 0.3) and the driver source explicitly declares it 'NOT yet re-derived/justified against the full 3-seed curriculum'. On the full curriculum the symmetric arm collapsed to 0.0 on 2/3 seeds, so the value is known-wrong but the existence of a better value is untested.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-934 does NOT narrow this leg. Its sole load-bearing criterion is a GRID EXISTENTIAL (does some cap in a 5-point grid put occupancy in (0.1,0.9)), which detects a CROSSING, not gradedness -- its pass probability rises with grid density regardless of steepness, so it cannot discriminate H1 from H2. No cap graded >1 of 3 seeds (0.75 -> 1/3; 1.0/1.25/1.5 -> 0/3; 1.75 -> 1/3); the two winners are disjoint singletons at opposite grid ends and the reported band is their min/max, not a band. Also conditional on a non-production config (salience_affinity_input_cap default None, use_external_task_drive default False), and the clamp is a no-op on external_task_drive at every cap >=1.0. Leg stays ALIVE per the skill state-map; H2 is explicitly NOT eliminated. Confirmed at the 2026-08-16 batch gate. | 2026-08-18 (V3-EXQ-935, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-935_2026-08-18): STRONGLY SUPPORTED but deliberately still ALIVE. Re-scoring 935's own pre-registered gate at each swept r returns C1 AND C2 AND C3 all PASS at r=2.45 and r=2.65 -- both inside its own pre-registered sweep -- and FAIL only at the imported R_STAR=2.25 (C1 4/5, 4/5 vs 2/5). The C1 count is monotone in r (1/5, 1/5, 2/5, 4/5, 4/5). So a cap operating point admitting a common mixed regime demonstrably EXISTS. It is NOT marked confirmed here because r=2.45 was selected post hoc from the same sweep, which is precisely the best-point selection this lineage exists to avoid; confirmation belongs to V3-EXQ-935a, which pre-registers r=2.45 and tests FRESH out-of-sample seeds. Adjudicating run for confirmation: V3-EXQ-935a (not yet queued).

hypotheses.label: structural bang-bang
hypotheses.desc: SD-032a's discrete argmax mode register cannot produce graded occupancy at ANY cap; the cap relocates the step but never removes it.
hypotheses.basis: SD-032a specifies operating_mode as discrete and states 'Mode transitions are discrete, not graded'. Every observation in this lineage read the discrete mode LABEL, which cannot distinguish graded arbitration rendered discrete at the output from arbitration that is discrete all the way down. 19 of 21 observed cells sit at exactly 0.0 or 1.0, and n_switches is invariant across a 20x rail sweep -- consistent with a hard argmax.

resolution.basis: ELIMINATED by V3-EXQ-935, which supplies exactly the discriminator V3-EXQ-934 lacked. 934 was a GRID EXISTENTIAL (does some cap land occupancy in (0.1,0.9)) and so detected a CROSSING, not gradedness -- which is why H2 was correctly left alive at the 2026-08-16 gate. 935 instead measures a DOSE-RESPONSE: occupancy is monotone decreasing in r WITHIN every seed across 5 swept r values (e.g. seed 46: 0.986 / 0.916 / 0.837 / 0.562 / 0.204; seed 45: 1.000 / 0.998 / 0.925 / 0.781 / 0.281), taking 12 distinct interior values spanning 0.124-0.925 with 15-26 genuine mode switches per cell on 4 of 5 seeds. A relocated step yields a step; a slope is not a relocated step. H2 as written -- 'cannot produce graded occupancy at ANY cap; the cap relocates the step but never removes it' -- is refuted on its own stated DV. Bar met: control_passed (ARM_ABS at cap 1.75 ran and returned a clean interpretable 0/5 bimodal result, and all five readiness anchors cleared 5/5 with no precondition unmet); non_degenerate (manipulation_landed, occupancy_varies_across_r and margin_varies_across_r all true); direction is a DISCRIMINATING non_contributory. SCOPE, stated so it is not over-read: what is settled is that TIME-AVERAGED occupancy is graded and cap-controllable. The INSTANTANEOUS mode label remains discrete by construction -- SD-032a specifies that and it was never in dispute. Seed 42 remains saturated at 1.000 with 0 switches across the whole sweep, but its required r lies ABOVE the top of the tested range (>2.65) rather than not existing, so it is an untested-range fact, not a counterexample. Adjudicated in failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-935_2026-08-18.

hypotheses.label: instrumentation ill-posed
hypotheses.desc: The non-vacuity gate and the mode-agnostic dwell statistic are ill-posed, so the non_contributory verdicts are artefacts of the instrument rather than of the substrate.
hypotheses.basis: Three identified defects: min() across arms/ratios conflates 'mode unreachable' with 'mode saturated' and emits a factually-false route_reason; 467e's min-over-ALL-ratios gate is anti-correlated with C1's own predicted effect; and mean_dwell accumulates run lengths in ANY mode, so C1 compares external_task dwell at r=0.10 against internal_planning dwell at r>=0.50. Testable by re-scoring banked data at zero compute cost.

resolution.basis: Pre-registered at fan-out. | 2026-08-18 (V3-EXQ-935): STAYS ALIVE, basis updated. 935 replaced the corrupting min-across-arms non-vacuity gate and the mode-agnostic dwell statistic with per-seed readiness anchors and a mode-specific occupancy fraction -- and still found real graded structure, so instrument ill-posedness is not the whole story and the family is not confirmed. But 935 exhibits a NEW defect of the SAME family: its H-KNIFE aliasing control was computed and recorded (graded_at_some_r_fraction) yet marked INFO_ONLY and never consulted by the routing, which falls through a bare `else` to H-IDIO with no H-KNIFE branch; and its route_reason asserts 'no_common_normalised_rule_outperformed_the_best_absolute_cap' while c3_beats_best_absolute_cap is true. That is the second factually-false route_reason in this lineage in five days. The family is therefore neither eliminated nor confirmed. | 2026-08-25T10:53:11Z (mech266_h3_rescoring_20260825.md, zero-cost re-score of the ORIGINAL banked 464e/467e data this leg was pre-registered against -- the probe the leg names had never actually been executed until now; 935 above is a different, new run, not this re-scoring). Declared null ("re-scoring changes no verdict") REFUTED on both targets. Readiness gate: regime-conditioned occupancy (sticky arm for 464e, r=0.10 for 467e, instead of min() across the full sweep) flips NOT-MET -> MET on BOTH runs (464e 0.333->1.000, 467e 0.000->1.000 of guard-passing seeds) -- route_reason=external_task_mode_not_occupied does not survive re-scoring on either run, confirming the cluster autopsy Section 2 claim quantitatively rather than only narratively. 467e load-bearing C1/C2 (dwell-based) flip from a definite FAIL (3/3 seeds) to UNDECIDABLE (3/3 seeds) under occupancy-conditioned dwell: at most one ratio arm per seed ever has a genuine external_task-dwell reading (occ>=0.9), so no same-mode comparison across r exists in the banked data -- the original FAIL compared external_task dwell at r=0.10 against internal_planning dwell at r>=0.50 (M3), not a real test of the hysteresis prediction. 464e load-bearing C1/C2 are UNCHANGED (pass 3/3, degenerate 2/3 seeds both before and after) -- never dwell-based, so M1/M3 correctly do not touch them: not every verdict in the cluster was an instrumentation artifact. Net: H3 SUPPORTED on the specific banked data it was pre-registered against, complementary to (not redundant with) the 2026-08-18 finding that 935 own corrected instrument still uncovered real graded structure. Stays ALIVE -- neither eliminated (real defects confirmed here) nor confirmed as sole cause (935 shows graded structure survives correction too).

hypotheses.label: clip rather than divisive normalisation
hypotheses.desc: The arbitration's scale-sensitivity -- the fact that a per-agent constant is needed AT ALL -- is a consequence of the gain stage being a HARD CLIP rather than a DIVISIVE NORMALISATION. Replacing max(-cap, min(cap, v)) with a normalising stage would be scale-free by construction and would remove the free parameter entirely: there would be no r to pre-register.
hypotheses.basis: SalienceCoordinator.tick() (ree_core/cingulate/salience_coordinator.py:455-467) clips each affinity input to [-cap,+cap] before its per-mode weight, while external_task_bias enters the external_task logit UNCLAMPED -- so the cap sets a ratio against a quantity whose scale varies per agent. Biological gain control in this role is divisive normalisation (Carandini & Heeger canonical normalisation; in BG via lateral inhibition / FSI-mediated pooling), which is scale-free by construction. V3-EXQ-935 makes this concrete and quantitative: baseline_margin is BIMODAL across seeds (~0.32-0.36 vs ~0.78-0.81), occupancy at R_STAR is STRICTLY MONOTONE in baseline_margin (0.448 < 0.837 < 0.925 < 0.990 < 1.000 for margins 0.3217 < 0.3549 < 0.3623 < 0.7851 < 0.8139), and the required r RISES with margin -- i.e. the ratio rule systematically UNDER-corrects, exactly as expected when the operation being undone is a clip rather than a division. WHY THIS IS NOT H2 RE-ENTERING ITS FAMILY (both map to `constitution`, and the convergence classifier will read this as same-family growth): H4 PRESUPPOSES H2's refutation. H2 claimed graded occupancy is unproducible by the discrete register; 935 showed it is producible. H4 concerns the GAIN STAGE UPSTREAM of the register and asks why producing it requires a per-agent constant. Refuting H2 is a precondition of H4 being interesting, so it is not the dead leg wearing a new name. PROBE-GATE SATISFIED 2026-08-25 (mech266_circling_review_20260825.md): the fresh /lit-pull commission this basis called for (targeted_review_salience_gain_normalisation) is NOT NEEDED -- the biological case for divisive normalisation as canonical striatal/BG gain control is already established across 3 existing targeted reviews with 7+ relevant entries already in the corpus: targeted_review_connectome_mech_439 and targeted_review_sd_082 both independently pulled Carandini & Heeger 2012 (canonical divisive normalisation, explicitly covering value coding and attention) plus Louie's value-based divisive-normalisation work (relative value coding); targeted_review_striatal_gain_control_bounding holds Pommer et al. 2021 (SPN-SPN lateral inhibition WITHIN THE STRIATUM, characterised by its own authors as 'divisive-normalization-flavoured' competitive gain -- the closest anatomical match to SalienceCoordinator in the whole corpus), plus Kohnomi 2016 (DA-graded normalizer), Chen 2020 and Gowrishankar 2018 (D2-autoreceptor homeostat / bound-vs-runaway dynamics in striatum). SD-082's own confirmed lit synthesis already makes the exact argument H4 needs on an analogous prior REE fix (hard clamp destroys the REINFORCE gradient at its flat region; divisive/bounded gain control has no flat region and preserves it). No new /lit-pull commission is owed; a substrate proposal for H4 may cite these three reviews directly once H1 is confirmed (V3-EXQ-935a).

resolution.basis: Pre-registered 2026-08-18 as labelled fan-out growth. UPDATED 2026-08-25: the /lit-pull probe-gate is satisfied by existing corpus (targeted_review_connectome_mech_439, targeted_review_sd_082, targeted_review_striatal_gain_control_bounding -- see leg basis for the entry-level citation); no new lit-pull commission is owed. Still ALIVE -- the biological case being established is not itself an adjudicating run. Adjudicating experiment (a substrate proposal replacing the clip with a normalising stage, tested against the H1-confirmation regime) not yet queued; blocked behind V3-EXQ-935a (H1 confirmation) so the operating point it would be compared against is settled first.

decision.decision_question: Is the observed bang-bang mode arbitration a cap operating-point artefact, a structural property of SD-032a's discrete mode register, or an artefact of the measurement instrument?
decision.live_gate: H3 re-scores the banked 464e/467e data with a per-arm regime-conditioned occupancy gate and an occupancy-conditioned dwell statistic; if the verdicts survive, a cap sweep (H1) reporting PER-ARM occupancy plus direct instrumentation of the continuous pre-argmax salience margin (H2) discriminates the remaining two.
decision.distance_phrase: One zero-cost re-scoring (H3) away from knowing whether the substrate question is even well-posed; two probes beyond that from separating cap artefact from structural saturation.
decision.observation_bottleneck: Every experiment in this lineage has measured the DISCRETE mode label. That variable is saturated by construction under an argmax and cannot distinguish H1 from H2; the continuous pre-argmax salience margin has never been instrumented.

questions.title: Why does residue_wanting predict behaviour if it has no selection authority?

decision.decision_question: Is residue_wanting a motivational signal with a causal path to action, or a shared upstream state correlate?
decision.live_gate: a coupling measured under an explicit ablation of each candidate effector pathway
decision.distance_phrase: one cheap discriminator away -- 931's existing ARM_W0 vs ARM_W5000 contrast instrumented with 932's coupling readout

hypotheses.label: The hippocampal-CEM wanting scoring term has selection authority at the operating weight

hypotheses.basis: the documented purpose of the config field ('Set ~0.3-0.5 for goal-directed navigation')
hypotheses.pre_registered_utc: 2026-08-14 (V3-EXQ-931's own completion date -- the criterion was pre-registered in the driver before the run)

resolution.basis: selection_flip_rate 0.0 in 5/5 seeds at w=0.5, with the in-run positive control (w=5000) flipping in 5/5 seeds and the arithmetic negative control (w=0) at exactly 0.0. A discriminating negative with both controls passing and criteria_non_degenerate true on all five criteria -- the full elimination bar.

hypotheses.label: SHARED-SITUATION: no causal path; wanting and locomotion are co-driven by the same situational state
hypotheses.desc: residue-field geometry, proximity, drive level and harm history drive both residue_wanting and locomotion, so the lagged correlation is a common-cause signature with no wanting->action arrow.
hypotheses.basis: 931 excludes the CEM route at two independent points (no authority at operating weight; no behavioural throughput at 10^4x), while 932's wanting->moved coupling survives partialling on z_goal -- so a real association exists whose route is not the ablated one.

hypotheses.label: ALTERNATIVE-EFFECTOR: a causal path exists but is not the pathway 931 ablated
hypotheses.desc: wanting reaches behaviour via the serotonergic benefit-salience path, drive coupling, or a modulatory channel at E3.select rather than via the hippocampal CEM scoring term.
hypotheses.basis: 931 ablated exactly one route and would not observe another; the wanting->moved coupling is robust and requires an explanation.

hypotheses.label: REVERSE / CO-DETERMINATION via the writer's own update cadence
hypotheses.desc: locomotion changes proximity, which changes benefit_exposure, which update_benefit_salience writes into VALENCE_WANTING on the same per-tick cadence -- so wanting[t] -> moved[t+1] is partly an artifact of write timing rather than forward prediction.
hypotheses.basis: the writer is called once per tick from the agent's own contact, so wanting[t] already encodes contact at t; the lag-1 direction has never been checked against its reverse.

questions.title: Does MECH-152's cue-indexed terrain_weight pathway modulate at the depth the claim asserts (w_harm 0.8 vs 0.2), and can a scale-invariant Pearson-r DV over a near-constant terrain target ever answer that?

decision.decision_question: Is MECH-152's contextual precision modulation present at the asserted magnitude, absent, or merely unmeasured?
decision.live_gate: A run that presents both terrain-target states on >=25% of steps each AND scores the between-context mean difference in terrain_weight against the claim's own w_harm>0.8 / w_goal<0.5 band.
decision.distance_phrase: One redesigned experiment away -- the DV and the target distribution both need fixing before any verdict on the mechanism is possible.
decision.observation_bottleneck: The terrain-precision target switched state on at most ~2% of collection steps in every cell of V3-EXQ-922a, and the scoring statistic (Pearson r) is scale-invariant. Both must be repaired before the mechanism question is observable at all.

hypotheses.label: Hard-Gumbel selection suppresses the terrain-precision signal; softening selection recovers it
hypotheses.desc: The V3-EXQ-922 MECH-152 collapse under the production combo is specific to the hard (near-one-hot) selection operator, and soft selection restores terrain content-tracking.
hypotheses.basis: The clean 1-knob A1->A2 ablation does move the DV by +0.184 (harm) and +0.174 (goal). The coupling is real.

resolution.basis: Neither eliminated nor confirmed. The recovery is real in sign but falls below A2's own across-seed SD (0.184 vs 0.193 harm; 0.174 vs 0.193 goal) on n=3, reaches only 37% / 60% of the 194a bar, and is rank-inverted by the tagger-OFF control (A0_OFF r_w_harm 0.356 at w_harm_std ~1e-6). An uninformative run narrows nothing; it surfaces the observation bottleneck recorded on this question.

hypotheses.label: The terrain pathway does not modulate at the depth MECH-152 asserts, regardless of selection operator
hypotheses.desc: The cue-indexed E1 -> terrain_weight pathway is architecturally incapable of (or has not learned) the 0.6-magnitude contextual swing the claim specifies, so no selection operator will recover it.
hypotheses.basis: Observed terrain_weight std is 3.8e-7 to 1.0e-2 across all nine cells against a claimed swing of 0.6 -- 2 to 6 orders of magnitude low, in every arm.

resolution.basis: Directionally suggested by the universal flatness but NOT adjudicable: the terrain target was near-constant (switch rate <=2%), so the pathway was never given the contrastive pressure that would distinguish 'cannot modulate' from 'was never asked to'. Cannot be eliminated or confirmed on this run.

hypotheses.label: The scoring DV (Pearson r between hazard and terrain_weight) is scale-invariant and therefore cannot adjudicate MECH-152's magnitude assertion
hypotheses.desc: Pearson r normalises out amplitude, which is precisely the quantity MECH-152 claims. A correlation over a functionally-constant terrain_weight is arithmetically real and substantively empty.
hypotheses.basis: Established directly by this run's own data: across all three arms the DV is monotonically DECREASING in cue-indexed retrieval selectivity (A0_OFF 0.356 at w_std ~1e-6 > A2 0.185 > A1 0.001), i.e. it ranks the arms in exact inverse order of modulation depth. The non-degeneracy floor of 1e-9 is ~6 orders too permissive to catch this.
hypotheses.discovery_note: Surfaced by this run's own analysis, on a NEW question, so Mode B's same-edit register-and-resolve applies; no discovery_growth_events entry is owed (that path is for growth of an EXISTING question).

resolution.basis: Confirmed but necessary-not-sufficient (met_elimination_bar false): the three-arm rank inversion against modulation depth demonstrates the DV cannot measure a cue-indexed magnitude claim, but confirming the instrument defect does not by itself close the question about the mechanism.

hypotheses.label: The collection and training distribution almost never crosses the terrain-target thresholds, so the mechanism was never under pressure to modulate
hypotheses.desc: hazard varies (std 0.19-0.25) but essentially never crosses the 0.3 / 0.33 thresholds that convert hazard variation into a terrain-TARGET contrast, so the terrain head learned a constant.
hypotheses.basis: final_terrain_loss of 1.0e-5 to 7.2e-3 against targets in {0.2, 0.8}, with an effectively-constant output (independently established by w_*_std), bounds the target switch rate at <=2.1% of collection steps in every cell and at ~0.003% in the tightest. The tiny loss and the flat output are the same fact.

resolution.basis: Confirmed but necessary-not-sufficient. Directly derived for the collection series (the series r_w is computed over); extension to the P0a/P1 training series is an inference from the same env, same thresholds and same compute_terrain_loss, corroborated by terminal near-zero w_*_std. A redesign should measure training-side target balance rather than inherit the inference.
