questions.title: Why does MECH-467's leg (c) have no target-consumption event denominator?

hypotheses.label: H-commitment
hypotheses.desc: the agent cannot sustain a multi-step approach long enough to complete a consume
hypotheses.basis: The V3-EXQ-874 autopsy named this first; V3-EXQ-874b set it aside on a geometry probe whose result did not transfer, so it is live again.

hypotheses.label: H-energy
hypotheses.desc: the homeostatic economy kills the agent before the pre-registered window elapses
hypotheses.basis: 7 of 12 V3-EXQ-874b cells terminated on health_depleted; only 63.1% of the intended exposure window was realised.

resolution.basis: DELIBERATELY UNRESOLVED (user-confirmed 2026-08-20, failure_autopsy_940-941-mech467-cluster_2026-08-20). V3-EXQ-940 is this leg's adjudicating run, but its deciding criterion C2_event_rate_lifts_when_window_decoupled NEVER EVALUATED: rate_lift_ratio divides by ARM_STOCK's event rate of exactly 0.0 and returns null, while its non-degeneracy guard tests total_events_all_arms > 0 -- the pooled numerator, not the denominator arm -- so it is stamped non_degenerate true while being arithmetically undefined. The run's emitted label window_restored_rate_unchanged is contradicted by its own per_arm_pooled: 0 events/2249 ticks (ARM_STOCK, rate 0.0), 2/2700 (ARM_CONTAM_OFF, 0.00074), 4/2700 (ARM_HEALTH_DECOUPLED, 0.00148) -- the rate rises MONOTONICALLY with decoupling strength from exactly zero. On 4 events that direction is not significant either, so the honest state is unresolved rather than null. Recording an elimination on a criterion that never computed is the frozen-set discipline's core failure mode. What the run DOES establish, and what is genuinely new: a fully-realised 2700-tick window with contamination gated AND health clamped still produced only 4 events, so neither survival nor contamination explains the missing denominator.

hypotheses.label: H-denominator
hypotheses.desc: events are not absent but mis-decomposed -- never-approached and approached-but-failed-to-arrive are pooled into one zero
hypotheses.basis: No movement or approach-initiation counter exists in the 874/874b design, so a zero cannot be attributed.

resolution.basis: The decomposition succeeded and localised the missing denominator UPSTREAM of arrival: 6 approach initiations, 2 arrivals and 4 consumption events over 3681 realised ticks, with approach_run_length_max = 1 in both arms. Control passed (movement_instrument_live: 4 of 4 distinct movement actions changed position on a fresh env), non_degenerate true. Confirms the leg as a description of WHERE the loss occurs; it does not establish WHY, which remains owned by e3_fdominance_causal_discrimination. Basis is thin and recorded as such: seed 43 sat fully immobile for 900/900 ticks in BOTH arms, contributing 48.9% of the denominator and zero signal, and the approach_is_definable precondition written to catch exactly that aliasing carries a 0.0 floor that cannot fire.

hypotheses.label: H-cadence
hypotheses.desc: the genuine-E3-tick fraction bounds the achievable selection rate and therefore the event rate
hypotheses.basis: Genuine E3 selections were 0.091-0.126 of ticks in every V3-EXQ-874b cell.

decision.decision_question: Which constraint must be lifted before MECH-467 leg (c) can be tested at all?
decision.live_gate: >=15 pooled target-consumption events in at least one arm, over a fully-realised exposure window
decision.distance_phrase: 2 of 4 legs run (V3-EXQ-940 H-energy, V3-EXQ-941 H-denominator); H-denominator confirmed (loss is upstream of arrival), H-energy deliberately unresolved (its deciding criterion never evaluated). Live gate still unmet: best pooled single-arm count is 4 against a floor of 15.
decision.observation_bottleneck: leg (c) has produced no usable denominator in THREE consecutive designs (V3-EXQ-874 0/0; V3-EXQ-874b 8 events / 6817 realised ticks; V3-EXQ-940/941 best single arm 4 events). The best-arm event rate has not moved off ~0.0015/tick across all three. V3-EXQ-940 removed both candidate explanations -- a fully-realised window with contamination gated and health clamped still yielded 4 events -- so the binding constraint is upstream of the window: the agent does not move (98.8% of movement actions blocked) and does not re-select (89-91% of ticks latched). That constraint is owned by the ACTIVE line e3_fdominance_causal_discrimination, not by MECH-467.

questions.title: Why does trained gumbel_learned write-address selection fail to become content-conditioned (V3-EXQ-956: mean probe Jaccard 0.400 untrained -> 0.667 trained vs required <= 0.15), and what mechanism would achieve content-conditioned ContextMemory write addressing?

hypotheses.label: Pairwise addressing-distribution diversity references no content; a content-referencing (contrastive) objective is required
hypotheses.desc: Swap in a contrastive/cluster-supervised loss at the same schedule, on BOTH real-agent latents and the synthetic 2-cluster stream as training input (the dual regime avoids conflation with H4). Null: Jaccard does not drop by the 0.25 margin in either regime. Precedent: V3-EXQ-907's confirmed read-path result (context-referencing objective broke the saddle at the same 15,000-step schedule); both failed write-side losses (MoE importance; pairwise diversity) are content-blind objectives.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-970 RESULT (2026-09-02) -- LEG STAYS ALIVE, NOT ADJUDICATED, AND CARRIES THE PORTFOLIO'S STRONGEST POSITIVE SIGNAL. Regime A (real agent latents) never produced its load-bearing DV: probe_heldout_real_latent_jaccard was null in 12/12 cells because the held-out gate needs >208 dangerous states and every cell yielded 171-195, so Regime A scored out in every possible world at this schedule. Regime B (synthetic 2-cluster stream) reached the BEST value the DV admits -- Jaccard 0.0 on 6/6 seeds -- and still returned FAIL, because with 2 of 6 paired diffs exactly zero the exact sign-flip p-grid floors at 1/2^4 = 0.0625 against alpha_corrected 0.025: no outcome could have cleared it. The self-route 'not confirmed in either regime' is a gate artifact, not a null. See failure_autopsy_contextmemory-write-content-cluster_2026-09-03.

hypotheses.label: w=0.5 / 100-episode schedule is the wrong operating point; some weight/anneal/duration yields discrimination
hypotheses.desc: First leg: cheap +10-seed x 2-gumbel-arm sweep (~26 min cloud) -- also settles whether 956's +0.267 wrong-direction move (p~0.25 at n=5) is real. Then weights {0.1, 2.0, 8.0} x anneal schedules at moderate scale. Null: no operating point moves Jaccard in the correct direction. NOT eliminated by 956 (only w=0.5 ever measured).

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-969 RESULT (2026-09-02) -- LEG STAYS ALIVE, NOT ADJUDICATED. Phase B carries no untrained arm at its own seeds and is graded against Phase A's disjoint 10-seed pool (mean 0.85); the same instrument reads 0.400 (956, 971) / 0.4167 (970) on the Phase-B seed family, so the reported deltas are cross-seed-set. Phase A's paired sign test returned p=1.0, the maximum the test can produce, with 8 of 10 seeds tied at delta 0. Two weight settings 20x apart (w=0.1, w=2.0) gave bit-identical per-seed DV vectors. The gating criterion WAS attainable at the observed baseline, so this is a data/instrument failure rather than an unreachable bar -- but no operating-point conclusion is licensed. See failure_autopsy_contextmemory-write-content-cluster_2026-09-03.

hypotheses.label: No standalone write-side auxiliary loss suffices; content conditioning needs the READ path's task gradient through write selection
hypotheses.desc: Couple the SD-016 read-path retrieval loss through write selection (straight-through) so end-task pressure reaches the tagger. Null: coupled training still fails the margin. If confirmed, the frame 'train the tagger with a standalone auxiliary loss' is wrong.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-971 RESULT (2026-09-02) -- LEG STAYS ALIVE, NOT ADJUDICATED; its 'null confirmed' label is not supportable. The load-bearing criterion is a bare mean-margin comparison at n=5 with no permutation test and no multiplicity correction -- the exact reading both sibling drivers demote to non-gating on this DV (measured FPR 25-68% in 969, ~15% in 970). Independently the objective did not train: the coupling loss ROSE across training (0.6273 -> 0.6514) while the untrained arm fell slightly, so a null cannot be attributed to the mechanism. The trained arm collapsed toward the single-slot regime the substrate entry exists to prevent (entropy 3.97 -> 0.79-1.48 bits; self_repeat 0.06 -> 0.71-0.88). See failure_autopsy_contextmemory-write-content-cluster_2026-09-03.

hypotheses.label: Train-time z_world under-differentiation (SD-008 ~0.98-cosine cone) leaves no usable content structure for ANY write-side objective
hypotheses.desc: Instrument train-time content structure: record pairwise-cosine distribution / cluster separability of the actual write-stream latents during training alongside the tagger's selections (un-instrumented in the 956 manifest). Null: latents carry separable structure the tagger ignores (which refocuses on H1/H3).

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-972 RESULT (2026-09-02) -- LEG STAYS ALIVE but is now the BEST-SUPPORTED of the four. Its PASS is explicitly a measurement-validity gate, not a scientific verdict (the driver says 'do not read passed: true here as H4 refuted'). The measurement is substantive and first-of-kind: train-time write-stream latents sit in a narrow cone -- intra-class cosine 0.980 (safe) / 0.971 (dangerous) against inter-class 0.948, mean separability 0.0281 over 5 seeds. Safe and dangerous states are very nearly collinear, so there is little content structure for any write-side objective to condition on. The direction is well-evidenced; the threshold crossing rests on a floor the manifest itself calls not rigorously derived, and the leg has no comparator arm. See failure_autopsy_contextmemory-write-content-cluster_2026-09-03.

Instrument caveat: the decisive/near-tie split is a per-seed MEDIAN split on a distribution whose median sits 1-2 orders below its mean in 4/6 seeds, so 'decisive' is not a confident regime; and divergence rate is only weakly stratum-dependent (|decisive - near_tie| under 0.03 in 7 of 12 cells, max 0.1031).

hypotheses.label: the noise floor anneals selectively in confident states
hypotheses.desc: MECH-440 leg (iii): the confidence-EMA anneal suppresses divergence in DECISIVE states relative to an anneal-off arm by >=0.05 absolute, while leaving near-tie divergence within 0.10 -- selective suppression, not a uniform reduction.

resolution.basis: Eliminated on the STRATIFICATION-INDEPENDENT whole-arm null: a real ~21% sigma reduction (sigma_scale_mean 0.7861 ANNEAL vs 1.0 NO_ANNEAL) moves yoked_divergence_frac by 9.1e-4 (0.76299 vs 0.76390), with ANNEAL higher on 4 seeds and lower on 2. synthesis.text: MECH-440 leg (i) PROPAGATION holds (V3-EXQ-955, separate question). Leg (iii) SELF-ANNEALING is eliminated on V3-EXQ-959's whole-arm null. Leg (ii) STATE-CONDITIONING missed its bar but trends the predicted way in 4/6 seeds and remains the surviving open work -- it needs an ABSOLUTE decisiveness stratifier rather than a median split, and a manipulation-engagement gate.

questions.title: After SD-e1 ITEM 1's action-conditioned transition landed, which locus explains E1's RESIDUAL per-action crush -- the evaluator statistic still sitting 25-37x short of its 0.1 bar?

hypotheses.label: the action-free transition INTERFACE is the binding locus
hypotheses.desc: E1's transition took no action, so the whole action signal was squeezed through one world_dim-wide prior_generator projection with the z_self LSTM slot zeroed. Supplying a dedicated action channel (ITEM 1) is therefore sufficient to restore evaluator-grade per-action discriminability.
hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-954 confirmed action-blindness as the dominant cause of the 108b evaluator collapse; the design doc makes the interface fix ITEM 1.

resolution.basis: ITEM 1 landed and demonstrably works -- the direct actions= channel produces real per-action divergence at the E1 output on a trained model (ON arms 1.46e-03..2.19e-03 mean pairwise L2 against an A_off arm at EXACTLY 0.0), lifting cr_ratio(h=1) 6455x-9775x from 4.14e-07/4.05e-07 to 2.67e-03..3.96e-03. But the residual crush REMAINS: cr_ratio(h=1) is still 25-37x short of the 0.1 bar and e1coe_score_var 5-7 orders below 0.002, against a healthy horizon-matched denominator (CR_real 0.17-0.26, n=40 at h=1). So the interface was necessary and is NOT sufficient -- it does not explain the residual. Control: A_off reproduces V3-EXQ-954's own cr_ratio(h=1) 4.76e-07/5.39e-07 to within ~15-25%. Adjudicated by confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-965_2026-08-30, whose verdict rests on the run's recorded pairwise/cr_ratio data and NOT on its own unsound C1 criterion.

hypotheses.label: the ABSOLUTE output parameterisation is the binding locus
hypotheses.desc: E1's output_proj predicts the absolute next state, where E2 uses a residual z + delta(z, a) form. The residual per-action crush is a parameterisation artifact: an absolute-state head must reproduce the whole state, so a small action-dependent delta is swamped at the output.
hypotheses.basis: Live and now activated by V3-EXQ-965: the doc's stated precondition for testing it is met. Declared null: a residual parameterisation leaves cr_ratio(h=1) within noise of 2.67e-03..3.96e-03. Gate on cr_ratio(h=1) against 0.1 and raw per-action divergence against E2's 2.8e-2 reference -- NEVER an ON/OFF ratio against an analytically-zero control (the V3-EXQ-965 C1 defect).

resolution.basis:
PRE-REGISTRATION (retained verbatim): Live and now activated by V3-EXQ-965: the doc's stated precondition for testing it is met. Declared null: a residual parameterisation leaves cr_ratio(h=1) within noise of 2.67e-03..3.96e-03. Gate on cr_ratio(h=1) against 0.1 and raw per-action divergence against E2's 2.8e-2 reference -- NEVER an ON/OFF ratio against an analytically-zero control (the V3-EXQ-965 C1 defect).

V3-EXQ-968 RESULT (2026-09-01) -- LEG STAYS ALIVE. The run adjudicated this leg and did NOT narrow it. Its self-routed 'residual_no_material_difference' is a threshold artifact, not a null: the arms genuinely differed (4 distinct arm_fingerprints, flag plumbed driver:347 -> config.py:8077 -> e1_deep.py:629,957,975) and the effect is large and opposite in sign across seeds -- seed 42 lift 2.2108, seed 123 inverse lift 2.9443, both narrowly missing the same 3.0 bar (the latter by 1.86%) in OPPOSITE directions, giving n_exceeds=0 and n_below=0 and falling through to the driver's final else: branch. The 3.0 bar is floor-bound from a 2-sample noise estimate. No discrimination was produced and the elimination bar is not met, so state remains alive. Note the pre-registration's own warning was NOT the defect this time -- 968's arms are real -- but its successor still needs a noise floor estimated from more than 2 samples. See failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-968-871b_2026-09-02 (confirmed).

hypotheses.label: the single-step MSE training OBJECTIVE is the binding locus
hypotheses.desc: The crush is in what the LSTM learned, not in how the output is parameterised: a single-step MSE objective never penalises multi-step per-action divergence collapse, so only a multi-step rollout-consistency objective (SD-e1 ITEM 2) moves cr_ratio(h).
hypotheses.basis: The design doc's ITEM 2, with five lit-grounded candidates ranked in the commissioned literature synthesis; V3-EXQ-954's red-team localised the dominant ~675x crush at the LSTM+output_proj stage, which an interface change alone was not expected to reach.

resolution.basis:
PRE-REGISTRATION (retained verbatim): Live. Cheapest probe is scheduled multi-step unrolling (DaD, no architecture change). Declared null: DaD alone leaves cr_ratio(h) flat -- which the design doc already predicts ('not expected to move C3 alone') and which would promote candidate 1 (TD-MPC-style multi-step latent consistency). Same absolute gating bars as H-outputproj-parameterisation.

V3-EXQ-976 RESULT (2026-09-02) -- LEG STAYS ALIVE, NARROWED AND WEAKENED. Candidate 1 itself (rollout_consistency_loss, H=5, flat and decay-0.5 forms, genuinely trained) was run directly, skipping DaD. Self-route rollout_consistency_mixed_across_seeds, accurate: rc_flat cr_ratio(h=1) lift over the depth-0 incumbent 0.88/5.75/3.35/1.87 (2 of 4 >= 3.0, 0 below; sign p=0.31), rc_decay 1.17/2.77/4.14/0.30; no cell within 7.9x of the 0.1 bar. At depth the objective DAMPS per-action divergence growth (8/8 ON cells grow less than OFF). Non-discriminating non_contributory: neither eliminated (a weak h=1 positive is consistent with it) nor confirmed (no bar progress); the damping is evidence against its trajectory-ACCURACY form and for the divergence-class sibling H-objective-class-divergence. Applied 2026-09-03 from the hypothesis_space_ledger_pending block of failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-976_2026-09-02, which drafted it under the staging rule and could not write the registry.

V3-EXQ-1000 (2026-09-03) bears on this leg by read-across: the OBJECTIVE is confirmed as the locus of the cr_ratio crush, but in its divergence-preserving form (sibling H-objective-class-divergence, confirmed), not in this leg's multi-step ACCURACY form (ITEM 2 arm re-run here as ARM_RC_DECAY: mixed again, 2/6 exceed 1/6 below, h1->h5 growth 0.83-1.50 vs OFF 2.5-5.5 -- damping replicated at n=6). Leg left alive as the accuracy-form residual; H-objective-horizon-budget remains its untested refinement.

hypotheses.label: no trajectory-ACCURACY objective un-crushes; a divergence-preserving SEQUENCE objective is required
hypotheses.desc: The LSTM+output_proj crush is a property that trajectory-accuracy losses (single-step or multi-step, flat or discounted) are indifferent-to-hostile to: they pull the rollout toward ONE observed trajectory and so damp divergence across candidate action sequences. Only an objective that directly rewards endpoint divergence across candidate sequences (the withheld e1_rollout_sequence_divergence_* contrastive) moves cr_ratio(h). Distinct from H-training-objective by the accuracy-vs-divergence split the substrate entry's why_not_contrastive draws.
hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-976: the H=5 accuracy objective damps depth growth of per-action spread on 8/8 ON cells (OFF x2.6-3.8 h1->h5 vs ON x0.5-1.75) while producing at most a weak h=1 bump -- the first measurement of the mechanism why_not_contrastive named as intuition. Declared null: a contrastive-trained ON arm within the 3.0 paired-lift band of a depth-0 single-step incumbent at h=1 AND with depth growth no larger than the incumbent's, n>=6 seeds.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-1000 (2026-09-03) CONFIRMED this leg: its declared null ('a contrastive-trained ON arm within the 3.0 paired-lift band of a depth-0 single-step incumbent at h=1 AND with depth growth no larger than the incumbent's, n>=6') is rejected on the first clause by 1-3 orders of magnitude -- ARM_RSD cr_ratio(h=1) lift over ARM_OFF 693/1838/56/88/1457/2714 on seeds 42/123/7/2024/17/31 (6/6 >= 3.0, sign p=0.0156), absolute 0.771-1.81 clearing the 0.1 bar 6/6 by 7.7x-18x, the statistic this question's title names. Control passed (8/8 readiness incl. rsd_objective_engaged 100% and action-sensitivity ratio 1.32-1.52 vs floor 1.05, grad steps matched gap 0), non_degenerate true. The second clause (depth growth) is moot: RSD sits at cr_ratio ~1 from h=1 so its multiplicative growth (0.83-2.68) is below OFF's (2.5-5.5) while its absolute h=5 values (0.64-4.41) exceed OFF's (0.002-0.10) by 22x-2070x. The lift is real at the spread level (RSD 0.15-0.24 vs OFF 2e-04..8e-03), not only in the ratio; the ratio is inflated by a centroid shrink (norm 0.54-0.81 vs incumbents 1.41-2.17) and the centroid-corrected h=1 ratio 0.115/0.081/0.080/0.167/0.138/0.103 still clears 0.1 on 4/6 seeds. What this run does NOT settle: the goal-proximity readout (e1coe_score_var, 36x-1700x short) -- a different statistic, registered as the new question sd_e1_var_bar_readout_crush. Adjudicated by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1000_2026-09-04.

hypotheses.label: the evaluator's hybrid E1/E2 rollout regime suppresses E1-side divergence at depth (MECH-135 consumer question)
hypotheses.desc: From h=2 the C3 evaluator re-primes z_self from E2 each step and re-computes E1's prior/context from the hybrid state, while every E1 objective trains E1's own autoregressive map (predict_long_horizon: prior once, own total fed back). The maps coincide exactly at h=1 (where the bars are read) and differ after. Hypothesis: the hybrid regime suppresses per-action divergence an E1 objective produces at depth, so the 30-step endpoint consumer would under-read even a divergence-preserving objective. NOT a claim that the evaluator is blind to E1.
hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-976 measurement row; the readout was never computed in the lineage (all six drivers use the hybrid scorer). Declared null: on the same trained cells, the ON-vs-OFF depth-growth contrast under an E1-alone rollout readout (predict_long_horizon on the identical 40 sequences) matches the hybrid readout's (damping in both).

resolution.basis:
V3-EXQ-980 (2026-09-02) ELIMINATED this leg: its declared null held with a real margin. Because the hybrid and E1-alone readouts are bit-identical at h=1 on all 16 cells, growth_e1alone(h) = growth_hybrid(h) x r(h) exactly; a flip to 'not damped' required r_ON/r_OFF in 1.828-7.975 and the measured ratio was 0.4922-0.9200 on every one of the 16 decision cells -- the E1-alone readout moved every cell 2.52x-10.99x FURTHER into damped. Verdict 8/8 damped under both readouts on both ON arms, on a healthy substrate (2,614-2,705 grad steps per cell, gap 0 every seed; grad_cos_samples 262-271; cr_real_h1 0.20-0.27 against a 1e-4 floor; zero missing action calls). The evaluator's hybrid regime is therefore NOT what suppresses E1-side divergence at depth. Bounded by three disclosed caveats: the run's PASS token is assigned unconditionally on readiness; its hybrid half is a byte-identical re-emission of V3-EXQ-976 rather than an independent sample; and a 109x readout discrepancy in the discriminating direction sits on ARM_single_step_stateful seed2024, an anchor arm no criterion reads and which the 976 autopsy had already flagged as ~100x action-insensitive. Adjudicated by confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-980_2026-09-03.

Read-across from V3-EXQ-1000 (2026-09-03): on the divergence-preserving ARM_RSD the hybrid-vs-E1-alone sign at h=30 is MIXED (hybrid 0.022/5.69/0.49/3.13/1.34/3.94 vs E1-alone 0.67/3.47/4.69/2.98/5.75/3.44 on seeds 42/123/7/2024/17/31) and seed 42's hybrid rollout collapses from h=10. 980's elimination stands on its own arms; its sign-extrapolation clause to contrastive objectives does not.

hypotheses.label: candidate 1 is right in kind but under-dosed (H=5, 100 episodes)
hypotheses.desc: Refinement of H-training-objective: the multi-step accuracy objective moves per-action divergence only at a horizon near the evaluator's (H -> 30) and/or a converged budget; 976's H=5 default and still-falling training loss (last/first fifth 0.49-0.73) did not test the leg. Weakened a priori by 976's damping signature, which predicts more dose damps more.
hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-976 scope statement ('says nothing about other horizons or budgets'); trained_loss_last_over_first_fifth 0.49-0.73 on every routed cell; supervision-volume asymmetry declared as the manipulation. Declared null: no (H, budget) cell in {5,30} x {100,400} lifts cr_ratio(h=1) >= 3.0 on a majority of >=6 seeds against a supervision-matched OFF cell.

questions.title: Why is the REE latent not a foraging-adequate representation for an external actor -- has the consumer failed to learn the mapping from z_world to action, or is the required structure inaccessible in z_world's geometry?
questions.lineage_note: Opened as its OWN qid rather than growing `competence_floor`, which matches these claims exactly but is CLOSED TO FURTHER FAN-OUT. That restriction directs precisely this case: 'a claim whose depends_on includes MECH-457, MECH-459, MECH-460, MECH-475, or MECH-476 ... should instead pre-register its OWN qid -- UNLESS the specific mechanism under test targets an axis family this qid's decision block still lists as undecided (there is currently none...)'. No exception applies, and the growth-restriction check was surfaced to the user at the /failure-autopsy Step 8 gate on 2026-09-03, who chose a new qid. This question is also genuinely distinct from competence_floor's (which asks what governs RETENTION of installed competence): it asks where the actor-adequacy deficit LIVES. RELATED: conversion_ceiling_root's H-observation-interface is already `confirmed` -- 'the REE latent is not a foraging-adequate representation for an external actor' -- on V3-EXQ-813 + V3-EXQ-948. This qid refines that confirmed leg by asking WHY, and exists because that confirmation was obtained with a PPO (reinforcement-learning) actor, which cannot separate the two readings below.

hypotheses.label: Consumer/readout learning failure
hypotheses.desc: The directional information in z_world is in an adequately usable form, and the downstream consumer has simply failed to learn the mapping from that representation to action. Predicts: a simple SUPERVISED reader on the frozen latent CAN reproduce oracle actions, and the deficit is in the RL consumer's learning rather than in the representation.
hypotheses.basis: Live. V3-EXQ-978 established that the field is linearly decodable from z_world with the auxiliary loss OFF (r2 0.70991 sense-path, 0.85838 encoder-path), which weakens the simple information-loss reading but does not distinguish this hypothesis from H-C. Named as reading B in the user's 2026-09-03 thought document docs/thoughts/2026-09-03_temporary_coordinated_representational_transformations.md section 8, which records it as 'the most important simple alternative' and says it 'should be tested before introducing richer architecture'.

resolution.basis: The registered live_gate ran. A capacity-matched supervised adapter (x734.PPOPolicyNet, 21381 action-path parameters -- the class and width V3-EXQ-978 used as its reader) trained by cross-entropy on the oracle's action at every visited state, with credit assignment removed entirely, reaches only 0.6695/0.6735/0.6478 held-out agreement from the frozen z_world: 0 of 3 seeds against a 0.80 bar, and 0 of 3 against the paired untrained control. The same adapter on the same steps reaches 0.9846/0.9796/0.9730 from the raw 25-dim field. H-B predicts the supervised reader CAN reproduce the oracle; it cannot. Discriminating non_contributory: the verdict arm sits sub-floor against a PASSING reference band, every readiness gate is green (per_arm_gate.all_green, dv_headroom green) and criteria_non_degenerate is true, so the full elimination bar is met. Uncontested by the Step 7c cross-model red-team pass.

hypotheses.label: Representational mismatch (information present, geometry unusable)
hypotheses.desc: The directional information is technically recoverable but the current geometry does not make the relationships required by action selection accessible under the actual learning dynamics. Predicts: a simple SUPERVISED reader on the frozen latent CANNOT reproduce oracle actions despite strong generic decoding, and a task-/candidate-conditioned transformation could improve behavioural accessibility without increasing total information content.
hypotheses.basis: Live. Same evidential position as H-B: V3-EXQ-978 does not distinguish them (stated verbatim at section 8 of the user's 2026-09-03 thought document: 'V3-EXQ-978 does not distinguish B from C'). Named there as reading C.

resolution.basis: CONFIRMED at the registered live_gate, on a CAVEATED basis (user decision, Step 8 gate 2026-09-05). The gate is verbatim 'CANNOT reproduce -> H-C' (this question's decision.live_gate). A capacity-matched supervised adapter (x734.PPOPolicyNet, 21381 action-path parameters -- the class and width V3-EXQ-978 used as its reader), trained by cross-entropy on the oracle's action at every visited state with credit assignment removed entirely, could NOT reproduce the oracle from the frozen z_world: 0.6695/0.6735/0.6478 held-out, 0 of 3 seeds against a 0.80 bar, while the identical adapter on the identical steps reached 0.9846/0.9796/0.9730 from the raw 25-dim resource_field_view. Every readiness gate is green (per_arm_gate.all_green, red_arms [], vacuous_arms [], dv_headroom green) and criteria_non_degenerate is true on all four criteria, so control_passed is true. THE CAVEAT, recorded here rather than by holding the leg open: the run's only 32-dimensional comparator is zworld_untrained, an UNTRAINED random NONLINEAR compression of the SAME input, and it TIES with -- in fact slightly beats -- the verdict arm (0.664 vs 0.688; off at or below untrained on 3/3 held-out seeds). So the 'THIS latent's LEARNED geometry' gloss is NOT established by this run. The deficit may instead be a property of the 250 -> 32 CHANNEL INPUT (the encoder reads the full 250-dim world_state, of which the 25-dim resource_field_view is 10%), in which case no rotation of z_world recovers it. THE OWED INFORMATION-PRESERVING ROTATION/REWEIGHTING CORROBORATOR IS THE TEST OF THIS LEG: a flat result there WEAKENS this confirmed leg (registry states are not terminal), and the parallel H-E-channel-input-capacity leg can weaken it independently. met_elimination_bar is false precisely because that corroborator is owed. RECORDED AND WITHDRAWN: the staged draft held this leg `alive` on the argument that C_untrained_control_below_bar is 'inverted relative to its own stated purpose'. That argument is WITHDRAWN. The conjunct's documented purpose -- in the driver's ARMS section, the manifest's interpretation.question, and the C_verdict_arm_beats_untrained_control description -- is attribution TO THE WARMUP ('whether any actionability found is creditable to SD-018's warmup') plus a guard against a spurious H-C via a collapsed comparator, and for that purpose its sign is correct; the phrase 'rather than to 32 dimensions of anything cannot do it' is loose English and incoherent as written (32 > 25 field dims, and the encoder's input is 250 dims), i.e. a wording defect in the driver rather than a licence to reopen a pre-registered gate.

hypotheses.label: The deficit is upstream of the learned geometry -- the encoder CHANNEL, not what the warmup wrote into it
hypotheses.desc: The actor-adequacy deficit is not attributable to what V3-EXQ-978's (SD-018/SD-070 P0a) warmup wrote into z_world: the SD-018 warmup does not account for the ~0.30 deficit to the raw-field ceiling. On the PRE-REGISTERED standardised instrument the warmed latent is consistently slightly WORSE than an untrained projection of the same input on fittability (training-split agreement -0.067 mean, final CE +0.150, participation ratio 0.53x) and no better held-out (3/3 seeds, mean -0.024) -- differences an order of magnitude smaller than the deficit itself. Whatever blocks the representation-to-action mapping is therefore a property of the observation-to-z_world channel already present before any warmup gradient is applied. Predicts: interventions on the warmup OBJECTIVE (more directional supervision, different auxiliary weights, longer P0a) move the action readout by amounts at or inside the seed spread, exactly as V3-EXQ-978's own ON-vs-OFF null did on the decode readout.
hypotheses.basis: This run's own cells, three seeds, four readouts, recomputed independently at the Step 7c cross-model red-team pass. zworld_off vs zworld_untrained: held-out 0.6695/0.6735/0.6478 vs 0.6876/0.6817/0.6947 (mean -0.0244, 2.3x the pooled within-arm seed SD, 0/3 seeds off-ahead); TRAINING SPLIT 0.7658/0.7597/0.7518 vs 0.8277/0.8285/0.8214 (mean -0.0668 at 11.7x the pooled seed spread, 0/3); final standardised CE +0.145/+0.150/+0.157 (17.7x, off worse); random-driven 0.5724/0.6018/0.6105 vs 0.6132/0.6361/0.6312 (0/3); turn states 2/3 (seed 43 off ahead by +0.0185). Raw field on the same steps 0.9846/0.9796/0.9730, i.e. ~0.30 above BOTH z arms on every readout -- an order of magnitude larger than the trained-vs-untrained gap. Participation ratio 4.57/4.22/5.67 vs 7.49/10.31/10.01 (0.53x, preprocessing-invariant, same direction). The SECONDARY unstandardised readout reverses the sign (off 0.5345/0.5425/0.5532 vs untrained 0.4939/0.4672/0.5384) but is PRE-REGISTERED by the driver as NON-OVERRIDING ('the primary (standardised) number is the one that answers the actual question, because it is the one with the scaling explanation removed') AND sits BELOW the trivial repeat-previous-action baseline on 3/3 seeds on BOTH z arms (0.5661/0.5803/0.5720; unstandardised CE 1.048-1.170 against ln 5 = 1.609), i.e. that adapter did not converge on either arm and its ordering carries no sign. Converges with V3-EXQ-978's independent finding that the SD-018 ON leg moved the latent two to three orders below the seed spread. What this does NOT license: the grid's untrained_projection_clears_warmed_arm_does_not cell requires the untrained arm to CLEAR the absolute bar, and it does not (0.688 < 0.80).

resolution.basis: Confirmed as a NECESSARY-not-sufficient reading on a LABELLED FAN-OUT leg (invariant 3a), NOT a Mode C discovery. Invariant 3a(a) is satisfied by GIT WITNESS: 'the warmup is not the locus' was named in writing -- 'Nobody reading hypothesis_verdict alone can tell trained latent is no more actionable than a random projection (a real finding about the WARMUP) from z_world lacks accessible directional structure (the registered H-C)' -- in evidence/planning/exq1002_redteam_findings_20260904.md, first committed ac85c048a2 on 2026-09-04 19:45 +0100 (18:45Z), about 6 h BEFORE the run resolved (2026-09-05T00:50:17Z) and ~50 min before it started. Mode C is therefore the WRONG door: the rival was anticipated (the driver's own _adjudicate grid carries two warmup-locus cells, zworld_supports_mapping_but_warmup_non_contributory and untrained_projection_clears_warmed_arm_does_not, and the manifest's interpretation.question names the untrained arm as an ATTRIBUTION axis), so discovery growth's born-not-anticipated condition fails and using it would be the escape-hatch the discovery_growth invariant explicitly forbids. What the leg establishes is that the warmup is not the LOCUS of the ~0.30 deficit -- not WHICH property of the channel is, which is what the parallel H-E-channel-input-capacity leg asks -- so met_elimination_bar is false.

hypotheses.label: The deficit is a channel-INPUT bottleneck (250 -> 32), not this latent's learned geometry
hypotheses.desc: A 32-dim random or PCA projection of the FULL 250-dim world_state (the encoder's actual input; the 25-dim resource_field_view is 10% of it) through the same adapter on the same banked dataset cannot reproduce the oracle -- i.e. the deficit is a channel-INPUT bottleneck property, not this latent's learned geometry. Predicts: that projection also fails the 0.80 bar, as zworld_untrained (a random NONLINEAR compression of the same 250 dims) already does at 0.688. If H-E holds, H-C's confirmed 'learned geometry' gloss is unsupportable, the owed rotation corroborator is a foregone null, and the route is instrument/interface redesign rather than a geometry build. Sanity anchor only and explicitly NOT a gate: a 32-dim projection of the 25-dim resource_field_view ALONE is expected to clear -- any injective linear map R^25 -> R^32 composed with the adapter's Linear(32,128) first layer spans exactly the Linear(25,128) function class, so the positive control's own 0.973-0.985 function is representable and the null could only fire through an optimisation artefact. That is why the staged draft's 25-dim-field specification of this leg (a rank-preserving re-basis of the positive control, with an unrealisable declared null) is DROPPED and replaced by this one.
hypotheses.basis: Live because V3-EXQ-1002 cannot exclude it, and the operative fact is the INPUT dimensionality, not the latent. ree-v3/ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py: world_obs_dim = 250 under use_proxy_fields=True (local_view 175 + contamination 25 + hazard_field 25 + resource_field 25), with resource_field_view = world_state[225:250]; the manifest's config.env_kwargs has no landmarks and reef_enabled false, so 250 applies. v3_exq_737's _agent_zworld passes the whole 250-dim world_state to agent.sense, and sense-time z_world is (world_encoder(w) + world_topdown(beta_to_split(z_beta))) * prec. So zworld_untrained is a random NONLINEAR compression of 250 dims (plus a body/topdown term) into 32, in which the field is 10% of the input: its failing at 0.688 is evidence about the CHANNEL INPUT bottleneck (250 -> 32 with no pressure to isolate the field), NOT about '32 dimensions of this observation'. No run to date carries a 32-dim reference of that 250-dim input under an optimal LINEAR compression, so this reading and the confirmed H-C leg are currently confounded.
adjudicating_runs: (unqueued) new EXQ number, leg 1: 32-dim random-Gaussian/PCA projection of the full 250-dim world_state through the V3-EXQ-1002 x734.PPOPolicyNet adapter on V3-EXQ-1002's banked BC dataset and standardiser

resolution.basis: Not yet adjudicated -- the discriminating control is designed (fanout_recommendation probe 1, PARALLEL leg 1 of 2) and deliberately unqueued by this session.

synthesis.surviving_label: H-C geometry-mismatch (confirmed, caveated) + H-D warmup-not-the-locus (confirmed); H-E channel-input capacity alive; H-B consumer-learning eliminated
synthesis.text: As of V3-EXQ-1002 the actor-adequacy deficit is located on the REPRESENTATION side of the observation-to-action interface, and not in the consumer. With credit assignment removed entirely and the reader held at the consumer's exact capacity, the local_view_greedy oracle's policy is recoverable from the raw 25-dim observation at 0.979 held-out agreement and from the frozen 32-dim z_world at 0.664 -- a gap of ~0.31 on identical steps, replicated on a random-driven state distribution and on a shortcut-free turn-state subset. H-B (consumer learning) is ELIMINATED and H-C (geometry mismatch) is CONFIRMED at its registered gate. Two things the run does not settle are recorded rather than glossed. First, the deficit is not what the SD-018/P0a warmup wrote: on the pre-registered standardised instrument the warmed latent is no better than, and consistently slightly worse than, an untrained projection of the same input (H-D, confirmed) -- by an amount an order of magnitude smaller than the deficit itself. Second, the encoder's actual input is the full 250-dim world_state, of which the 25-dim field is 10%, so the run's only 32-dim comparator is itself a compression of that input and its failure is equally consistent with a 250 -> 32 channel-INPUT bound (H-E, alive) that no rotation of z_world could fix; H-C's confirmed label therefore carries a caveated basis and an owed corroborator. A parallel two-leg portfolio on the banked dataset separates them: a 32-dim projection of the full world_state, and an information-preserving re-basis of the frozen latent. Biologically the shape is a missing prerequisite rather than a falsification: DiCarlo-style untangling says a code can carry information a simple readout cannot use until a cascade whose job is reshaping has separated the behaviourally relevant manifolds, and z_world is trained for sensory prediction with no pressure to untangle the action-relevant variable and no separate action-formatted stream for an actor to read.
synthesis.under_test: Parallel two-leg portfolio owed (new EXQ): 250-dim world_state 32-dim projection control (H-E, instrumentation) + information-preserving rotation/reweighting corroborator (H-C, representation), both on the banked V3-EXQ-1002 dataset with the same adapter. Not yet queued.

decision.decision_question: Is the z_world actor-adequacy deficit located in the consumer's learning of a representation-to-action mapping (H-B, ELIMINATED 2026-09-05), in the accessibility of the required structure within z_world's learned geometry (H-C, CONFIRMED 2026-09-05 at its registered gate on a caveated basis, corroborator owed), or in the observation-to-latent CHANNEL itself -- either upstream of anything the warmup wrote (H-D, CONFIRMED) or as a 250 -> 32 channel-input bound that no rotation could fix (H-E, ALIVE)?
decision.live_gate: A PARALLEL two-leg portfolio on V3-EXQ-1002's banked BC dataset, adapter and standardiser -- NOT an ordered chain, and neither leg conditional on the other. LEG 1 (instrumentation axis, adjudicates H-E): a 32-dim random-Gaussian and/or PCA projection of the FULL 250-dim world_state -- the encoder's actual input, optionally plus body_state to mirror the topdown term -- fitted on the training split, read by the same x734.PPOPolicyNet adapter. Declared null: it also fails the 0.80 bar. CLEARS -> H-E eliminated; an optimal linear 250 -> 32 compression preserves what the task needs, the deficit is specific to the REE encoder channel, and H-C's learned-geometry gloss survives. DOES NOT CLEAR -> H-E confirmed; the deficit is a channel-input bound and H-C is weakened to its narrow gate sense. LEG 2 (representation axis, corroborates or weakens the confirmed H-C): an information-preserving rotation/reweighting of the frozen z_world (whitening, decision-relevant reweighting, or a train-split-fitted supervised linear re-basis), same adapter. Declared null: agreement is flat under a separability-improving, information-preserving re-basis; a flat result WEAKENS the confirmed H-C leg, a lift corroborates it. NOT YET QUEUED -- new EXQ number, not a lettered V3-EXQ-1002b (refused by the re-derive brake).
decision.distance_phrase: Decided on the registered question (H-B eliminated, H-C confirmed); one parallel two-leg portfolio away on the residual attribution, both legs on already-banked data with no ree_core change, no new warmup family and no contract-gate exposure.
decision.observation_bottleneck: No run carries a 32-dim reference of the encoder's ACTUAL input -- the full 250-dim world_state -- known to be able to clear the bar, and no run applies an information-preserving re-basis to the frozen z_world. Until one of those exists, the confirmed H-C leg's 'learned geometry' gloss and a 250 -> 32 channel-input bound remain confounded. Note the correction this records: V3-EXQ-1002's untrained control IS a 32-dim comparator, but of the 250-dim input, and it fails -- which is evidence for the channel-input reading rather than against it.

questions.title: Is hazard-detection sensitivity an interior-optimum function of the E3 heartbeat rate, and is any avoidance readout in CausalGridWorldV2 capable of showing it?

hypotheses.label: The avoidance readout cannot express the contrast
hypotheses.desc: avoidant-rate(HIGH) - avoidant-rate(SAFE) with the response defined as the away-from-hazard geometric argmax has no signal/noise asymmetry; a measured perfect avoider scores +0.0000 and policy-free nulls score -0.06 to -0.44, so the statistic cannot certify avoidance at any threshold above zero.
hypotheses.basis: Oracle and null probes run for this autopsy against the driver's own readout, same env config and seeds (facts_V3-EXQ-999.md sections 8b/8c). Live because the decisive question -- does a VALID readout reveal avoidance in the same agents -- is unrun.

hypotheses.label: Hazard-avoidant behaviour is genuinely absent
hypotheses.desc: _train_warmup trains e1, the e2 world-forward model and the e3 harm_eval head and no action policy on harm; NAV_BIAS=0.25 overrides a quarter of training actions toward the hazard. There may be no avoidance for any readout to find.
hypotheses.basis: Direct read of the driver's training loop; no run in the corpus has ever demonstrated trained hazard avoidance on this bed. Live and untested.

hypotheses.label: The environment provides no usable low-hazard contrast band
hypotheses.desc: With hazard_field_view normalised by the global max, one hazard and decay 0.5, SAFE (<0.15) means Manhattan d>=12 -- unreachable for a centred hazard on a 10x10 grid and a far-corner wedge otherwise (measured 1.1-2.2% of non-wall cells), where the designated avoidant action is a wall no-op in 93-100% of steps.
hypotheses.basis: Field arithmetic plus a 40-reset census run for this autopsy (facts_V3-EXQ-999.md section 8a). Live because it is a separate, independently repairable cause from the readout definition.

questions.title: Is the z_block BLOCK-vs-CONTROL elevation the external-attribution computation MECH-353 claims, and does it dissociate from z_harm_a?

decision.decision_question: May MECH-353's v3_pending be cleared -- i.e. is z_block an established distinct affect stream rather than a relabelled outcome-mismatch signal?
decision.live_gate: Leg H3 resolved (z_harm_a free to vary and z_block separates from it) AND leg H1-vs-H2 resolved in favour of H1 (the external-attribution gate is load-bearing) AND the assert-vs-withdraw pole contrast instantiated.
decision.distance_phrase: One correctly-configured re-run away for H1/H2/H3 -- V3-EXQ-642d, carrying a hazards arm, a self-attributable-cancellation arm and a per-tick series. The H1-vs-H2 half is NOT free reanalysis: 642c recorded counts, not series, so no confusion matrix is derivable from it, and a confusion matrix alone would not separate H1 from H2 anyway. The claim's own decision question is a further design away (the capacity-collapse contrast), and that one is DEFERRED behind 642d.
decision.observation_bottleneck: TWO bottlenecks, and the second is prior and decisive. (i) The validating environment pins num_hazards=0, so the dissociation partner cannot vary and z_harm_a separation is identically 0.000. (ii) WITHDRAW IS UNREPRESENTABLE in the family's action space: every 642-family driver runs at action_dim=4 while blocked_agency_noop_class defaults to 0, which CausalGridWorldV2 maps to MOVE-UP, with the stay action at index 4 and unreachable -- so C3's action_rate has always scored 'fraction of steps not choosing move-up' and the consumer's ASSERT score-bias (blocked_agency.py:426) treats move-up as the passive option. The family's C3 has therefore NEVER measured the assert-vs-withdraw contrast, across 642 / 642a / 642b / 642c. This is recorded here as a CONFIGURATION FACT about the observation bed, deliberately NOT as a hypothesis leg: it was discovered by the Step 7c red-team from the driver source, not by the run's data, and it is not a rival explanation of anything -- adding it as a leg would inflate initial_frozen_count with a non-hypothesis. It is the reason MECH-353's v3_pending was HELD at the 2026-09-05 gate and the reason V3-EXQ-642d's action-space repair is its first spec item.

hypotheses.label: The baseline-relative outcome_mismatch floor gives z_block real dynamic range on a headroom statistic
hypotheses.desc: The V3-EXQ-642a defect was that a fixed absolute mismatch floor sat below the free-step baseline, pinning z_block at its cap in every condition. H0: the baseline-relative floor (ree-v3 d49db86f3e64670) fixes this, and a headroom DV (z_block_mean) separates BLOCK from CONTROL where the clamped peak cannot.
hypotheses.basis: Directly adjudicated by V3-EXQ-642c.

resolution.basis: C0 (the absolute readiness criterion) passed 3/3 at margins 0.601/0.547/0.498 vs floor 0.10, and C1 -- non-degenerate on the statistic it consumes -- passed 3/3 with separations 0.6805/0.5904/0.7709 against an a-priori 0.30 bar that rejects the un-calibrated 642a regime 3/3 (0.1650/0.1214/0.0831). confirmed, not eliminated: this establishes a necessary instrument, it does not close the question.

hypotheses.label: The separation is produced by the external-attribution gate selecting externally-cancelled steps
hypotheses.desc: The BLOCK-vs-CONTROL z_block_mean separation reflects MECH-353's claimed distinctive computation: mismatch attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint rather than to the agent's own motor error.
hypotheses.basis: Still live, and UNTOUCHED by V3-EXQ-642c. That run cannot separate H1 from H2 (its own pre-run red-team F2 concedes the design cannot distinguish an external block from a move cancelled by any means). Its control-arm firing rate of 6.1-15.1 pct is NOT evidence about this leg: the attribution (motor) clause was true on all 14400 measured ticks and never discriminated, so the false positives are mismatch-FLOOR crossings, not permissive attribution (Step 7c red-team F2). Adjudicated only by a self-attributable-cancellation arm, which is the only design that pushes motor_agency below the 0.5 attribution floor.
adjudicating_runs: V3-EXQ-642d (proposed) -- the SELF-ATTRIBUTABLE-cancellation arm specifically, not the main hazards contrast and not the confusion matrix alone

hypotheses.label: The separation is generic outcome-mismatch elevation; the external-attribution gate is not load-bearing
hypotheses.desc: Any sufficiently large action-outcome mismatch drives z_block, so a self-attributable cancellation (motor noise, execution failure) would produce the same elevation, and z_block is a relabelled surprise signal rather than a distinct attributional stream.
hypotheses.basis: Still live, and NOT supported by V3-EXQ-642c's control-arm false-positive rate -- that draft claim is withdrawn on Step 7c red-team F2c, since the FP rate is evidence about the mismatch floor and the attribution clause was never exercised. Discriminated from H1 only by a third, self-attributable-cancellation arm; the per-tick confusion matrix is a supporting readout and is not itself a discriminator (both hypotheses predict the same matrix in a design with no self-attributable cancellations).

hypotheses.label: With z_harm_a free to vary, z_block co-varies with it rather than dissociating
hypotheses.desc: MECH-353's registered distinctness predicate fails: under a block manipulation in a hazard-bearing environment, z_block and z_harm_a move together, so the blocked-agency stream is not separable from the harm stream and the claim is falsified on its own terms.
hypotheses.basis: Wholly untested. Every 642-family run to date pins num_hazards=0, so the measured z_harm_a separation is identically 0.000 and the dissociation criterion is algebraically inert -- the space has never contained an observation bearing on this leg.

questions.title: Now that the waypoint proximity field is decodable and behaviourally sufficient for a supervised reader (V3-EXQ-1004), where does the residual blockage on navigation-dependent subgoal_mode DVs live -- in the learning objective, or in REE's own observation-to-z_world interface?

hypotheses.label: Reward sparsity in the learning signal, not target perceptibility, is the residual blocker
hypotheses.desc: With the field ON and the consumer held fixed, varying ONLY the training signal (stock sparse waypoint reward vs shaped/proximity-credited vs demonstration-warm-started) moves visits/ep off the floor.
hypotheses.basis: UNTESTED leg. The V3-EXQ-1004 driver reports an A2C reader at 0.00 (OFF) / 0.10 (ON) visits/ep after 400 training episodes with the field available, and switched to behaviour cloning for that reason -- but that A2C figure is DOCSTRING-ONLY (seed 42 only, never committed to the repo, no manifest, no per-episode trace) and was measured BEFORE the SD-094 contamination gate, on a self-contaminating env where every arm ended health_depleted at 44-134 steps against a declared 400 and per-episode contamination (~-1.2) outweighed the waypoint reward (~+0.04) by 30:1, so not moving was reward-optimal -- it MOTIVATES the consumer-reach question, it is not evidence about it. The leg is live because the consumer question is genuinely open, not because evidence already points at sparsity.

hypotheses.label: The field does not survive REE's observation-to-z_world compression
hypotheses.desc: The pending waypoint's direction is linearly decodable from the raw observation with the field ON (0.575 -> 0.841 imitation accuracy, V3-EXQ-1004) but not from z_world, locating the loss at the encoder rather than at the environment.
hypotheses.basis: The field is the trailing 25 dims of a 275-dim world_state consumed by prefix-sliced encoders (latent/stack.py, latent/zworld_p0.py); [memory] project_v3_binding_constraint_observation_interface records the observation->z_world->E1/E2 interface as the binding V3 constraint on 39/43 nodes.

decision.live_gate: Both legs need a run; neither has an adjudicating experiment queued yet.

questions.title: Is separate optimisation of the three BG-like learning channels (sensory prediction / motor-sensory forward / harm-goal) REQUIRED for harm calibration, or is one shared channel differentiated at the readout sufficient?
questions.note_on_count: 4 = the retro-registered leg 1 (adjudicated `alive`/mixed by V3-EXQ-993a in the same edit; PROVENANCE FLAG: not a live pre-registration) plus 3 fan-out legs H-encoder / H-real-stack / H-submargin (GOV-FANOUT-1 portfolio). initial_frozen_count_at_registration is set at registration and never moves.

hypotheses.label: merging three surrogate channel heads into one trunk under one optimizer degrades harm calibration
hypotheses.desc: In a driver-local three-head surrogate (sensory-reconstruction / forward-prediction / action-conditioned harm) over a frozen z_world, MERGED mean calibration_gap <= SEPARATED - 0.15 with all seeds sign-consistent, in BOTH hazard densities.
hypotheses.basis: Retro-registered and adjudicated by the same artifact; see resolution.basis.

resolution.basis: V3-EXQ-993a returned DENSE mean paired diff -0.0064 (2 of 4 seeds negative) and SPARSE +0.1120 (1 of 4 seeds negative); both pre-registered criteria failed on both clauses, with H1/H2 dv_headroom cleared over the control arm beforehand and 8 of 8 control cells positive. The leg is NOT falsified and NOT eliminated: the correct t(3) 95 percent intervals on the paired means are [-0.204, +0.191] (DENSE) and [-0.158, +0.382] (SPARSE), so the run does NOT exclude this leg's own >= 0.15 degradation in either condition, and joint power at -0.15 is about 12 percent -- the bar is not met, so the state stays `alive`. What the run DOES establish is an upper bound: a merged degradation of roughly 0.20+ (DENSE) / 0.16+ (SPARSE) is excluded in this surrogate, on a working readout. Two further limits on how far the leg was even tested: only one of ARC-021's two falsifier DVs (calibration_gap, not attribution accuracy) was read, and the arm satisfies the claim's non-degeneracy precondition only in the surrogate's sense. WITHDRAWN at the Step 8 gate (2026-09-05): the draft's `falsified_at_this_scale` state, its `resolved_utc`, and its z-interval bound clause ('excludes roughly 0.13+ DENSE / 0.05+ SPARSE') -- all three were consequences of the same z-vs-t error (Step 7c red-team F1). PROVENANCE FLAG, unchanged: this leg was retro-registered and adjudicated by the SAME artifact, so it must not be counted as a live pre-registration when the Dimension 3/4 denominator is computed.

hypotheses.label: the contamination is at the ENCODER, not the trunk
hypotheses.desc: With the encoder unfrozen and jointly optimised under the collapsed objective, MERGED degrades harm calibration by >= 0.15 in both conditions. Null: both mean paired diffs still > -0.15 with no sign consistency.
hypotheses.basis: Live rival named by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-993a_2026-09-05 fan-out; see desc for the pre-registered test and null.

hypotheses.label: the null is a surrogate artefact -- merging the ACTUAL E1/E2/E3 stack degrades harm calibration
hypotheses.desc: Merging E1DeepPredictor / E2WorldForward / E2HarmSForward / E3TrajectorySelector into one trunk under one optimizer inside a live REEAgent loop degrades the action-conditioned calibration_gap and a selection-level harm-avoidance readout, relative to the separated stack. Null: no degradation beyond the pre-registered margin in either condition. This is the test ARC-021's what_would_answer names by file. It should START from the existing never-scored driver ree-v3/experiments/v3_spark_arc021_three_loop_scale.py, but ONLY after the six mandatory repairs in fanout_recommendation.suggested_probes[H2] -- in particular repair (d), the detach/undetach encoder-gradient asymmetry, which as the spark stands would alias THIS leg with H-encoder-level-merge-degrades in a single arm. The leg must also read BOTH of ARC-021's falsifier DVs (calibration_gap AND attribution accuracy) and pre-register an effect its seed count can actually detect.
hypotheses.basis: Live rival named by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-993a_2026-09-05 fan-out; see desc for the pre-registered test and null.

hypotheses.label: a real but sub-margin degradation exists and this design cannot resolve it
hypotheses.desc: At >= 16 seeds with paired variance reduction, the 95 percent CI on the mean paired diff lies below -0.05 in at least one condition. Null: the CI excludes -0.05 in both.
hypotheses.basis: Live rival named by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-993a_2026-09-05 fan-out; see desc for the pre-registered test and null.

decision.decision_question: Is separate optimisation of the three BG-like learning channels required for harm calibration, or is one shared channel differentiated at the readout sufficient?
decision.live_gate: The three-leg portfolio pre-registered here: an encoder-unfrozen merge (drive axis), a real E1/E2/E3-stack merge inside a live REEAgent loop reading BOTH of ARC-021's falsifier DVs (representation axis; start from v3_spark_arc021_three_loop_scale.py only after its six mandatory repairs, esp. the detach/undetach asymmetry), and a >=16-seed sub-margin re-pose with a CI on -0.05 (measurement axis). New EXQ number, not a 993 letter.
decision.distance_phrase: 1 of 4 legs adjudicated (surrogate trunk merge: bounded from above at ~0.20/0.16 degradation, -0.15 not excluded, joint power ~12 percent -> alive/mixed); 3 fan-out legs pre-registered, none queued.

questions.opened_note: Opened because V3-EXQ-993a is the first run in this family with a working readout and therefore the first that can adjudicate anything here. 993a's own reading was amended at the Step 8 gate from `weakens` to `mixed` after a cross-model Step 7c red-team, so leg 1 stays alive rather than resolving -- the run bounds the effect from above without excluding the one the leg predicts. The question is genuinely a discrimination, and the biology is contested in the same direction (Engel 2024 / Engelhard 2019 / Groessl 2018 / Wolpert 1998 for channel specificity; Schultz 1998 for one global signal differentiated downstream), so the denominator should be frozen before the portfolio runs rather than after.

questions.title: Is SD-082's propagated action bias candidate-DISCRIMINATING because the rule->bias readout was TRAINED to discriminate -- or is the apparent discrimination the INIT STRUCTURE of a random first layer plus ReLU, a tanh artefact, an upstream property of the candidate summaries, or capped by a half-dead head?
questions.note_on_count: 5 = the four legs drafted by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822e_2026-09-05 plus H-init-structure, added at that artifact's Step 7c red team and ratified at its Step 8 gate. Mode A throughout: no leg has been adjudicated, so the denominator is frozen BEFORE the adjudicating run exists. initial_frozen_count_at_registration is set here and never moves.

hypotheses.label: The TRAINED rule->bias readout produces a candidate-DISCRIMINATING raw bias
hypotheses.desc: SD-082's own assertion: with the per-candidate-summary amend engaged, the TRAINED head converts a differentiated rule_state into a raw pre-tanh action bias whose cross-candidate range is a substantial fraction of its mean-abs, and which is argmax-consequential. Adjudicated by a TRAINED-MINUS-INIT discrimination index exceeding a margin pre-registered off the random-init distribution, on new seeds -- NOT by an absolute index floor. Null: the trained index sits inside the init head's own distribution, i.e. training adds no discrimination.
hypotheses.basis: 822e measured C1 at 4/5 seeds (mean_median index 1.846) and C2 at 0.0583 (107/1834), both clearing their pre-registered ABSOLUTE bars -- but the run's readiness conjunction voided the verdict, and its Step 7c red team then established that those bars do not separate this leg from H-init-structure. The leg is live and untested as stated here.

hypotheses.label: The discrimination is present but is INIT STRUCTURE, not a trained coupling
hypotheses.desc: The measured cross-candidate spread is what a randomly-initialised first layer plus ReLU already possesses -- exactly the reading the driver's `bias_head_actually_trained` gate text says it exists to exclude, and exactly the one C1/C2 as designed cannot separate from H1. Adjudicated by the same trained-minus-init measurement as H1, of which this leg is the complement: if the trained index does not exceed the init index by the pre-registered margin, this leg holds and H1 does not. Null: the trained index exceeds the init distribution by that margin.
hypotheses.basis: Added at failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822e_2026-09-05's cross-model Step 7c red team (Finding 2/3) and ratified at its Step 8 gate. Monte-Carlo over 200 trials with a head of the driver's exact shape (K=32 centered random summaries, last-layer norm rescaled to the recorded 0.148, rule_state norm 0.19) gives a RANDOM-INIT raw discrimination index of median 3.93, p5 1.68, p95 5.41, clearing C1's 1.0 floor in 99 percent of trials -- above 822e's measured 1.846, and near the driver's own iid reference of 5.15. The leg is not merely live; on the recorded numbers it is the leg the existing evidence cannot rule out.

hypotheses.label: The propagated bias is candidate-UNIFORM; apparent spread is manufactured by the tanh
hypotheses.desc: The raw pre-tanh bias is a common-mode shift near-identical across candidates; because the output stage is bias_scale*tanh(raw/bias_scale), a uniform raw shift emerges as a non-uniform post-tanh delta of the same order as the observed post-tanh spread. Such a state preserves argmax order and is invisible to every downstream reader. This is the only state that may WEAKEN SD-082. PROBE SKETCH (not assigned to V3-EXQ-822f, which measures a difference of indices and does not separate uniform from discriminating): decompose the raw stage against the post-tanh stage with the tanh scale swept or bypassed, declaring the null as the index sitting near its analytic 0 (< 0.25) in BOTH arms with zero argmax flips.
hypotheses.basis: This is the state the raw-stage DV was constructed to exclude, and it is the driver's own `reads_candidate_uniform` branch. 822e recorded `reads_candidate_uniform: false` and a post-tanh spread (2.15e-3 ON / 2.70e-3 OFF) of exactly the order the driver's header predicts a uniform shift would manufacture, so the leg is not excluded on any adjudicated run.

hypotheses.label: Any index is set upstream: the post-action candidate summaries are too similar to flip hidden units
hypotheses.desc: The index also reads near zero, and can read spuriously high in a pinned-pool arm, when the hidden ReLU mask is IDENTICAL or near-identical across candidates -- an UPSTREAM property of the centered candidate summaries rather than a property of SD-082's consumer. The driver records this caveat at `reads_uniform` and points at the summary-spread statistic. PROBE SKETCH (not assigned to V3-EXQ-822f): decompose the index against per-candidate hidden-mask heterogeneity -- the leg's own adjudication condition, and one 822f performs nowhere.
hypotheses.basis: The `candidate_summary_spread_survives_centering` gate is a FLOOR (worst-cell ratio 2.70e-3 against 1e-3), not a guarantee of mask heterogeneity, and the driver says so in terms. ARM_OFF/seed101 carrying the matrix's highest index (4.316) in a one-rule pinned pool is the kind of observation this leg predicts.

hypotheses.label: The consumer head's capacity caps the achievable discrimination
hypotheses.desc: Over half the head's hidden ReLU units are dead in both arms (`hidden_dead_relu_frac_p2_mean` 0.5140 ON / 0.5127 OFF), so the mapping from rule_state to per-candidate bias runs through roughly half the intended width. On this reading the index is real but systematically depressed, and the pre-registered bars are read against a handicapped head. PROBE SKETCH (not assigned to V3-EXQ-822f): an initialisation or activation-function variation that MOVES the dead fraction, asking whether the index moves with it -- a variation 822f does not perform.
hypotheses.basis: Measured and unchanged across 822c / 822d / 822e, and flagged by the driver itself as `dead_relu_partial_contributor: true` while `dead_relu_confirmed` stays false. Never isolated as a hypothesis; carried as a caveat only.

decision.decision_question: Does the SD-082 TRAINED rule-to-action readout deliver a candidate-discriminating, argmax-consequential action bias BEYOND what the head's initialisation already provides -- the property that makes the SD-078 differentiated rule pool behaviourally consequential rather than silent?
decision.live_gate: V3-EXQ-822f as specified by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822e_2026-09-05: a TRAINED-MINUS-INIT-HEAD raw discrimination index (the existing `_init_positive_control` snapshot and synthetic probe run through the INIT head as well as the trained one), with the margin pre-registered off the random-init distribution (Monte-Carlo p95 5.41, or an init distribution measured in-run), on NEW seeds (not 101/202/303/404/505), with the trainedness gate re-specified as ||W_p1 - W_init|| per parameter tensor scoped to the treatment arm, and the C4 / SD-078 contrast kept but emitted through the three-valued logic at a seed count its 1.69 variance can support. An ABSOLUTE index floor is explicitly NOT the gate: an untrained head clears 1.0 in 99 percent of trials.
decision.distance_phrase: One DESIGN-CHANGED run away, not one repaired re-run away. The DV, the arm axis and the controls are exercised and stable at full budget, but the load-bearing criterion has to be replaced (init control) and the seeds changed before any run can adjudicate; a same-seed replay is a deterministic re-print of 822d/822e and adjudicates nothing.
decision.observation_bottleneck: TWO, compounding. (1) V3-EXQ-822e's run-level readiness gate `bias_head_actually_trained` compares the SIGNED difference of last-layer weight NORMS (driver L1164-1166) against a 1e-3 LOWER floor over the MINIMUM cell (L1402-1404), so a head that trained inward reads as untrained; ARM_OFF/seed101 read -0.003772 and voided the run, though all ten cells clear the floor on |delta| (min 0.002076). (2) The deeper bottleneck, and the one that survives repairing (1): there is NO INIT-HEAD CONTROL anywhere in the design, so C1 and C2 cannot separate a trained coupling from init structure -- a random-init head of this shape clears C1's floor in 99 percent of Monte-Carlo trials. Until the init control exists this question cannot be adjudicated however well the substrate behaves and however cleanly the readiness gate passes.
